AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  CloudFormation stack for StudyBuddy authentication infrastructure.
  Creates a Cognito User Pool with email verification, custom Lambda triggers,
  a frontend app client supporting OAuth2 flows, a Cognito Hosted UI domain,
  Google identity provider integration, and secrets storage for Google OAuth credentials.

Parameters:
  FrontendDomain:
    Type: String
    Description: Fully qualified domain name for the frontend application (e.g., app.studybuddy.com)
    AllowedPattern: '^([a-zA-Z0-9]([a-zA-Z0-9-]*[a-zA-Z0-9])?\.)+[a-zA-Z]{2,}$|^localhost(:\d{1,5})?$'
    Default: localhost:3000

  DomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Globally unique prefix for the Cognito Hosted UI domain.
    Default: 'study-buddy-hosted-ui'
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 63
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens, 3-63 characters.

  GoogleClientId:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Description: Google OAuth client ID for sign-in integration.
    Default: 'placeholder-client-id'

  GoogleClientSecret:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Description: Google OAuth client secret for sign-in integration.
    Default: 'placeholder-client-secret'

Resources:
  # IAM Role for Lambda functions
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  # Lambda function: Post-Authentication trigger
  PostAuthLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-post-auth'
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          def handler(event, context):
              # Placeholder: log and return event
              print("Post-authentication trigger invoked")
              return event
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  # Lambda function: Post-Confirmation trigger
  PostConfirmationLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-post-confirmation'
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          def handler(event, context):
              print("Post-confirmation trigger invoked")
              return event
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  # Lambda function: Pre-Sign-Up trigger
  PreSignUpLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-pre-signup'
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          def handler(event, context):
              print("Pre sign-up trigger invoked")
              # Auto-confirm user
              event['response']['autoConfirmUser'] = True
              event['response']['autoVerifyEmail'] = True
              return event
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  # Permissions for Cognito to invoke Lambda functions
  PostAuthLambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !GetAtt PostAuthLambda.Arn
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt StudyBuddyUserPool.Arn

  PostConfirmationLambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !GetAtt PostConfirmationLambda.Arn
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt StudyBuddyUserPool.Arn

  PreSignUpLambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !GetAtt PreSignUpLambda.Arn
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt StudyBuddyUserPool.Arn

  # Cognito User Pool
  StudyBuddyUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: StudyBuddyUserPool
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      EmailVerificationSubject: 'StudyBuddy - Verify your email'
      EmailVerificationMessage: 'Your verification code is {####}'
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: given_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: family_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      LambdaConfig:
        PostAuthentication: !GetAtt PostAuthLambda.Arn
        PostConfirmation: !GetAtt PostConfirmationLambda.Arn
        PreSignUp: !GetAtt PreSignUpLambda.Arn
      MfaConfiguration: 'OFF'

  # Cognito Identity Provider for Google
  GoogleIdP:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Properties:
      ProviderName: Google
      ProviderType: Google
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudyBuddyUserPool
      AttributeMapping:
        email: email
        given_name: given_name
        family_name: family_name
      ProviderDetails:
        client_id: !Ref GoogleClientId
        client_secret: !Ref GoogleClientSecret
        authorize_scopes: 'profile email openid'

  # Cognito App Client – depends on GoogleIdP to avoid ordering issues
  StudyBuddyAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: GoogleIdP
    Properties:
      ClientName: StudyBuddyAppClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudyBuddyUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        RefreshToken: days
      ReadAttributes:
        - email
        - given_name
        - family_name
      WriteAttributes:
        - email
        - given_name
        - family_name
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
        - implicit
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Sub
          - 'https://${Domain}/callback'
          - {Domain: !Ref FrontendDomain}
        - 'http://localhost:3000/callback'
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Sub
          - 'https://${Domain}/logout'
          - {Domain: !Ref FrontendDomain}
        - 'http://localhost:3000/logout'
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
        - Google

  # Cognito Hosted UI Domain (Cognito‑provided domain)
  StudyBuddyDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Ref DomainPrefix
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudyBuddyUserPool

  # Secrets Manager secret for Google OAuth credentials
  GoogleOAuthCredentials:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-google-oauth-credentials'
      Description: Google OAuth client ID and secret for StudyBuddy app
      SecretString: !Sub '{"client_id":"${GoogleClientId}","client_secret":"${GoogleClientSecret}"}'
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the StudyBuddy Cognito User Pool
    Value: !Ref StudyBuddyUserPool

  AppClientId:
    Description: ID of the StudyBuddy App Client
    Value: !Ref StudyBuddyAppClient

  CognitoDomainUrl:
    Description: Full URL for the Cognito Hosted UI
    Value: !Sub 'https://${DomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'

  GoogleOAuthSecretArn:
    Description: ARN of the Secret containing Google OAuth credentials
    Value: !Ref GoogleOAuthCredentials

Description: CloudFormation template for Users and Fog VPCs with private endpoint connectivity

Parameters:
  UsersSubnetCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.50.0.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the Users subnet
  FogSubnetCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.60.0.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the Fog subnet

Resources:
  # Users VPC
  UsersVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.50.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: UsersVPC

  UsersSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref UsersVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref UsersSubnetCIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: UsersSubnet

  UsersRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref UsersVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: UsersRouteTable

  UsersSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref UsersRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref UsersSubnet

    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref UsersVPC

      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref UsersRouteTable
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway

    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup

        - IpProtocol: tcp

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Security Hub Automation Rules for Suppression of Specific Findings'
Parameters:
  ExcludedIAMUsers:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: 'List of IAM user names to exclude from IAM finding suppression (expect exactly 2)'
  SubAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'AWS account ID for scoped CIS suppression'
  PublicBuckets:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: 'List of S3 bucket names that are intentionally public (max 3 expected)'
  EBSEncryptionAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'AWS account ID for EBS encryption finding suppression'
  AutomationAccounts:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: 'Comma-separated list of two AWS account IDs for automation accounts (exactly 2 expected)'
Conditions:
  HasExcludedIAMUsers: !Not [!Equals [!Join [',', !Ref ExcludedIAMUsers], '']]
  HasSubAccountId: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SubAccountId, '']]
  HasPublicBuckets: !Not [!Equals [!Join [',', !Ref PublicBuckets], '']]
  HasEBSAccountId: !Not [!Equals [!Ref EBSEncryptionAccountId, '']]
  HasAutomationAccounts: !Not [!Equals [!Join [',', !Ref AutomationAccounts], '']]
Resources:
  GuardDutyDetector:
    Type: AWS::GuardDuty::Detector
    Properties:
      Enable: true
  Rule1SuppressIAMFindingsExcludingUsers:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: SuppressIAMFindingsExcludingUsers
      Description: 'Suppress IAM-related findings across the account, excluding specified human users'
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      RuleOrder: 1
      Criteria:
        GeneratorId:
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/iam.1
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/iam.2
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/iam.3
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/iam.4
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/iam.5
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/iam.6
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/iam.7
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/iam.8
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/iam.9
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/iam.10
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/iam.11
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/iam.12
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/iam.13
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/iam.14
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/iam.15
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/iam.16
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/iam.17
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/iam.18
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/iam.19
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/iam.20
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/iam.21
            Comparison: EQUALS
        ResourceType:
          - Value: AwsIamUser
            Comparison: EQUALS
        ResourceId: !If
          - HasExcludedIAMUsers
          - - Value: !Select [0, !Ref ExcludedIAMUsers]
              Comparison: NOT_EQUALS
            - Value: !Select [1, !Ref ExcludedIAMUsers]
              Comparison: NOT_EQUALS
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: !If
                - HasExcludedIAMUsers
                - 'IAM findings suppressed – accepted as non-actionable. Excluded users: '
                - 'IAM findings suppressed – accepted as non-actionable. No users excluded.'
              UpdatedBy: System
  Rule2SuppressCISForSubAccount:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: SuppressCISForSubAccount
      Description: 'Suppress specific CIS benchmark findings scoped to a designated sub-account'
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      RuleOrder: 2
      Criteria:
        GeneratorId:
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/cis-aws-foundations-benchmark/v/1.2.0/1.1
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/cis-aws-foundations-benchmark/v/1.2.0/1.2
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/cis-aws-foundations-benchmark/v/1.2.0/1.3
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/cis-aws-foundations-benchmark/v/1.2.0/1.4
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/cis-aws-foundations-benchmark/v/1.2.0/1.5
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/cis-aws-foundations-benchmark/v/1.2.0/1.6
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/cis-aws-foundations-benchmark/v/1.2.0/1.7
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/cis-aws-foundations-benchmark/v/1.2.0/1.8
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/cis-aws-foundations-benchmark/v/1.2.0/1.9
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/cis-aws-foundations-benchmark/v/1.2.0/1.10
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/cis-aws-foundations-benchmark/v/1.2.0/1.11
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/cis-aws-foundations-benchmark/v/1.2.0/1.12
            Comparison: EQUALS
        AwsAccountId: !If
          - HasSubAccountId
          - - Value: !Ref SubAccountId
              Comparison: EQUALS
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: !If
                - HasSubAccountId
                - !Sub 'Sub-account ${SubAccountId} CIS findings suppressed – reviewed and accepted.'
                - 'No sub-account specified – no suppression applied.'
              UpdatedBy: System
  Rule3SuppressCISAndFSBPBroad:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: SuppressCISAndFSBPBroad
      Description: 'Suppress a set of CIS and AWS Foundational Security Best Practices findings organization-wide'
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      RuleOrder: 3
      Criteria:
        GeneratorId:
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/cis-aws-foundations-benchmark/v/1.2.0/2.1
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/cis-aws-foundations-benchmark/v/1.2.0/2.2
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/cis-aws-foundations-benchmark/v/1.2.0/2.3
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/cis-aws-foundations-benchmark/v/1.2.0/4.1
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/cis-aws-foundations-benchmark/v/1.2.0/4.2
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/cis-aws-foundations-benchmark/v/1.2.0/4.3
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/aws-foundational-security-best-practices/v/1.0.0/EC2.1
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/aws-foundational-security-best-practices/v/1.0.0/EC2.2
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/aws-foundational-security-best-practices/v/1.0.0/S3.1
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/aws-foundational-security-best-practices/v/1.0.0/S3.2
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/aws-foundational-security-best-practices/v/1.0.0/S3.3
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/aws-foundational-security-best-practices/v/1.0.0/Config.1
            Comparison: EQUALS
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: 'Broad CIS and FSBP findings suppressed – accepted as non-actionable (bastion host ports, testing S3 buckets, Config regional coverage).'
              UpdatedBy: System
  Rule4SuppressPublicBucketFindings:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: SuppressPublicBucketFindings
      Description: 'Suppress public-access findings for a known list of intentionally public S3 buckets'
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      RuleOrder: 4
      Criteria:
        ResourceType:
          - Value: AwsS3Bucket
            Comparison: EQUALS
        GeneratorId:
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/aws-foundational-security-best-practices/v/1.0.0/S3.1
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/aws-foundational-security-best-practices/v/1.0.0/S3.2
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/aws-foundational-security-best-practices/v/1.0.0/S3.3
            Comparison: EQUALS
        ResourceId: !If
          - HasPublicBuckets
          - - Value: !Select [0, !Ref PublicBuckets]
              Comparison: EQUALS
            - Value: !Select [1, !Ref PublicBuckets]
              Comparison: EQUALS
            - Value: !Select [2, !Ref PublicBuckets]
              Comparison: EQUALS
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: 'Public bucket findings suppressed – buckets are intentionally public. See PublicBuckets parameter for list.'
              UpdatedBy: System
  Rule5SuppressEBSEncryptionFinding:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: SuppressEBSEncryptionFinding
      Description: 'Suppress the EBS default-encryption finding for one specific account'
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      RuleOrder: 5
      Criteria:
        GeneratorId:
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/aws-foundational-security-best-practices/v/1.0.0/EC2.15
            Comparison: EQUALS
        AwsAccountId: !If
          - HasEBSAccountId
          - - Value: !Ref EBSEncryptionAccountId
              Comparison: EQUALS
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: !If
                - HasEBSAccountId
                - !Sub 'EBS encryption finding suppressed for account ${EBSEncryptionAccountId}.'
                - 'No account specified – no suppression applied.'
              UpdatedBy: System
  Rule6SuppressIAMUnusedCredsAndKeys:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: SuppressIAMUnusedCredsAndKeys
      Description: 'Suppress unused-credential and access-key-rotation findings for two specific automation accounts'
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      RuleOrder: 6
      Criteria:
        GeneratorId:
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/iam.4
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/iam.5
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/iam.6
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:securityhub:::rules/iam.7
            Comparison: EQUALS
        AwsAccountId: !If
          - HasAutomationAccounts
          - - Value: !Select [0, !Ref AutomationAccounts]
              Comparison: EQUALS
            - Value: !Select [1, !Ref AutomationAccounts]
              Comparison: EQUALS
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: 'IAM unused credential and key rotation findings suppressed for accounts with infrequent automation.'
              UpdatedBy: System
  Rule7SuppressGuardDutyBedrockActivity:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: SuppressGuardDutyBedrockActivity
      Description: 'Suppress GuardDuty finding type related to expected cross-account Bedrock API activity'
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      RuleOrder: 7
      Criteria:
        ProductName:
          - Value: GuardDuty
            Comparison: EQUALS
        Type:
          - Value: 'GuardDuty/BedrockActivity/PossibleCrossAccountActivity'
            Comparison: EQUALS
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: 'Cross-account Bedrock API activity is expected – finding suppressed.'
              UpdatedBy: System

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

Resources:
  CMKKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for MCPToolBucket SSE-KMS encryption
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow S3 to use the key for SSE-KMS
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  MCPToolBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref CMKKey
            BucketKeyEnabled: true

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:InvokeModel
                  - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ce:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:aws:s3:::${MCPToolBucket}
                  - !Sub arn:aws:s3:::${MCPToolBucket}/*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:

                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt

      Timeout: 900

  LambdaLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup

      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/bac-mcp-tool

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: BedrockAgentGatewayInvocationRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: BedrockGatewayPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: !GetAtt LambdaFunction.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:aws:s3:::${MCPToolBucket}
                  - !Sub arn:aws:s3:::${MCPToolBucket}/*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                Resource: !GetAtt CMKKey.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'EC2 Image Builder pipeline for CIS hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM AMI with Elastic Beanstalk compatibility, daily builds, vulnerability scanning, and lifecycle policy'

Parameters:
  ParentImageArn:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>
    Description: AMI ID of the parent image for the Image Builder recipe. Resolves to the latest Amazon Linux 2023 ARM image.
    Default: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-6.1-arm64
  OrganizationArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the AWS Organization to share AMI launch permissions
    Default: 'arn:aws:organizations::123456789012:organization/o-xxxxxxxxxx'
  DevAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: AWS account ID for development environment
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    Default: '111111111111'
  ProdAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: AWS account ID for production environment
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    Default: '222222222222'
  ImageBuilderPipelineName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name for the Image Builder pipeline
    Default: 'cis-eb-arm-pipeline'
  ImageBuilderComponentName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name for the custom Elastic Beanstalk component
    Default: 'elastic-beanstalk-setup'

Resources:
  # VPC and Networking
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: '10.0.0.0/16'
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: '10.0.1.0/24'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: '10.0.2.0/24'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-2'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  # NAT Gateway for private subnet internet access
  NatEip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip'

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gw'

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: '10.0.3.0/24'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet'

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt'

  PrivateDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet

  # Security Groups
  BuildSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Image Builder build instances
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-build-sg'
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16

  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for VPC interface endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-endpoint-sg'
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16

  # VPC Endpoints
  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource: '*'

  SsmEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  SsmMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  Ec2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  # IAM Roles and Instance Profile
  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderS3Logs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt LogsBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${LogsBucket.Arn}/*'
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderKMSLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !GetAtt S3KmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-instance-role'

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole

  # S3 Bucket for logs
  LogsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Suspended
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref S3KmsKey
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-logs'
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  # KMS Key for S3 Encryption
  S3KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: 'KMS key for Image Builder log bucket encryption'
      Enabled: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: 'key-default-1'
        Statement:
          - Sid: 'Enable IAM User Permissions'
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-s3-kms-key'

  S3KmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-logs-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref S3KmsKey

  # Custom Component for Elastic Beanstalk
  ElasticBeanstalkComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ImageBuilderComponentName}-${AWS::StackName}'
      Platform: 'Linux'
      Version: '1.0.0'
      Description: 'Installs Elastic Beanstalk CLI and dependencies for AMI compatibility'
      ChangeDescription: 'Initial version'
      Data: |
        name: ElasticBeanstalkSetup
        description: Installs EB CLI and required packages
        schemaVersion: 1.0

        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: UpdateSystem
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - yum update -y
              - name: InstallPythonPip
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - yum install -y python3-pip
              - name: InstallEbCli
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - pip3 install awsebcli
    DeletionPolicy: Delete

  # Image Recipe
  ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ImageBuilderPipelineName}-recipe-${AWS::StackName}'
      Version: '1.0.0'
      ParentImage: !Ref ParentImageArn
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref ElasticBeanstalkComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: '/dev/xvda'
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: 50
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      WorkingDirectory: '/tmp'
      Description: 'CIS hardened AL2023 ARM with Elastic Beanstalk setup'

  # Distribution Configuration
  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ImageBuilderPipelineName}-dist-${AWS::StackName}'
      Description: 'Distribution to current region with launch permissions'
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub '${ImageBuilderPipelineName}-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            Description: 'CIS hardened AL2023 ARM for Elastic Beanstalk'
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              OrganizationArns:
                - !Ref OrganizationArn
              UserIds:
                - !Ref DevAccountId
                - !Ref ProdAccountId

  # Infrastructure Configuration
  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ImageBuilderPipelineName}-infra-${AWS::StackName}'
      Description: 'Infrastructure config for Image Builder pipeline'
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref BuildSecurityGroup
      Logging:
        S3Logs:
          S3BucketName: !Ref LogsBucket
          S3KeyPrefix: 'logs/'
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true

  # Image Pipeline
  ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ImageBuilderPipelineName
      Description: 'Daily build of CIS hardened AL2023 ARM AMI with EB setup'
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref ImageRecipe
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ImageScanningEnabled: true
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: 'cron(0 0 * * ? *)'
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: 'EXPRESSION_MATCH_AND_DEPENDENCY_UPDATES_AVAILABLE'
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true  # Required when vulnerability scanning is enabled
      EnhancedImageMetadataEnabled: true

  # IAM Role for Lifecycle Policy
  LifecyclePolicyRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderLifecyclePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - imagebuilder:DeleteImage
                  - imagebuilder:ListImages
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-lifecycle-role'

  # Lifecycle Policy to delete images after 6 months (180 days)
  LifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ImageBuilderPipelineName}-lifecycle-${AWS::StackName}'
      Description: 'Expire images older than 180 days'
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt LifecyclePolicyRole.Arn
      ResourceType: 'AMI_IMAGE'
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            Type: 'DELETE'
          Filter:
            Type: AGE
            Value: 180
            Unit: DAYS
            RetainAtLeast: 1
      ResourceSelection:
        TagMap:
          CreatedByImagePipeline: !Ref ImageBuilderPipelineName
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${ImageBuilderPipelineName}-lifecycle-policy'

Outputs:
  PipelineName:
    Description: Name of the Image Builder pipeline
    Value: !Ref ImagePipeline
  PipelineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Image Builder pipeline
    Value: !Ref ImagePipeline
  ImageRecipeArn:
    Description: ARN of the custom image recipe
    Value: !Ref ImageRecipe
  DistributionConfigurationArn:
    Description: ARN of the distribution configuration
    Value: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
  InfrastructureConfigurationArn:
    Description: ARN of the infrastructure configuration
    Value: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
  LifecyclePolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the lifecycle policy
    Value: !Ref LifecyclePolicy
  LogsBucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket for Image Builder logs
    Value: !Ref LogsBucket

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Serverless Maths MCP Server with Cognito authentication'

Parameters:
  DeploymentStage:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Deployment stage name for API Gateway
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: maths-mcp-users
    Description: Name of the Cognito User Pool
  AppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: maths-mcp-client
    Description: Name of the Cognito User Pool App Client

Resources:
  # Cognito User Pool
  MathsMCPUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          Mutable: true

  # Cognito User Pool Client
  MathsMCPUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref AppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref MathsMCPUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days

  # IAM Role for Lambda
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: cognito-idp:GetUser
                Resource: !GetAtt MathsMCPUserPool.Arn

  # Main Lambda Function
  MathsMCPLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 512
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          def handler(event, context):
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'body': json.dumps('Hello from Maths MCP Lambda')
              }

  # Cognito Token Validator Lambda
  CognitoValidatorLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: MathsMCPUserPool
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-validator'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 128
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  token = event['headers']['Authorization']
                  client = boto3.client('cognito-idp')
                  user_response = client.get_user(AccessToken=token)
                  return {
                      'principalId': user_response['Username'],
                      'policyDocument': {
                          'Version': '2012-10-17',
                          'Statement': [{
                              'Action': 'execute-api:Invoke',
                              'Effect': 'Allow',
                              'Resource': event['methodArn']
                          }]
                      }
                  }
              except Exception:
                  return {
                      'principalId': 'unauthorized',
                      'policyDocument': {
                          'Version': '2012-10-17',
                          'Statement': [{
                              'Action': 'execute-api:Invoke',
                              'Effect': 'Deny',
                              'Resource': event['methodArn']
                          }]
                      }
                  }

  # API Gateway REST API
  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-api'
      Description: Maths MCP API
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  # API Gateway Resource: /mcp (child of root)
  McpResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: mcp

  # API Gateway Authorizer (Lambda REQUEST type)
  CognitoValidatorAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    DependsOn: MathsMCPUserPool
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-validator'
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      Type: REQUEST
      AuthorizerUri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${CognitoValidatorLambda.Arn}/invocations'
      IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization
      AuthorizerResultTtlInSeconds: 300

  # GET method on root (public)
  RootGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${MathsMCPLambda.Arn}/invocations'

  # OPTIONS method on /mcp for CORS (mock integration)
  McpOptionsMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref McpResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'OPTIONS,POST'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,Authorization'"
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: true

  # POST method on /mcp (secured with Lambda authorizer)
  McpPostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref McpResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: CUSTOM
      AuthorizerId: !Ref CognitoValidatorAuthorizer
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${MathsMCPLambda.Arn}/invocations'

  # Lambda Permission for public GET endpoint
  LambdaPermissionRootGet:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref MathsMCPLambda
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RestApi}/*/GET/'

  # Lambda Permission for secured POST endpoint
  LambdaPermissionMcpPost:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref MathsMCPLambda
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RestApi}/*/POST/mcp'

  # Lambda Permission for Cognito Validator Authorizer
  LambdaPermissionCognitoValidator:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref CognitoValidatorLambda
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RestApi}/*'

  # API Gateway Deployment
  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - RootGetMethod
      - McpOptionsMethod
      - McpPostMethod
      - CognitoValidatorLambda
      - CognitoValidatorAuthorizer
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      StageName: !Ref DeploymentStage

Outputs:
  ApiEndpoint:
    Description: API Gateway endpoint URL
    Value: !Sub 'https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${DeploymentStage}'
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito User Pool ID
    Value: !Ref MathsMCPUserPool
  AppClientId:
    Description: Cognito App Client ID
    Value: !Ref MathsMCPUserPoolClient
  LambdaFunctionName:
    Description: Name of the main Lambda function
    Value: !Ref MathsMCPLambda

Description: "ECS Fargate task definition with ECR repository and IAM roles"

        ScanOnPush: true
      RepositoryPolicyText:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowPull
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action:
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability

  ExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EcrPullRestricted
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                Resource: !GetAtt ECRRepository.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: "*"

  TaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: TaskLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow

                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"

  TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub "${RepoName}-task"
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      Cpu: "256"
      Memory: "512"
      NetworkMode: awsvpc

      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt TaskRole.Arn

        - Name: !Ref RepoName

          - "text"

            items:

            type: "string"

            type: "string"
          text:
            type: "string"
          cc:
            type: "array"

          ResponseModels:

      - RequestValidator

    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::ApiKey
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ApiKeyName
      Description: "API key for email API"
      Enabled: true
      GenerateDistinctId: true
      StageKeys:

    DependsOn:
      - Deployment

    Properties:

    Properties:
      KeyId: !Ref ApiKey
      KeyType: API_KEY
      UsagePlanId: !Ref UsagePlan

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Calculator demo with Step Functions and Lambda

Resources:
  CalculatorLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  CalculatorLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: Calculator
      Runtime: nodejs24.x
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt CalculatorLambdaRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          exports.handler = async (event) => {
            const { operator, operands } = event;
            if (!Array.isArray(operands) || operands.length < 2) {
              throw new Error("operands must be an array with at least two numbers");
            }
            const [a, b] = operands;
            switch (operator) {
              case 'add': return { result: a + b };
              case 'subtract': return { result: a - b };
              case 'multiply': return { result: a * b };
              case 'divide':
                if (b === 0) throw new Error("Division by zero");
                return { result: a / b };
              default: throw new Error(`Unsupported operator: ${operator}`);
            }
          };

  CalculatorLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/Calculator
      RetentionInDays: 3

  StepFunctionsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeCalculatorLambda
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: !GetAtt CalculatorLambda.Arn

  CalculatorStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: Calculator-StateMachine
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StepFunctionsRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub
        - |-
          {
            "Comment": "Calculator State Machine",
            "StartAt": "ChooseOperation",
            "States": {
              "ChooseOperation": {
                "Type": "Choice",
                "Choices": [
                  {"Variable": "$.operator", "StringEquals": "add", "Next": "Add"},
                  {"Variable": "$.operator", "StringEquals": "subtract", "Next": "Subtract"},
                  {"Variable": "$.operator", "StringEquals": "multiply", "Next": "Multiply"},
                  {"Variable": "$.operator", "StringEquals": "divide", "Next": "Divide"}
                ],
                "Default": "UnknownOperator"
              },
              "Add": {"Type": "Task", "Resource": "${CalculatorArn}", "End": true},
              "Subtract": {"Type": "Task", "Resource": "${CalculatorArn}", "End": true},
              "Multiply": {"Type": "Task", "Resource": "${CalculatorArn}", "End": true},
              "Divide": {"Type": "Task", "Resource": "${CalculatorArn}", "End": true},
              "UnknownOperator": {"Type": "Fail", "Error": "UnknownOperator", "Cause": "The operator is not supported."}
            }
          }
        - CalculatorArn: !GetAtt CalculatorLambda.Arn

Outputs:
  SampleInput:
    Value: '{"operator": "add", "operands": [1,2]}'
    Description: Example input format for the Calculator state machine

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'EC2 Image Builder pipeline for custom Amazon Linux 2023 bastion AMI'

Parameters:
  RootVolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 32
    Description: Size of the root EBS volume in GB for the AMI
  ImageVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: '1.0.0'
    Description: Version string for the image (e.g., 1.0.0)
  InstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: t3.medium
    Description: EC2 instance type for the Image Builder build instance
  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Default: 'o-xxxxxxxxxxx'
    Description: AWS Organization ID (e.g., o-xxxxxxxx) to share the AMI with. Must override with a valid Organization ID.
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.0/20'
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
  PublicSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.0/24'
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet
  PrivateSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.1.0/24'
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet
  ParentAmiId:
    Type: String
    Default: ami-0e2c8caa4b6378d8c
    Description: Amazon Linux 2023 AMI ID for use as the parent image. Default is for us-east-1; override for other regions.

Resources:
  # VPC and networking
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ImageBuilderVPC

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ImageBuilderIGW

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ImageBuilderPublicSubnet

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ImageBuilderPrivateSubnet

  NatGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ImageBuilderNAT

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ImageBuilderPublicRT

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ImageBuilderPrivateRT

  PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # Security group for Image Builder build instance (default egress allows all outbound)
  ImageBuilderSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Image Builder build instance (outbound only)
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ImageBuilderBuildSG

  # IAM role and instance profile
  ImageBuilderRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
                - imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonS3ReadOnlyAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderInline
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:Describe*
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ImageBuilderRole

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderRole

  # KMS key for S3 bucket encryption
  ImageBuilderKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for Image Builder logs bucket
      Enabled: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable root account full access
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ImageBuilderKmsKey

  ImageBuilderKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/imagebuilder-logs-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref ImageBuilderKmsKey

  # S3 bucket for Image Builder logs (auto-generated name to avoid collisions)
  ImageBuilderLogsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref ImageBuilderKmsKey
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ImageBuilderLogs

  ImageBuilderLogsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ImageBuilderLogsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub '${ImageBuilderLogsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:aws:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'

  # Image Builder Component - install packages
  ImageBuilderComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: bastion-setup-component
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Platform: Linux
      SupportedOsVersions:
        - Amazon Linux 2023
      Data: |
        name: BastionSetup
        description: Installs SSM Agent, MongoDB tools, Python, Synapse client, .NET SDK
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: UpdateSSMAgent
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo yum update -y amazon-ssm-agent
              - name: AddMongoRepo
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      sudo tee /etc/yum.repos.d/mongodb-org-8.0.repo <<EOF
                      [mongodb-org-8.0]
                      name=MongoDB Repository
                      baseurl=https://repo.mongodb.org/yum/amazon/2023/mongodb-org/8.0/x86_64/
                      gpgcheck=1
                      enabled=1
                      gpgkey=https://www.mongodb.org/static/pgp/server-8.0.asc
                      EOF
              - name: InstallMongoTools
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo yum install -y mongodb-database-tools mongosh
              - name: InstallPythonAndSynapse
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo yum install -y python3 python3-pip
                    - sudo pip3 install synapseclient
              - name: InstallDotNetSDK
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo rpm -Uvh https://packages.microsoft.com/config/rhel/9/packages-microsoft-prod.rpm
                    - sudo dnf install -y dotnet-sdk-8.0
      Tags:
        Name: BastionSetupComponent

  # Image Recipe
  ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: bastion-recipe
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: !Ref ParentAmiId
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref ImageBuilderComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
      Tags:
        Name: BastionImageRecipe

  # Infrastructure Configuration
  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: bastion-infra
      Description: Infrastructure config for bastion image build
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - !Ref InstanceType
      Logging:
        S3Logs:
          S3BucketName: !Ref ImageBuilderLogsBucket
          S3KeyPrefix: imagebuilder-logs/
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderSecurityGroup
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      Tags:
        Name: BastionInfraConfig

  # Distribution Configuration
  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: bastion-distro
      Description: Distribute AMI to all accounts in organization
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub 'bastion-ami-${ImageVersion}-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            Description: Bastion AMI with SSM, MongoDB tools, Python, Synapse, .NET SDK
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              OrganizationArns:
                - !Sub 'arn:aws:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:organization/${OrganizationId}'
                # No additional accounts; sharing with the entire organization
            AmiTags:
              Name: !Sub 'bastion-ami-${ImageVersion}'
              Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Tags:
        Name: BastionDistroConfig

  # Image Pipeline (manual trigger only)
  ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: bastion-pipeline
      Description: Pipeline to build bastion AMI on demand
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref ImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: false
        TimeoutMinutes: 60
      Status: ENABLED
      Tags:
        Name: BastionImagePipeline

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID created for Image Builder
    Value: !Ref VPC
  PrivateSubnetId:
    Description: Private subnet ID for build instances
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet
  PublicSubnetId:
    Description: Public subnet ID (NAT)
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet
  ImageBuilderSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group ID for build instances
    Value: !Ref ImageBuilderSecurityGroup
  ImageBuilderInstanceProfileArn:
    Description: Instance profile ARN used by Image Builder
    Value: !GetAtt ImageBuilderInstanceProfile.Arn
  ImageBuilderComponentArn:
    Description: Component ARN
    Value: !Ref ImageBuilderComponent
  ImageRecipeArn:
    Description: Image Recipe ARN
    Value: !Ref ImageRecipe
  InfrastructureConfigurationArn:
    Description: Infrastructure Configuration ARN
    Value: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
  DistributionConfigurationArn:
    Description: Distribution Configuration ARN
    Value: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
  ImagePipelineArn:
    Description: Image Pipeline ARN
    Value: !Ref ImagePipeline
  S3LogsBucketName:
    Description: S3 bucket for Image Builder logs
    Value: !Ref ImageBuilderLogsBucket
  KmsKeyId:
    Description: KMS key ID used for S3 bucket encryption
    Value: !Ref ImageBuilderKmsKey
  ParentAmiIdUsed:
    Description: AMI ID used as the parent image
    Value: !Ref ParentAmiId

Description: 'CloudFormation template for Plot Palette DynamoDB tables'

    Type: String
    AllowedValues:

      - staging

        - AttributeName: job_id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: user_id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: created_at
          AttributeType: S

        - AttributeName: job_id

        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

        - IndexName: user-id-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: user_id
              KeyType: HASH
            - AttributeName: created_at
              KeyType: RANGE
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL

    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'plot-palette-Queue-${EnvironmentName}'

        - AttributeName: status

        - AttributeName: job_id_timestamp

      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      Threshold: !Ref EventIngestionLatencyThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold

      EvaluationPeriods: 3

                  "region": "${Region}",

                  "annotations": {

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'AWS Backup infrastructure with tag-based backup selections and Service Catalog TagOptions'
Resources:
  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for AWS Backup vault encryption
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Allow root account full access
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow AWS Backup service to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: backup.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:ListGrants
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow AWS Backup IAM role to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt AWSBackupServiceRole.Arn
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:ListGrants
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  AWSBackupServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: AWSBackupServiceRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: backup.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSBackupServiceRolePolicyForBackup'

  DailyBackupVault:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: daily-backup-vault
      EncryptionKeyArn: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn

  WeeklyBackupVault:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: weekly-backup-vault
      EncryptionKeyArn: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn

  MonthlyBackupVault:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: monthly-backup-vault
      EncryptionKeyArn: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn

  BackupPlan:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupPlan
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: BackupPlan
        BackupPlanRule:
          - RuleName: DailyBackup
            TargetBackupVault: !Ref DailyBackupVault
            ScheduleExpression: 'cron(0 5 * * ? *)'
            StartWindowMinutes: 60
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: 14
          - RuleName: WeeklyBackup
            TargetBackupVault: !Ref WeeklyBackupVault
            ScheduleExpression: 'cron(0 5 ? * SUN *)'
            StartWindowMinutes: 60
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: 56
          - RuleName: MonthlyBackup
            TargetBackupVault: !Ref MonthlyBackupVault
            ScheduleExpression: 'cron(0 5 1 * ? *)'
            StartWindowMinutes: 60
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: 365

  BackupSelection:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupSelection
    Properties:
      BackupPlanId: !Ref BackupPlan
      BackupSelection:
        SelectionName: TagBasedSelection
        IamRoleArn: !GetAtt AWSBackupServiceRole.Arn
        Resources:
          - '*'
        ListOfTags:
          - ConditionType: STRINGEQUALS
            ConditionKey: backup
            ConditionValue: daily
          - ConditionType: STRINGEQUALS
            ConditionKey: backup
            ConditionValue: weekly
          - ConditionType: STRINGEQUALS
            ConditionKey: backup
            ConditionValue: monthly

  TagOptionDaily:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::TagOption
    Properties:
      Key: backup
      Value: daily

  TagOptionWeekly:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::TagOption
    Properties:
      Key: backup
      Value: weekly

  TagOptionMonthly:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::TagOption
    Properties:
      Key: backup
      Value: monthly

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Route53 Public Hosted Zone and DNS records for external services"

Parameters:
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: podcastgarage.org
    AllowedPattern: "^([a-zA-Z0-9-]+\\.)+[a-zA-Z]{2,}$"
    Description: Root domain name for the hosted zone.

  GoogleSiteVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Default: "REQUIRED"
    Description: Google site verification token (e.g., google-site-verification=TOKEN).

  DMARCReportEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: "REQUIRED"
    Description: Email address for DMARC aggregate reports (e.g., dmarc-reports@example.com).

  ZendeskVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Default: "REQUIRED"
    Description: Verification token for ZenDesk ownership (TXT record value).

  ZendeskDomainValidationCnameValue:
    Type: String
    Default: "REQUIRED"
    Description: CNAME target for ZenDesk domain validation.

  ZendeskDkimCnameValue:
    Type: String
    Default: "REQUIRED"
    Description: CNAME target for ZenDesk DKIM.

  GoogleWorkspaceDkimValue:
    Type: String
    Default: "REQUIRED"
    Description: DKIM TXT record value for google._domainkey.

  CampaignMonitorDkimValue:
    Type: String
    Default: "REQUIRED"
    Description: DKIM TXT record value for cm._domainkey.

  CampaignMonitorSubdomain:
    Type: String
    Default: mail
    Description: Subdomain used for Campaign Monitor delivery.

  CampaignMonitorMxPriority:
    Type: String
    Default: 10
    Description: MX priority for the Campaign Monitor subdomain.

  CampaignMonitorMxTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: bounce.mail.cm-templates.com
    Description: MX server target for Campaign Monitor.

  PrinterHostname:
    Type: String
    Default: printer
    Description: Hostname (subdomain) for the office printer.

  PrinterIpAddress:
    Type: String
    Default: 192.0.2.1
    Description: Private IP address for the printer A record.

  PublicHostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref DomainName

  RootARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: A
      TTL: 3600
      ResourceRecords:
        - 198.185.159.144
        - 198.185.159.145
        - 198.49.23.144
        - 198.49.23.145

  WwwCnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone

      TTL: 3600
      ResourceRecords:

  SpfAndVerificationTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName

      ResourceRecords:

        - !Sub '"google-site-verification=${GoogleSiteVerificationToken}"'

    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName

      ResourceRecords:
        - "1 ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM"
        - "5 ALT1.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM"
        - "5 ALT2.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM"
        - "10 ALT3.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM"
        - "10 ALT4.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM"

    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
