    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Join [".", [!Ref PrinterHostname, !Ref DomainName]]
      Type: A
      TTL: 3600
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref PrinterIpAddress

  ZendeskVerificationTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone

    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone

      Type: TXT

      Name: !Join [".", [!Ref CampaignMonitorSubdomain, !Ref DomainName]]
      Type: MX
      TTL: 3600
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub "${CampaignMonitorMxPriority} ${CampaignMonitorMxTarget}"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'E-commerce serverless IAM roles and managed policies'

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - prod
    ConstraintDescription: "Deployment environment used in resource names"

Resources:
  # SQS Queue KMS Key
  SQSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "KMS key for SQS queue POC-Queue-${Environment}"
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowSQSService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: "*"
      Enabled: true

  SQSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/sqs-key-${Environment}"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref SQSKey

  # SQS Queue
  POCQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub "POC-Queue-${Environment}"
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref SQSKey

  # DynamoDB Table
  OrdersTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "ecommerce-orders-${Environment}"
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: orderId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: orderId
          KeyType: HASH
      StreamSpecification:
        StreamViewType: NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST

  # SNS Topic KMS Key
  SNSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "KMS key for SNS topic POC-Topic-${Environment}"
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowSNSService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: "*"
      Enabled: true

  SNSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/sns-key-${Environment}"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref SNSKey

  # SNS Topic
  POCTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub "POC-Topic-${Environment}"
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref SNSKey

  # Managed Policies
  BasicLambdaExecutionPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "BasicLambdaExecution-${Environment}"
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*"

  LambdaSQSDynamoDBPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "LambdaSQSDynamoDB-${Environment}"
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sqs:ReceiveMessage
              - sqs:DeleteMessage
              - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
            Resource: !GetAtt POCQueue.Arn
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:PutItem
              - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
            Resource: !GetAtt OrdersTable.Arn

  LambdaDynamoDBStreamSNSPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "LambdaDynamoDBStreamSNS-${Environment}"
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:DescribeStream
              - dynamodb:GetRecords
              - dynamodb:GetShardIterator
              - dynamodb:ListStreams
            Resource:
              Fn::Sub:
                - "${TableArn}/stream/*"
                - TableArn: !GetAtt OrdersTable.Arn
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref POCTopic

  APIGatewaySQSPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "APIGatewaySQS-${Environment}"
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sqs:SendMessage
            Resource: !GetAtt POCQueue.Arn

  # IAM Roles
  LambdaSQSDynamoDBRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "LambdaSQSDynamoDB-${Environment}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref BasicLambdaExecutionPolicy
        - !Ref LambdaSQSDynamoDBPolicy

  LambdaDynamoDBStreamSNSPublisher:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "LambdaDynamoDBStreamSNS-${Environment}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref BasicLambdaExecutionPolicy
        - !Ref LambdaDynamoDBStreamSNSPolicy

  APIGatewaySQSPublisher:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "APIGatewaySQS-${Environment}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref APIGatewaySQSPolicy

Outputs:

    Description: ARN of the Lambda SQS DynamoDB role
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaSQSDynamoDBRole.Arn
    Export:

  LambdaDynamoDBStreamSNSPublisherArn:

    Description: ARN of the API Gateway SQS publisher role
    Value: !GetAtt APIGatewaySQSPublisher.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-APIGatewaySQSPublisherArn"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: CloudFormation template for AppStream 2.0 usage analysis with Athena named queries
Resources:
  EncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      Enabled: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: athena.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:athena:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:workgroup/AppStreamUsageWorkgroup'
  EncryptionKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/AppStreamUsageKey
      TargetKeyId: !Ref EncryptionKey
  AppStreamUsageDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: appstream-usage
        Description: Database for AppStream 2.0 usage data analyzed by Athena
  QueryResultsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref EncryptionKey
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
  QueryResultsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref QueryResultsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: athena.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${QueryResultsBucket}'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:athena:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:workgroup/AppStreamUsageWorkgroup'
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: athena.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${QueryResultsBucket}/athena-results/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:athena:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:workgroup/AppStreamUsageWorkgroup'
  AppStreamUsageWorkgroup:
    Type: AWS::Athena::WorkGroup
    Properties:
      Name: AppStreamUsageWorkgroup
      State: ENABLED
      WorkGroupConfiguration:
        ResultConfiguration:
          OutputLocation: !Sub 's3://${QueryResultsBucket}/athena-results/'
          EncryptionConfiguration:
            EncryptionOption: SSE_KMS
            KmsKey: !GetAtt EncryptionKey.Arn
        EnforceWorkGroupConfiguration: true
  AverageSessionLengthPerStackQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: AverageSessionLengthPerStack
      Database: !Ref AppStreamUsageDatabase
      WorkGroup: !Ref AppStreamUsageWorkgroup
      QueryString: |
        SELECT
          stack_name,
          AVG(CASE
              WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month', session_start_time) = DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)
                THEN date_diff('second', session_start_time, session_end_time)
              END) AS avg_current_month_seconds,
          AVG(CASE
              WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month', session_start_time) = DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1' MONTH)
                THEN date_diff('second', session_start_time, session_end_time)
              END) AS avg_previous_month_seconds
        FROM appstream_usage
        WHERE session_end_time IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY stack_name
        ORDER BY stack_name
  DailySessionCountsQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: DailySessionCounts
      Database: !Ref AppStreamUsageDatabase
      WorkGroup: !Ref AppStreamUsageWorkgroup
      QueryString: |
        SELECT
          CAST(session_start_time AS DATE) AS session_date,
          COUNT(*) AS session_count
        FROM appstream_usage
        WHERE DATE_TRUNC('month', session_start_time) = DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)
        GROUP BY CAST(session_start_time AS DATE)
        ORDER BY session_date
  AllSessionDetailsQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: AllSessionDetails
      Database: !Ref AppStreamUsageDatabase
      WorkGroup: !Ref AppStreamUsageWorkgroup
      QueryString: |
        SELECT
          session_id,
          user_id,
          stack_name,
          application_name,
          session_start_time,
          session_end_time,
          session_status,
          instance_type,
          connection_protocol
        FROM appstream_usage
        WHERE session_start_time >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30' DAY
        ORDER BY session_start_time DESC
  StreamingHoursPerUserQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: StreamingHoursPerUser
      Database: !Ref AppStreamUsageDatabase
      WorkGroup: !Ref AppStreamUsageWorkgroup
      QueryString: |
        SELECT
          user_id,
          SUM(date_diff('second', session_start_time, session_end_time) / 3600.0) AS streaming_hours
        FROM appstream_usage
        WHERE DATE_TRUNC('month', session_start_time) = DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)
          AND session_end_time IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY user_id
        ORDER BY streaming_hours DESC
  UniqueUsersPerApplicationQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: UniqueUsersPerApplication
      Database: !Ref AppStreamUsageDatabase
      WorkGroup: !Ref AppStreamUsageWorkgroup
      QueryString: |
        SELECT
          application_name,
          COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS unique_users
        FROM appstream_usage
        WHERE DATE_TRUNC('month', session_start_time) = DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)
        GROUP BY application_name
        ORDER BY unique_users DESC

    Description: CIDR block for the VPC

Conditions: {}

  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC

      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ThreeTierVPC

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ThreeTierIGW

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  NATGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: NATGatewayEIP

  NATGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NATGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ThreeTierNATGW

  # Public Subnets
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCIDR, 9, 8]]

  # Custom resource to trigger the Lambda during stack creation
  ScriptUploadTrigger:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    DependsOn: ScriptUploaderFunction
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt ScriptUploaderFunction.Arn

  # Glue Jobs
  GlueJobAssetsAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    DependsOn: ScriptUploadTrigger
    Properties:

  # Consolidated IAM Role
  ConsolidatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: QuickSightAdminSuiteRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: QuickSightAdminSuitePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:PutBucketPolicy
                  - s3:GetBucketPolicy
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${AdminSuiteBucket.Arn}/*'
                  - !GetAtt ScriptBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${ScriptBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt S3EncryptionKey.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:*
                  - quicksight:*
                  - iam:PassRole
                  - cloudwatch:*
                  - logs:*
                  - firehose:*
                  - kinesis:*
                Resource: '*'

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Self-contained ECS Fargate microservice with Cloud Map service discovery,
  VPC, NAT gateway, auto scaling, and CloudWatch logging.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Description: Environment name used to tag resources and prefix names.
    Default: dev
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z0-9\-]+'
  ServiceName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the microservice.
    Default: nginx
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z0-9\-]+'
  ContainerImage:
    Type: String
    Description: Container image URI (e.g., nginx:latest).
    Default: nginx:latest
  ContainerPort:
    Type: Number
    Description: Port the container listens on.
    Default: 80
  Cpu:
    Type: Number
    Description: CPU units for the Fargate task (256, 512, 1024, etc.).
    Default: 256
  Memory:
    Type: Number
    Description: Memory for the Fargate task in MB (512, 1024, 2048, etc.).
    Default: 512
  DesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Description: Number of tasks to run initially.
    Default: 2
  CustomTaskRoleArn:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional IAM role ARN for the task to assume (leave empty to omit).
    Default: ""

Conditions:
  HasCustomTaskRole: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CustomTaskRoleArn, ""]]

Resources:
  # VPC
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-vpc"

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-igw"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Public subnet (for NAT gateway)
  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-public"

  # Private subnets (two AZs)
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-1"

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-2"

  # NAT Gateway
  NatEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-nat"

  # Route tables
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-public-rt"

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-rt"

  PrivateDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # Security group for containers
  ContainerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for ECS tasks
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          ToPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-sg"

  # ECS Cluster
  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cluster"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cluster"

  # CloudWatch Log Group
  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/ecs/${EnvironmentName}/${ServiceName}"
      RetentionInDays: 30

  # IAM Execution Role
  ExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ECSLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt LogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-exec-role"

  # Task Definition
  TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub "${ServiceName}-task"
      ExecutionRoleArn: !Ref ExecutionRole
      TaskRoleArn: !If [HasCustomTaskRole, !Ref CustomTaskRoleArn, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      Cpu: !Ref Cpu
      Memory: !Ref Memory
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: !Ref ServiceName
          Image: !Ref ContainerImage
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref LogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref "AWS::Region"
              awslogs-stream-prefix: !Ref ServiceName

  # Cloud Map Private DNS Namespace
  CloudMapNamespace:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::PrivateDnsNamespace
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${ServiceName}.local"
      Vpc: !Ref VPC
      Description: !Sub "Private namespace for ${ServiceName}"

  # Cloud Map Service
  CloudMapService:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::Service
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ServiceName
      NamespaceId: !Ref CloudMapNamespace
      DnsConfig:
        RoutingPolicy: MULTIVALUE
        DnsRecords:
          - Type: SRV
            TTL: 60
      HealthCheckCustomConfig:
        FailureThreshold: 1

  # ECS Service
  ECSService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    Properties:
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      ServiceName: !Ref ServiceName
      TaskDefinition: !Ref TaskDefinition
      DesiredCount: !Ref DesiredCount
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref ContainerSecurityGroup
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      ServiceRegistries:
        - RegistryArn: !GetAtt CloudMapService.Arn

  # Application Auto Scaling
  ScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: ecs
      ResourceId: !Sub "service/${ECSCluster}/${ServiceName}"
      ScalableDimension: ecs:service:DesiredCount
      MinCapacity: 2
      MaxCapacity: 10

  # Scale-out alarm
  ScaleOutAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scaleout"
      AlarmDescription: "Scale out when CPU >= 70% for 2 minutes"
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref ECSCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  # Scale-out step scaling policy
  ScaleOutPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scaleout"
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalableTarget
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 0
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 10
            ScalingAdjustment: 1
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 10
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 20
            ScalingAdjustment: 2
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 20
            ScalingAdjustment: 3
        Cooldown: 120
        MetricAggregationType: Average

  # Scale-in alarm
  ScaleInAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scalein"
      AlarmDescription: "Scale in when CPU <= 20% for 15 minutes"
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      Threshold: 20
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref ECSCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  # Scale-in step scaling policy
  ScaleInPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scalein"
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalableTarget
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        StepAdjustments:
          - ScalingAdjustment: -1
        Cooldown: 300
        MetricAggregationType: Average

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
  ClusterName:
    Description: ECS Cluster name
    Value: !Ref ECSCluster
  TaskDefinitionArn:
    Description: Task definition ARN
    Value: !Ref TaskDefinition
  ServiceArn:
    Description: ECS Service ARN
    Value: !Ref ECSService
  CloudMapServiceArn:
    Description: Cloud Map service ARN for service discovery
    Value: !GetAtt CloudMapService.Arn
  CloudMapNamespaceId:
    Description: Cloud Map namespace ID
    Value: !Ref CloudMapNamespace
  LogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch Log group name
    Value: !Ref LogGroup

    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-tgw-attach-vpc"

  # Explicit Transit Gateway Route Table
  TGWRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-tgw-rt"

  # Associate the VPC attachment with the explicit route table
  TGWRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TGWRouteTable

  # Security Group
  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: "Security group for hybrid interconnect demo"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref InternalCIDR
          Description: "HTTPS from internal network"
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref OCIBackboneCIDR
          Description: "HTTPS to OCI backbone"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-sg"

  # Conditional VPN resources
  CustomerGateway:
    Condition: CreateVPNCondition
    Type: AWS::EC2::CustomerGateway
    Properties:
      Type: ipsec.1
      BgpAsn: !Ref BgpAsn
      IpAddress: !Ref OCIVpnEndpointIP
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-cgw"

  VpnConnection:
    Condition: CreateVPNCondition
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPNConnection
    Properties:
      Type: ipsec.1
      CustomerGatewayId: !Ref CustomerGateway
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      StaticRoutesOnly: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vpn"

  VpnConnectionRoute:
    Condition: CreateVPNCondition
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPNConnectionRoute
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OCIBackboneCIDR
      VpnConnectionId: !Ref VpnConnection

  TransitGatewayRoute:
    Condition: CreateVPNCondition
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OCIBackboneCIDR
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref VpnConnection
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TGWRouteTable

  # KMS Key for Flow Logs
  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: "KMS key for VPC Flow Logs encryption"
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "Enable IAM User Permissions"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: "AllowTaggedRoles"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: "*"
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              ForAnyValue:StringEquals:
                aws:PrincipalTag/FlowLogRole: "true"
          - Sid: "AllowCloudWatchLogsToUseKey"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                "kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn": !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc/flow-logs/${AWS::StackName}"

  FlowLogsKmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/vpc-flow-logs-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  # CloudWatch Log Group for Flow Logs
  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/vpc/flow-logs/${AWS::StackName}"
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn

  # IAM Role for VPC Flow Logs
  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VPCFlowLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-flow-logs-role"
        - Key: FlowLogRole
          Value: "true"

  # VPC Flow Log
  FlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-log"

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: "VPC ID"
    Value: !Ref VPC

  SubnetId:
    Description: "Private subnet ID"
    Value: !Ref Subnet

  TransitGatewayId:
    Description: "Transit Gateway ID"
    Value: !Ref TransitGateway

  SecurityGroupId:
    Description: "Security Group ID"
    Value: !Ref SecurityGroup

  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: "KMS Key ARN"
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn

  LogGroupName:
    Description: "CloudWatch Log Group name for VPC Flow Logs"
    Value: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup

  VpnConnectionId:
    Condition: CreateVPNCondition
    Description: "VPN Connection ID"
    Value: !Ref VpnConnection

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'QuickSight Admin Console Data Preparation Pipeline'

Resources:
  # KMS Customer Managed Key for S3 bucket encryption
  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowPipelineRoleKMSActions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt PipelineRole.Arn
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  # KMS Key Alias for readability
  KmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/quicksight-admin-pipeline-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  # S3 Bucket with KMS encryption
  PipelineBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'quicksight-admin-pipeline-${AWS::AccountId}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref KmsKey
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  # Bucket Policy (grants PipelineRole full S3 access)
  PipelineBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref PipelineBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt PipelineRole.Arn
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${PipelineBucket}'
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${PipelineBucket}/*'

  # IAM Role (trust Glue and CloudFormation)
  PipelineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/IAMFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonS3FullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/CloudWatchFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/CloudWatchLogsFullAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: QuickSightFullAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: 'quicksight:*'
                Resource: '*'

  # PythonShell Jobs (Glue 3.0, Python 3.9)
  GroupMembershipJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: group-membership-job
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${PipelineBucket}/scripts/group-membership.py'
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 2880

  ObjectAccessJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: object-access-job
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${PipelineBucket}/scripts/object-access.py'
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 2880

  # Glue ETL Jobs (Glue 5.0, G.1X, 2 workers)
  FolderAssetsJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: folder-assets-job
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${PipelineBucket}/scripts/folder-assets.py'
        PythonVersion: '3'
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 2880

  FolderLookupJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: folder-lookup-job
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${PipelineBucket}/scripts/folder-lookup.py'
        PythonVersion: '3'
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 2880

  FolderPathJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: folder-path-job
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${PipelineBucket}/scripts/folder-path.py'
        PythonVersion: '3'
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 2880

  # Scheduled Triggers (every 3 hours)
  GroupMembershipTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: group-membership-trigger
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(0 */3 * * ? *)
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GroupMembershipJob
      StartOnCreation: true

  ObjectAccessTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: object-access-trigger
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(0 */3 * * ? *)
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref ObjectAccessJob
      StartOnCreation: true

  FolderAssetsTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: folder-assets-trigger
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(0 */3 * * ? *)
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref FolderAssetsJob
      StartOnCreation: true

  FolderLookupTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: folder-lookup-trigger
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(0 */3 * * ? *)
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref FolderLookupJob
      StartOnCreation: true

  FolderPathTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: folder-path-trigger
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(0 */3 * * ? *)
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref FolderPathJob
      StartOnCreation: true

Outputs:
  GroupMembershipPath:
    Description: S3 path for group membership data
    Value: !Sub 's3://${PipelineBucket}/data/group-membership/'
  ObjectAccessPath:
    Description: S3 path for object access data
    Value: !Sub 's3://${PipelineBucket}/data/object-access/'
  FolderAssetsPath:
    Description: S3 path for folder assets data
    Value: !Sub 's3://${PipelineBucket}/data/folder-assets/'
  FolderLookupPath:
    Description: S3 path for folder lookup data
    Value: !Sub 's3://${PipelineBucket}/data/folder-lookup/'
  FolderPath:
    Description: S3 path for folder path data
    Value: !Sub 's3://${PipelineBucket}/data/folder-path/'
  CloudTrailLogTableS3Location:
    Description: S3 location for CloudTrail log table
    Value: !Sub 's3://${PipelineBucket}/data/cloudtrail-logs/'
  CloudTrailLogTableName:
    Description: Name of the CloudTrail log table
    Value: cloudtrail_logs

        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref KMSKey

  ChefRecipeBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ChefRecipeBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt EC2InstanceRole.Arn
            Action: s3:GetObject
            Resource: !Sub '${ChefRecipeBucket.Arn}/*'

  # IAM Role for EC2 instance
  EC2InstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3Access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub '${ChefRecipeBucket.Arn}/*'
        - PolicyName: KMSDecrypt
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn

  EC2InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref EC2InstanceRole

  # IAM service role for Image Builder
  ImageBuilderServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:Describe*
                  - ec2:RunInstances
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:TerminateInstances
                  - ec2:CreateImage
                  - ec2:CopyImage
                  - ec2:ModifyImageAttribute
                  - ec2:CreateSnapshot
                  - ec2:DeleteSnapshot
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceStatus
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub '${ChefRecipeBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn

  # VPC with public subnet for NAT, private subnets for build instances
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1CIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2CIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  PrivateRouteToNat:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # VPC Endpoints for S3 and SSM (so build instances in private subnets can reach these services)
  S3VpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:GetObject
            Resource: !Sub '${ChefRecipeBucket.Arn}/*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:ListBucket
            Resource: !Sub '${ChefRecipeBucket.Arn}'

  SSMVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref BuildSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  SSMMessagesVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref BuildSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  EC2MessagesVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref BuildSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  BuildSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Image Builder build instance
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCIDR
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCIDR

  # Image Builder component: download and run Chef recipe
  ChefRecipeDownloaderComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ComponentName1
      Platform: Linux
      Version: '1.0.0'
      Description: Downloads Chef recipe from S3 and executes it
      Data: !Sub |
        name: ChefRecipeDownloader
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - action: ExecuteBash
                name: InstallChefAndDownloadRecipe
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      # Install Chef if not present (using Chef Infra Client)
                      if ! command -v chef-client &> /dev/null; then
                        curl -L https://omnitruck.chef.io/install.sh | sudo bash -s -- -P chefdk
                      fi
                      # Download recipe archive (expects a tar.gz named recipe.tar.gz in the bucket)
                      aws s3 cp s3://${S3BucketName}/recipe.tar.gz /tmp/recipe.tar.gz
                      mkdir -p /tmp/chef-repo
                      tar -xzf /tmp/recipe.tar.gz -C /tmp/chef-repo
                      cd /tmp/chef-repo
                      # Execute chef-client in local mode
                      chef-client --local-mode --runlist 'recipe[my_cookbook]' --config-option cookbook_path=/tmp/chef-repo/cookbooks
      Tags:
        Name: !Ref ComponentName1

  # Image Builder component: update SSM agent and collect metadata
  SSMAgentUpdateAndMetadataComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ComponentName2
      Platform: Linux
      Version: '1.0.0'
      Description: Updates SSM Agent and collects metadata
      Data: |
        name: SSMAgentUpdateAndMetadata
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - action: ExecuteBash
                name: UpdateSSMAgent
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      # Update SSM Agent to latest version
                      sudo yum install -y amazon-ssm-agent
                      sudo systemctl restart amazon-ssm-agent
              - action: ExecuteBash
                name: CollectMetadata
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      # Collect system metadata and write to a file
                      echo "Build timestamp: $(date)" > /tmp/build_metadata.txt
                      uname -a >> /tmp/build_metadata.txt
                      cat /etc/os-release >> /tmp/build_metadata.txt
                      # You can upload this to S3 if needed
      Tags:
        Name: !Ref ComponentName2

  # Image recipe using latest Amazon Linux 2 ECS optimized AMI
  ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ImageRecipeName
      ParentImage: '{{resolve:ssm:/aws/service/ecs/optimized-ami/amazon-linux-2/recommended/image_id}}'
      Version: '1.0.0'
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt SSMAgentUpdateAndMetadataComponent.Arn
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt ChefRecipeDownloaderComponent.Arn
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: 30
            VolumeType: gp3

  # Infrastructure configuration
  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref InfraConfigName
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref EC2InstanceProfile
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref BuildSecurityGroup
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true

  # Distribution configuration
  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref DistConfigName
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref TargetRegion
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: 'MyCustomAMI-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserIds:
                - !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  # Image pipeline with daily schedule
  ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref PipelineName
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref ImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ImageScanningEnabled: false
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 60
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: 'cron(0 0 * * ? *)'
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: EXPRESSION_MATCH_ONLY

  # Lifecycle policy to deprecate old AMIs
  LifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref LifecyclePolicyName
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt ImageBuilderServiceRole.Arn
      ResourceType: AMI_IMAGE
      ResourceSelection:
        Recipes:
          - Name: !Ref ImageRecipeName
            SemanticVersion: '1.0.0'
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            Type: DEPRECATE
          Filter:
            RetainAtLeast: 1
            Type: AGE
            Value: 30
            Unit: DAYS

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template for 5 EC2 instances with CloudWatch alarms'

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
  InstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: t3.micro
    Description: EC2 instance type
  AMIInfo:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>
    Default: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/amzn2-ami-hvm-x86_64-gp2
    Description: AMI ID from AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store

Resources:
  # VPC
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VPC'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-IGW'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Subnets
  Subnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-Subnet1'

  Subnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-Subnet2'

  # Route table and routes
  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RouteTable'

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  Subnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  Subnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  # Security Group - no ingress/egress rules defined to avoid unrestricted access
  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for EC2 instances
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress: []
      SecurityGroupEgress: []
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SG'

  # Launch Template for IMDSv2 enforcement
  LaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateData:
        MetadataOptions:
          HttpTokens: required
          HttpEndpoint: enabled
      LaunchTemplateName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-IMDSv2Template'

  # Five EC2 Instances (all in Subnet1)
  EC2Instance1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      ImageId: !Ref AMIInfo
      InstanceType: !Ref InstanceType
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet1
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref SecurityGroup
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            Encrypted: true
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref LaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt LaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EC2Instance1'

  EC2Instance2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      ImageId: !Ref AMIInfo
      InstanceType: !Ref InstanceType
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet1
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref SecurityGroup
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            Encrypted: true
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref LaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt LaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EC2Instance2'

  EC2Instance3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      ImageId: !Ref AMIInfo
      InstanceType: !Ref InstanceType
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet1
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref SecurityGroup
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            Encrypted: true
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref LaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt LaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EC2Instance3'

  EC2Instance4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      ImageId: !Ref AMIInfo
      InstanceType: !Ref InstanceType
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet1
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref SecurityGroup
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            Encrypted: true
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref LaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt LaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EC2Instance4'

  EC2Instance5:

Description: CloudFormation template for a DynamoDB table with comprehensive CloudWatch alarms.

Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: TestTable
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table.

  DynamoDBTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table

        - AttributeName: USER_ID

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: PII Classification Scanner using S3 Access Point, Comprehend, and DynamoDB

Parameters:
  ScannerFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: pii-scanner
    Description: Name of the Lambda function.
  S3AccessPointArn:
    Type: String
    Default: 'arn:aws:s3:us-east-1:123456789012:accesspoint/example-access-point'
    Description: ARN of the S3 Access Point to scan.
  ComprehendLanguageCode:
    Type: String
    Default: en
    Description: Language code for Comprehend (e.g., en, es).
  MaxFiles:
    Type: Number
    Default: 500
    Description: Maximum number of files to scan per invocation.
  LambdaMemory:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    Description: Lambda function memory in MB.
  LambdaTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 600
    Description: Lambda function timeout in seconds.
  SampleSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5000
    Description: Maximum bytes to read per file chunk (also chunk size).
  MaxChunks:
    Type: Number
    Default: 10
    Description: Maximum number of chunks to process per file (for chunking).
  VpcId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: VPC ID for Lambda deployment (leave empty for outside VPC).
  SubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: Subnet IDs for Lambda (comma-separated, required if VpcId set).
  SecurityGroupId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Security group ID for Lambda (required if VpcId set).
  RouteTableIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: Route table IDs for S3 Gateway endpoint (comma-separated, required if CreateEndpoints true).
  CreateEndpoints:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Whether to create VPC endpoints (set false if endpoints already exist).
  DynamoDBTableName:
    Type: String
    Default: PiiClassificationReports
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table for classification reports.
  SNSTopicArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional SNS topic ARN for notifications.

Conditions:
  HasVpc: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VpcId, '']]
  HasSecurityGroup: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SecurityGroupId, '']]
  HasSnsTopic: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SNSTopicArn, '']]
  CreateEndpoints: !And
    - Condition: HasVpc
    - !Equals [!Ref CreateEndpoints, 'true']

Resources:
  ReportTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref DynamoDBTableName
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: FileKey
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: ScannedAt
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: FileKey
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: ScannedAt
          KeyType: RANGE
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true

  LambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PiiScannerPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Ref S3AccessPointArn
                  - !Sub "${S3AccessPointArn}/object/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: comprehend:DetectPiiEntities
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: dynamodb:PutItem
                Resource: !GetAtt ReportTable.Arn
              - !If
                - HasSnsTopic
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - sns:Publish
                  Resource: !Ref SNSTopicArn
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'

  PiiScannerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref ScannerFunctionName
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaRole.Arn
      MemorySize: !Ref LambdaMemory
      Timeout: !Ref LambdaTimeout
      Environment:
        Variables:
          ACCESS_POINT_ARN: !Ref S3AccessPointArn
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref DynamoDBTableName
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN: !Ref SNSTopicArn
          LANGUAGE_CODE: !Ref ComprehendLanguageCode
          MAX_FILES: !Ref MaxFiles
          SAMPLE_SIZE: !Ref SampleSize
          MAX_CHUNKS: !Ref MaxChunks
      VpcConfig: !If
        - HasVpc
        - SecurityGroupIds: !If [HasSecurityGroup, [!Ref SecurityGroupId], !Ref AWS::NoValue]
          SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3, os, json, logging, time, random, math
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          s3 = boto3.client('s3')
          comprehend = boto3.client('comprehend')
          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          sns = boto3.client('sns')

          access_point_arn = os.environ['ACCESS_POINT_ARN']
          table_name = os.environ['TABLE_NAME']
          sns_topic_arn = os.environ.get('SNS_TOPIC_ARN', '')
          language_code = os.environ.get('LANGUAGE_CODE', 'en')
          max_files = int(os.environ.get('MAX_FILES', 500))
          sample_size = int(os.environ.get('SAMPLE_SIZE', 5000))
          max_chunks = int(os.environ.get('MAX_CHUNKS', 10))

          def process_object(key, table):
              try:
                  file_size = 0
                  chunks_processed = 0
                  total_pii = []
                  continuation_token = None

                  while chunks_processed < max_chunks:
                      range_start = chunks_processed * sample_size
                      range_end = (chunks_processed + 1) * sample_size - 1
                      try:
                          response = s3.get_object(
                              Bucket=access_point_arn,
                              Key=key,
                              Range=f'bytes={range_start}-{range_end}'
                          )
                          data = response['Body'].read().decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
                          if not data:
                              break
                      except (ClientError, Exception) as e:
                          logger.error(f"Error reading {key} chunk {chunks_processed}: {str(e)}")
                          break

                      try:
                          pii_result = comprehend.detect_pii_entities(
                              Text=data,
                              LanguageCode=language_code
                          )
                          total_pii.extend(pii_result.get('Entities', []))
                      except Exception as e:
                          logger.error(f"Comprehend error on {key} chunk {chunks_processed}: {str(e)}")

                      chunks_processed += 1

                  if total_pii:
                      item = {
                          'FileKey': key,
                          'ScannedAt': time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime()),
                          'PiiEntities': [json.dumps(e, default=str) for e in total_pii],
                          'ChunksProcessed': str(chunks_processed),
                          'SampleSize': str(sample_size)
                      }
                      try:
                          table.put_item(Item=item)
                          return f"Found {len(total_pii)} PII entities in {key}"
                      except Exception as e:
                          logger.error(f"DynamoDB put_item error for {key}: {str(e)}")
                  else:
                      return f"No PII entities found in {key}"
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(f"Unexpected error processing {key}: {str(e)}")
                  return None

          def handler(event, context):
              table = dynamodb.Table(table_name)
              scanned = 0
              results = []
              paginator = s3.get_paginator('list_objects_v2')
              page_iterator = paginator.paginate(Bucket=access_point_arn)

              try:
                  for page in page_iterator:
                      if 'Contents' in page:
                          for obj in page['Contents']:
                              if scanned >= max_files:
                                  break
                              key = obj['Key']
                              result = process_object(key, table)
                              if result:
                                  results.append(result)
                              scanned += 1
                      if scanned >= max_files:
                          break

                  summary = f"Scanned {scanned} files. Results: {len(results)} files had PII."
                  logger.info(summary)

                  if sns_topic_arn and results:
                      sns.publish(
                          TopicArn=sns_topic_arn,
                          Subject='PII Scan Complete',
                          Message=json.dumps({'scanned': scanned, 'files_with_pii': len(results), 'details': results}, default=str)
                      )

                  return {
                      'statusCode': 200,
                      'body': json.dumps({'scanned': scanned, 'files_with_pii': len(results)})
                  }
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(f"Handler error: {str(e)}")
                  raise

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3"
      RouteTableIds: !Ref RouteTableIds
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway

  DynamoDBEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.dynamodb"
      SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
      SecurityGroupIds: !If [HasSecurityGroup, [!Ref SecurityGroupId], !Ref AWS::NoValue]
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  ComprehendEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.comprehend"
      SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
      SecurityGroupIds: !If [HasSecurityGroup, [!Ref SecurityGroupId], !Ref AWS::NoValue]
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  SNSEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sns"
      SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
      SecurityGroupIds: !If [HasSecurityGroup, [!Ref SecurityGroupId], !Ref AWS::NoValue]
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

Outputs:
  ScannerFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the PII scanner Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt PiiScannerFunction.Arn
  ReportTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table storing classification reports
    Value: !Ref ReportTable
  ExampleInvocationCommand:
    Description: CLI command to invoke the scanner function
    Value: !Sub "aws lambda invoke --function-name ${ScannerFunctionName} --payload {} response.json"
