AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'PiBot Cognito Authentication Setup - Main Web App and IoT Provisioning'

Resources:

  # --------------------------------------------
  # Main Web Application Setup
  # --------------------------------------------

  MainAppUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: PiBotMainAppUserPool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: false

  MainAppUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: PiBotMainAppClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref MainAppUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  MainAppIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: PiBotMainAppIdentityPool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ProviderName: !GetAtt MainAppUserPool.ProviderName
          ClientId: !Ref MainAppUserPoolClient

  MainAppAuthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud': !Ref MainAppIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr': authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PiBotMainAppAuthPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:Connect
                  - iot:Publish
                  - iot:Subscribe
                  - iot:Receive
                  - iot:GetThingShadow
                  - iot:UpdateThingShadow
                  - iot:DescribeThing
                  - iot:ListThings
                  - iot:DescribeEndpoint
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesisvideo:PutMedia
                  - kinesisvideo:GetMedia
                  - kinesisvideo:GetDataEndpoint
                  - kinesisvideo:DescribeStream
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rekognition:DetectLabels
                  - rekognition:DetectModerationLabels
                  - rekognition:RecognizeCelebrities
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-sync:*
                  - cognito-identity:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                Resource: '*'

  MainAppUnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud': !Ref MainAppIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr': unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PiBotMainAppUnauthPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:DescribeEndpoint
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-sync:*
                  - cognito-identity:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                Resource: '*'

  MainAppIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref MainAppIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt MainAppAuthenticatedRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt MainAppUnauthenticatedRole.Arn

  # --------------------------------------------
  # IoT Trusted User Provisioning Setup
  # --------------------------------------------

  IoTProvisioningUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: PiBotIoTProvisioningUserPool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: false

  IoTProvisioningUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: PiBotIoTProvisioningClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref IoTProvisioningUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  IoTProvisioningIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: PiBotIoTProvisioningIdentityPool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ProviderName: !GetAtt IoTProvisioningUserPool.ProviderName
          ClientId: !Ref IoTProvisioningUserPoolClient

  IoTProvisioningAuthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud': !Ref IoTProvisioningIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr': authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PiBotIoTProvisioningAuthPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:CreateKeysAndCertificate
                  - iot:RegisterThing
                  - iot:DescribeThing
                  - iot:AttachPolicy
                  - iot:AttachThingPrincipal
                  - iot:UpdateCertificate
                  - iot:CreatePolicy
                  - iot:ListPolicies
                  - iot:ListThingPrincipals
                Resource: '*'

  IoTProvisioningUnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud': !Ref IoTProvisioningIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr': unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PiBotIoTProvisioningUnauthPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:DescribeEndpoint
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-sync:*
                  - cognito-identity:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                Resource: '*'

  IoTProvisioningIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref IoTProvisioningIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt IoTProvisioningAuthenticatedRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt IoTProvisioningUnauthenticatedRole.Arn

Outputs:

  MainAppIdentityPoolId:
    Description: Main Web Application Cognito Identity Pool ID
    Value: !Ref MainAppIdentityPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-MainAppIdentityPoolId"

  MainAppUserPoolId:
    Description: Main Web Application Cognito User Pool ID
    Value: !Ref MainAppUserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-MainAppUserPoolId"

  MainAppClientId:
    Description: Main Web Application Cognito User Pool Client ID
    Value: !Ref MainAppUserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-MainAppClientId"

  IoTProvisioningIdentityPoolId:
    Description: IoT Provisioning Cognito Identity Pool ID
    Value: !Ref IoTProvisioningIdentityPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-IoTProvisioningIdentityPoolId"

  IoTProvisioningUserPoolId:
    Description: IoT Provisioning Cognito User Pool ID
    Value: !Ref IoTProvisioningUserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-IoTProvisioningUserPoolId"

  IoTProvisioningClientId:
    Description: IoT Provisioning Cognito User Pool Client ID
    Value: !Ref IoTProvisioningUserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-IoTProvisioningClientId"

I see the Remediator's guidance. After 14 iterations converging toward the same DNS validation bottleneck in a greenfield deployment, switching to EMAIL validation for ACM certificates eliminates the root cause entirely. This is a pragmatic architectural decision for reliability.

I will apply all four fix objectives: switch certificates to EMAIL validation, remove the entire Lambda/custom-resource infrastructure, clean up distribution `DependsOn`, and delete the now-unused ACM validation placeholder parameters. The template will become far simpler and deployable in a single pass.

```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Production Route53 hosted zone for radiotopia.fm with comprehensive DNS records,
  including ACM certificates and CloudFront distributions for subdomains.
  NOTE: This stack MUST be deployed in us-east-1 because CloudFront and its
  associated WAF (CLOUDFRONT scope) require that region.

Parameters:
  SPFValue:
    Type: String
    Default: "v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com include:servers.mcsv.net include:spf.mandrillapp.com ~all"
    Description: SPF record value (update with actual verification tokens)
  DMARCValue:
    Type: String
    Default: "v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:dmarc-reports@radiotopia.fm; ruf=mailto:forensic@radiotopia.fm"
    Description: DMARC record value
  MXPriority:
    Type: Number
    Default: 10
  MXExchange:
    Type: String
    Default: "aspmx.l.google.com"
    Description: Mail exchange hostname
  ApexAIPs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: "203.0.113.1,203.0.113.2"
    Description: Static IP addresses for the apex A records
  WWWCNAMETarget:
    Type: String
    Default: "radiotopia.fm"
    Description: Target hostname for www CNAME alias
  FeedSubdomainCNAME:
    Type: String
    Default: "feedproxy.example.com"
    Description: Target for the podcast feed CNAME record
  EventSubdomainIP:
    Type: String
    Default: "203.0.113.10"
    Description: IP address for the event subdomain A record
  # Third‑party service DNS record parameters
  GoogleWorkspaceVerificationTXT:
    Type: String
    Default: "google-site-verification=placeholder"
    Description: TXT verification record for Google Workspace
  GoogleWorkspaceDKIMCNAMEName:
    Type: String
    Default: "google._domainkey.radiotopia.fm."
  GoogleWorkspaceDKIMCNAMEValue:
    Type: String
    Default: "google.domainkey.d1.placeholder.com."
  MailchimpCNAMEName:
    Type: String
    Default: "kb._domainkey.radiotopia.fm."
  MailchimpCNAMEValue:
    Type: String
    Default: "dkim.mcsv.net."
  ZendeskVerificationTXT:
    Type: String
    Default: "zendesk-verification=placeholder"
  ZendeskCNAMEName:
    Type: String
    Default: "zendesk.radiotopia.fm."
  ZendeskCNAMEValue:
    Type: String
    Default: "zendesk.com."
  SquarespaceVerificationTXT:
    Type: String
    Default: "squarespace-verification=placeholder"
  SquarespaceCNAMEName:
    Type: String
    Default: "www.radiotopia.fm."
  SquarespaceCNAMEValue:
    Type: String
    Default: "proxy.squarespace.com."
  CampaignMonitorVerificationTXT:
    Type: String
    Default: "campaignmonitor-verification=placeholder"
  CampaignMonitorCNAMEName:
    Type: String
    Default: "createsend.radiotopia.fm."
  CampaignMonitorCNAMEValue:
    Type: String
    Default: "createsend.com."

Resources:
  # Public Hosted Zone
  HostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: radiotopia.fm.
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: Production public hosted zone for radiotopia.fm

  # WAFv2 Web ACL for CloudFront
  WebACL:
    Type: AWS::WAFv2::WebACL
    Properties:
      Name: radiotopia-fm-waf
      Scope: CLOUDFRONT
      DefaultAction:
        Allow: {}
      Rules:
        - Name: AWS-AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
          Priority: 0
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSetMetric
      VisibilityConfig:
        SampledRequestsEnabled: true
        CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
        MetricName: radiotopia-fm-waf-metric

  # ACM Certificates for CloudFront‑backed subdomains (EMAIL validation – no DNS records required)
  MediaCertificate:
    Type: AWS::CertificateManager::Certificate
    Properties:
      DomainName: media.radiotopia.fm
      ValidationMethod: EMAIL
      DomainValidationOptions:
        - DomainName: media.radiotopia.fm
          ValidationDomain: radiotopia.fm

  TowerCertificate:
    Type: AWS::CertificateManager::Certificate
    Properties:
      DomainName: tower.radiotopia.fm
      ValidationMethod: EMAIL
      DomainValidationOptions:
        - DomainName: tower.radiotopia.fm
          ValidationDomain: radiotopia.fm

  V1Certificate:
    Type: AWS::CertificateManager::Certificate
    Properties:
      DomainName: v1.radiotopia.fm
      ValidationMethod: EMAIL
      DomainValidationOptions:
        - DomainName: v1.radiotopia.fm
          ValidationDomain: radiotopia.fm

  PlusCertificate:
    Type: AWS::CertificateManager::Certificate
    Properties:
      DomainName: plus.radiotopia.fm
      ValidationMethod: EMAIL
      DomainValidationOptions:
        - DomainName: plus.radiotopia.fm
          ValidationDomain: radiotopia.fm

  # CloudFront Distributions (implicit dependency via Ref on certificates)
  MediaDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Aliases:
          - media.radiotopia.fm
        Origins:
          - Id: DefaultOrigin
            DomainName: origin.radiotopia.fm
            CustomOriginConfig:
              OriginProtocolPolicy: https-only
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: DefaultOrigin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          CachePolicyId: 4135ea2d-6df8-44a3-9df3-4b5a84be39ad
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
        ViewerCertificate:
          AcmCertificateArn: !Ref MediaCertificate
          SslSupportMethod: sni-only
          MinimumProtocolVersion: TLSv1.2_2021
        WebACLId: !GetAtt WebACL.Arn
        Enabled: true
        Comment: CloudFront distribution for media.radiotopia.fm

  TowerDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Aliases:
          - tower.radiotopia.fm
        Origins:
          - Id: DefaultOrigin
            DomainName: origin.radiotopia.fm
            CustomOriginConfig:
              OriginProtocolPolicy: https-only
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: DefaultOrigin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          CachePolicyId: 4135ea2d-6df8-44a3-9df3-4b5a84be39ad
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
        ViewerCertificate:
          AcmCertificateArn: !Ref TowerCertificate
          SslSupportMethod: sni-only
          MinimumProtocolVersion: TLSv1.2_2021
        WebACLId: !GetAtt WebACL.Arn

  V1Distribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Aliases:

        Origins:
          - Id: DefaultOrigin
            DomainName: origin.radiotopia.fm
            CustomOriginConfig:
              OriginProtocolPolicy: https-only
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: DefaultOrigin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          CachePolicyId: 4135ea2d-6df8-44a3-9df3-4b5a84be39ad

          MinimumProtocolVersion: TLSv1.2_2021
        WebACLId: !GetAtt WebACL.Arn
        Enabled: true
        Comment: CloudFront distribution for v1.radiotopia.fm

  PlusDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Aliases:
          - plus.radiotopia.fm
        Origins:
          - Id: DefaultOrigin
            DomainName: origin.radiotopia.fm
            CustomOriginConfig:
              OriginProtocolPolicy: https-only
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: DefaultOrigin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          CachePolicyId: 4135ea2d-6df8-44a3-9df3-4b5a84be39ad
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET

        ViewerCertificate:
          AcmCertificateArn: !Ref PlusCertificate
          SslSupportMethod: sni-only
          MinimumProtocolVersion: TLSv1.2_2021
        WebACLId: !GetAtt WebACL.Arn
        Enabled: true
        Comment: CloudFront distribution for plus.radiotopia.fm

  # DNS Record Set Group (implicit dependencies via Ref/GetAtt)
  DNSRecords:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSetGroup
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Comment: All DNS records for radiotopia.fm
      RecordSets:
        # Apex SPF TXT record
        - Name: radiotopia.fm.

        - Name: radiotopia.fm.

          TTL: 300

            - !Ref DMARCValue

        - Name: tower.radiotopia.fm.

        - Name: plus.radiotopia.fm.

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway for MCP integration (protein variant effect prediction)

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: protein-engineering
    Description: Project name used to derive resource names and SSM parameter paths.
  GatewayDescription:
    Type: String
    Default: Gateway for MCP-based protein variant effect prediction agent
    Description: Description for the AgentCore Gateway.
  GatewayName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional custom name for the gateway. If left blank, a name will be auto-generated based on the project name.

Conditions:
  IsGatewayNameBlank: !Equals [!Ref GatewayName, '']

Resources:
  # IAM Role for Lambda execution
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  # Placeholder Lambda function
  PlaceholderFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          def handler(event, context):
              return {"statusCode": 200, "body": "ok"}

  # IAM Role for Bedrock AgentCore service
  BedrockAgentCoreRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaInvokePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: !GetAtt PlaceholderFunction.Arn

  # SSM Parameter to store the newly created IAM Role ARN
  BedrockAgentCoreRoleArnParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Type: String
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/bedrock-agentcore-role-arn'
      Value: !GetAtt BedrockAgentCoreRole.Arn
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  # Cognito User Pool for JWT authentication
  CognitoUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-pool'

  # Cognito User Pool Client
  CognitoUserPoolClient:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Private VPC infrastructure with ALB subnets, Lambda subnet, optional NAT Gateway, KMS key, and S3 bucket."

Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/16"
    Description: "CIDR block for the VPC."
  ALBSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.1.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR block for the first ALB private subnet."
  ALBSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.2.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR block for the second ALB private subnet (different AZ)."
  LambdaSubnetCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.3.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR block for the Lambda private subnet."
  PublicSubnetCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.254.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR block for the public subnet used by the NAT Gateway."
  EnableNATGateway:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Default: "false"
    Description: "Set to 'true' to create a NAT Gateway for internet egress."
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: "Dev"
    Description: "Environment name for tagging."
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: "myapp"
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-z0-9-]+$"
    Description: "Project name for tagging. Must be lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens."

Conditions:
  CreateNatGateway: !Equals [!Ref EnableNATGateway, "true"]

Resources:
  # VPC
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-vpc"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  # Internet Gateway
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-igw"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Private subnets
  ALBSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref ALBSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-alb-subnet-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  ALBSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref ALBSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-alb-subnet-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  LambdaSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref LambdaSubnetCIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-lambda-subnet"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  # Public subnet (conditional)
  PublicSubnet:
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-public-subnet"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  # Public route table (conditional)
  PublicRouteTable:
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-public-rt"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  PublicRoute:
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # Elastic IP and NAT Gateway (conditional)
  NatEIP:
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-nat-eip"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  NatGateway:
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-nat-gw"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  # Private route table and routes
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-private-rt"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  PrivateRouteToNat:
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  # Associate private subnets to private route table
  ALBSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref ALBSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  ALBSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref ALBSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  LambdaSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref LambdaSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # KMS Key
  ArtifactBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: "KMS key for encrypting artifact storage bucket"
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Id: "key-policy"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "Enable IAM User Permissions"
            Effect: "Allow"
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-artifact-key"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  ArtifactBucketKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${ProjectName}-artifact-key"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref ArtifactBucketKey

  # S3 Bucket
  ArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-artifacts-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt ArtifactBucketKey.Arn
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-artifact-bucket"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  # Bucket Policy to enforce HTTPS
  ArtifactBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ArtifactBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "DenyInsecureConnections"
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !Sub "${ArtifactBucket.Arn}/*"
              - !GetAtt ArtifactBucket.Arn
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: false

Outputs:
  VPCId:
    Description: "VPC ID"
    Value: !Ref VPC
  ALBSubnet1:
    Description: "First ALB Subnet ID"
    Value: !Ref ALBSubnet1
  ALBSubnet2:
    Description: "Second ALB Subnet ID"
    Value: !Ref ALBSubnet2
  LambdaSubnet:
    Description: "Lambda Subnet ID"
    Value: !Ref LambdaSubnet
  PublicSubnet:
    Description: "Public Subnet ID (only if NAT enabled)"
    Value: !If [CreateNatGateway, !Ref PublicSubnet, "N/A"]
  NatGatewayId:
    Description: "NAT Gateway ID (only if enabled)"
    Value: !If [CreateNatGateway, !Ref NatGateway, "N/A"]
  ArtifactBucketName:
    Description: "S3 Artifact Bucket Name"
    Value: !Ref ArtifactBucket
  KmsKeyId:
    Description: "KMS Key ID"
    Value: !Ref ArtifactBucketKey

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Step Functions state machine with two REST APIs (GET and POST) to start executions.

Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: Name of the API Gateway stage for both APIs

Resources:
  # Step Functions State Machine
  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      Definition:
        Comment: Simple two-step pass workflow
        StartAt: GetRequestPass
        States:
          GetRequestPass:
            Type: Pass
            Next: ProcessPass
          ProcessPass:
            Type: Pass
            End: true
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn

  StateMachineExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /

  # GET REST API
  GetApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: GetApi
      Description: API Gateway exposing GET endpoint to start state machine execution
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  GetApiMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetApi
      ResourceId: !GetAtt GetApi.RootResourceId
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Credentials: !GetAtt GetApiRole.Arn
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: >
            {
              "stateMachineArn": "{{ stateMachineArn }}",
              "input": "$input.json('$')"
            }
        Uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution"
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ""
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200

  GetApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - GetApiMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetApi
      StageName: !Ref StageName

  GetApiRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:StartExecution
                Resource: !GetAtt StateMachine.Arn

  # POST REST API
  PostApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: PostApi
      Description: API Gateway exposing POST endpoint to start state machine execution
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  PostApiMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostApi
      ResourceId: !GetAtt PostApi.RootResourceId
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Credentials: !GetAtt PostApiRole.Arn
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: >
            {
              "stateMachineArn": "{{ stateMachineArn }}",
              "input": "$input.json('$')"
            }
        Uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution"
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ""
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200

  PostApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - PostApiMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostApi
      StageName: !Ref StageName

  PostApiRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:StartExecution
                Resource: !GetAtt StateMachine.Arn

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions state machine
    Value: !Ref StateMachine
  GetApiEndpoint:
    Description: GET API endpoint URL
    Value: !Sub "https://${GetApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}"
  PostApiEndpoint:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Cognito user pool and related resources for researchapp/AgentCore'

Parameters:
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateGatewayPool
    Description: Name of the Cognito user pool.
  MachineAppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateMachineClient
    Description: Name of the machine-to-machine client.
  WebAppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateWebClient
    Description: Name of the web application client.

Resources:
  # Primary User Pool
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7

  # User Pool Domain (required for domain URL)
  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Domain: !Sub "templategatewaypool-${AWS::AccountId}"

  # Admin group with higher precedence
  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: admin
      Description: Admin group with higher precedence
      Precedence: 10
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  # Customer group with lower precedence
  CustomerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: customer
      Description: Customer group with lower precedence
      Precedence: 5
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  # Resource Server
  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: resource-server
      Name: ResearchApp Resource Server
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access scope

  # Web application client (authorization code flow)
  WebAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref WebAppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - resource-server/read
      CallbackURLs:
        - http://localhost:8501/
        - https://example.com/auth/callback
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH

  # Machine-to-machine client (client credentials flow)
  MachineAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref MachineAppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - resource-server/read

  # Lambda role
  AddToCustomerGroupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cognito-add-user-to-group
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/${UserPool}"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "arn:aws:logs:*:*:*"

  # Lambda function (not wired as trigger)
  AddToCustomerGroupFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: AddToCustomerGroupFunction
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt AddToCustomerGroupRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          USER_POOL_ID: !Ref UserPool
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import os

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              client = boto3.client('cognito-idp')
              username = event.get('username')
              if not username:
                  raise ValueError('username is required')
              client.admin_add_user_to_group(
                  UserPoolId=os.environ['USER_POOL_ID'],
                  Username=username,
                  GroupName='customer'
              )
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'body': f'User {username} added to customer group'
              }

  # SSM Parameters under /app/researchapp/agentcore/
  UserPoolIdParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/user_pool_id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Cognito User Pool ID

  WebAppClientIdParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/client_id/web_app
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref WebAppClient
      Description: Web application client ID

  MachineAppClientIdParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/client_id/machine_app
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref MachineAppClient
      Description: Machine-to-machine client ID

  MachineAppClientSecretParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/client_secret/machine_app
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt MachineAppClient.ClientSecret
      Description: Machine-to-machine client secret

  OAuthScopeParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/oauth_scope
      Type: String
      Value: "resource-server/read"
      Description: OAuth scope for read access

  CognitoDomainParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/cognito_domain
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com"
      Description: Cognito hosted UI domain

  OidcDiscoveryUrlParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/oidc_discovery_url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration"
      Description: OIDC discovery URL

  TokenUrlParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/token_url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token"
      Description: Token endpoint URL

  AuthorizeUrlParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/authorize_url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/authorize"
      Description: Authorization endpoint URL

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template for MediaPackage live streaming channel with HLS and DASH origin endpoints, optional live-to-VOD and VOD workflows.'

Parameters:
  Prefix:
    Type: String
    Default: myprefix
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters, hyphens, or underscores.
    Description: Logical name prefix for all resources.
  OutputType:
    Type: String
    Default: APPLE_HLS
    AllowedValues:
      - APPLE_HLS
      - ISO_DASH
      - ALL
    Description: Desired output type for the origin endpoints.
  ManifestName:
    Type: String
    Default: index
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$'
    Description: Manifest name for the endpoints.
  HlsSegmentDurationSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 6
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 30
    Description: Segment duration in seconds for the HLS endpoint.
  StartoverWindowSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 0
    MinValue: 0
    MaxValue: 604800
    Description: Startover window in seconds for the endpoints.
  ArchiveBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid S3 bucket name or empty.
    Description: Bucket name for live-to-VOD archive storage. If provided, endpoint origination is set to DENY.
  VodSourceBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid S3 bucket name or empty.
    Description: Bucket name for VOD source content. If provided, VOD workflows are created.
  Env:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment tag value.

Conditions:
  IsArchiveBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ArchiveBucket, '']]
  IsVodSourceBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VodSourceBucket, '']]
  HasS3Buckets: !Or [!Condition IsArchiveBucket, !Condition IsVodSourceBucket]
  OutputTypeIsHls: !Or [!Equals [!Ref OutputType, APPLE_HLS], !Equals [!Ref OutputType, ALL]]
  OutputTypeIsDash: !Or [!Equals [!Ref OutputType, ISO_DASH], !Equals [!Ref OutputType, ALL]]

  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      Tags:
        - Key: Env
          Value: !Ref Env

  MediaPackageChannel:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::Channel
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub '${Prefix} live channel'
      Id: !Sub '${Prefix}-channel'
      Tags:
        - Key: Env
          Value: !Ref Env

  MediaPackageHlsEndpoint:
    Condition: OutputTypeIsHls
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Properties:
      ChannelId: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
      Description: !Sub '${Prefix} HLS endpoint'
      Id: !Sub '${Prefix}-hls-endpoint'
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      Origination: !If [IsArchiveBucket, DENY, ALLOW]
      HlsPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: !Ref HlsSegmentDurationSeconds
        AdMarkers: NONE
        AdsOnDeliveryRestrictions: NONE
        IncludeIframeOnlyStream: false
        StreamSelection:
          MaxVideoBitsPerSecond: 2147483647
          MinVideoBitsPerSecond: 0
          StreamOrder: ORIGINAL
      Tags:
        - Key: Env
          Value: !Ref Env

  MediaPackageDashEndpoint:
    Condition: OutputTypeIsDash
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Properties:
      ChannelId: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
      Description: !Sub '${Prefix} DASH endpoint'
      Id: !Sub '${Prefix}-dash-endpoint'
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      Origination: !If [IsArchiveBucket, DENY, ALLOW]
      DashPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: 2
        AdsOnDeliveryRestrictions: NONE
        PeriodTriggers: []
        Profile: NONE
        StreamSelection:
          MaxVideoBitsPerSecond: 2147483647
          MinVideoBitsPerSecond: 0
          StreamOrder: ORIGINAL
      Tags:
        - Key: Env
          Value: !Ref Env

  ArchiveBucketResource:
    Condition: IsArchiveBucket
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Ref ArchiveBucket
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref KmsKey
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Env
          Value: !Ref Env

  VodSourceBucketResource:
    Condition: IsVodSourceBucket
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Ref VodSourceBucket
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref KmsKey
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Env
          Value: !Ref Env

  MediaPackageRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: mediapackage.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - !If
          - HasS3Buckets
          - PolicyName: MediaPackageS3Access
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - !If
                  - IsArchiveBucket
                  - Effect: Allow
                    Action:
                      - s3:GetObject
                      - s3:PutObject
                      - s3:ListBucket
                    Resource:
                      - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ArchiveBucket}'
                      - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ArchiveBucket}/*'
                  - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
                - !If
                  - IsVodSourceBucket
                  - Effect: Allow
                    Action:
                      - s3:GetObject
                      - s3:PutObject
                      - s3:ListBucket
                    Resource:
                      - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${VodSourceBucket}'
                      - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${VodSourceBucket}/*'
                  - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Tags:
        - Key: Env
          Value: !Ref Env

  VodPackagingGroup:
    Condition: IsVodSourceBucket
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::PackagingGroup
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${Prefix}-vod-packaging-group'
      Tags:
        - Key: Env
          Value: !Ref Env

  VodAsset:
    Condition: IsVodSourceBucket
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::Asset
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${Prefix}-vod-asset'
      PackagingGroupId: !Ref VodPackagingGroup
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${VodSourceBucket}'
      SourceRoleArn: !GetAtt MediaPackageRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Env
          Value: !Ref Env

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template to create a DynamoDB table with configurable keys, billing mode, point-in-time recovery, optional customer-managed KMS encryption, and optional CloudWatch alarms for throttling and system errors publishing to an SNS topic."

Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: "MyTable"
    Description: "Name of the DynamoDB table."

  PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: "id"
    Description: "Name of the partition key."

  PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: "S"
    AllowedValues: ["S", "N", "B"]
    Description: "Data type of the partition key (S=String, N=Number, B=Binary)."

  EnableSortKey:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: "Whether to include a sort key."

  SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: "sk"
    Description: "Name of the sort key (used only if EnableSortKey is true)."

  SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: "N"
    AllowedValues: ["S", "N", "B"]
    Description: "Data type of the sort key (used only if EnableSortKey is true)."

  BillingMode:
    Type: String
    Default: "PROVISIONED"
    AllowedValues: ["PROVISIONED", "PAY_PER_REQUEST"]
    Description: "Billing mode for the table."

  ReadCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 100000
    Description: "Provisioned read capacity units (used only if BillingMode is PROVISIONED)."

  WriteCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 100000
    Description: "Provisioned write capacity units (used only if BillingMode is PROVISIONED)."

  EnablePITR:
    Type: String
    Default: "true"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: "Enable point-in-time recovery for the table."

  EnableSSE:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: "Enable server-side encryption using a customer-managed KMS key."

  EnableAlarms:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: "Enable CloudWatch alarms for throttled requests and system errors, publishing to a new SNS topic."

Conditions:
  IsProvisioned: !Equals [!Ref BillingMode, "PROVISIONED"]
  HasSortKey: !Equals [!Ref EnableSortKey, "true"]
  EnablePITRCond: !Equals [!Ref EnablePITR, "true"]
  EnableSSECond: !Equals [!Ref EnableSSE, "true"]
  EnableAlarmsCond: !Equals [!Ref EnableAlarms, "true"]

Resources:
  DynamoDBTable:
    Type: "AWS::DynamoDB::Table"
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref TableName
      BillingMode: !If [IsProvisioned, "PROVISIONED", "PAY_PER_REQUEST"]
      ProvisionedThroughput: !If
        - IsProvisioned
        - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadCapacityUnits
          WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteCapacityUnits
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      AttributeDefinitions: !If
        - HasSortKey
        - - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref SortKeyType
        - - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
      KeySchema: !If
        - HasSortKey
        - - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
            KeyType: HASH
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            KeyType: RANGE
        - - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
            KeyType: HASH
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification: !If
        - EnablePITRCond
        - PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      SSESpecification: !If
        - EnableSSECond
        - SSEEnabled: true
          SSEType: "KMS"
          KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"

  KmsKey:
    Type: "AWS::KMS::Key"
    Condition: EnableSSECond
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "Customer-managed KMS key for DynamoDB table ${TableName}"
      Enabled: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: Allow DynamoDB to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "dynamodb.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - "kms:Encrypt"
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
            Resource: "*"

  SnsTopic:
    Type: "AWS::SNS::Topic"
    Condition: EnableAlarmsCond
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub "DynamoDB-${TableName}-Alarms"
      TopicName: !Sub "DynamoDB-${TableName}-Alarms"
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Sub "arn:aws:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alias/aws/sns"

  AlarmThrottledRequests:
    Type: "AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm"
    Condition: EnableAlarmsCond
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${TableName}-ThrottledRequests"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when DynamoDB table experiences throttled requests."
      Namespace: "AWS/DynamoDB"
      MetricName: "ThrottledRequests"
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SnsTopic

  AlarmSystemErrors:
    Type: "AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm"
    Condition: EnableAlarmsCond
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${TableName}-SystemErrors"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when DynamoDB table experiences system errors."
      Namespace: "AWS/DynamoDB"
      MetricName: "SystemErrors"
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SnsTopic

Outputs:
  TableName:
    Description: "Name of the DynamoDB table."
    Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable

  TableArn:
    Description: "ARN of the DynamoDB table."
    Value: !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn

  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: "ARN of the customer-managed KMS key (if created)."
    Value: !If [EnableSSECond, !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn, ""]

  SnsTopicArn:
    Description: "ARN of the SNS topic for alarms (if created)."
    Value: !If [EnableAlarmsCond, !Ref SnsTopic, ""]

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: EC2 Image Builder pipeline for Amazon Linux 2023 AMIs with Docker, Python packages, and organization sharing.

Parameters:
  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: "^o-[a-z0-9]{10,32}$"
    Default: "o-0000000000"
    Description: AWS Organization ID for sharing AMIs.
  ImageVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: "1.0.0"
    Description: Version for the image recipes.
  RootVolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 32
    Description: Root volume size in GB.
  ParentImageParamX86:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>
    Default: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
    Description: SSM parameter for x86 AL2023 AMI ID.
  ParentImageParamArm64:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>
    Default: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-arm64
    Description: SSM parameter for arm64 AL2023 AMI ID.
  InstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: "t3.micro"
    Description: Instance type for the build instance.
  DistributionRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: "us-east-1"
    Description: Region for AMI distribution.

Resources:
  # Networking
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vpc"

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-igw"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet"

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet"

  NatEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP.AllocationId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-natgw"

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-rt"

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-rt"

  PrivateDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Image Builder build instance
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-sg"

  # IAM Role and Instance Profile
  ImageBuilderRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
                - imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderLogsAndS3
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt LoggingBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub "${LoggingBucket.Arn}/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt ImageBuilderKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-role"

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderRole

  # KMS Key for S3 bucket encryption
  ImageBuilderKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable root account administration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action:
              - kms:*
            Resource: "*"
      Enabled: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT

  # S3 Bucket for logs
  LoggingBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-logs-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref ImageBuilderKmsKey
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-logs"

  LoggingBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref LoggingBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub "${LoggingBucket.Arn}/*"

  # Components
  SoftwareInstallComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-software-install"
      Platform: Linux
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Description: Installs Docker, Docker Compose, Python packages, configures SSM sudo.
      ChangeDescription: Initial version
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Data: |
        name: SoftwareInstall
        description: Install Docker, Docker Compose, Python packages, enable SSM sudo
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: InstallDocker
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo dnf install -y docker
              - name: StartDocker
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo systemctl enable docker
                    - sudo systemctl start docker
              - name: InstallDockerCompose
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo curl -L "https://github.com/docker/compose/releases/latest/download/docker-compose-$(uname -s)-$(uname -m)" -o /usr/local/bin/docker-compose
                    - sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/docker-compose
              - name: InstallPythonPackages
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - pip3 install --upgrade pip
                    - pip3 install synapseclient pandas pysftp
              - name: EnableSSMSudo
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      if ! grep -q "^ssm-user ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL" /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-agent-users; then
                        echo "ssm-user ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL" | sudo tee /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-agent-users
                        sudo chmod 440 /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-agent-users
                      fi
              - name: Cleanup
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo dnf clean all

  TestComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-test"
      Platform: Linux
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Description: Validates Docker Compose and Python imports.
      ChangeDescription: Initial version
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Data: |
        name: Test
        description: Test Docker Compose and Python packages
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: validate
            steps:
              - name: TestDockerCompose
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - docker-compose --version
              - name: TestPythonImports
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - python3 -c "import synapseclient; import pandas; import pysftp; print('All imports successful')"

  # Image Recipes
  X86ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-x86-recipe"
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: !Ref ParentImageParamX86
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref SoftwareInstallComponent
        - ComponentArn: !Ref TestComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

  Arm64ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-arm64-recipe"
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: !Ref ParentImageParamArm64
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref SoftwareInstallComponent
        - ComponentArn: !Ref TestComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

  # Infrastructure Configuration (uses private subnet)
  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-infra-config"
      Description: Shared infrastructure configuration
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - !Ref InstanceType
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref SecurityGroup
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      Logging:
        S3Logs:
          S3BucketName: !Ref LoggingBucket
          S3KeyPrefix: logs/
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

  # Distribution Configuration
  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-dist-config"
      Description: Distribution configuration with public and organization sharing
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref DistributionRegion
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: "{{ imagebuilder:outputImageName }}-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}"
            Description: Custom Amazon Linux 2023 AMI
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserGroups:
                - all
              OrganizationArns:
                - !Sub "arn:aws:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:organization/${OrganizationId}"
            AmiTags:
              StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

  # Image Pipelines (one per architecture)
  X86ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-x86-pipeline"
      Description: Pipeline to build Amazon Linux 2023 x86 AMI
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref X86ImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 60
      EnhancedImageMetadataEnabled: true
      Status: ENABLED
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

  Arm64ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-arm64-pipeline"
      Description: Pipeline to build Amazon Linux 2023 ARM64 AMI
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref Arm64ImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 60
      EnhancedImageMetadataEnabled: true
      Status: ENABLED
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

Outputs:
  X86ImagePipelineArn:
    Description: ARN of the x86 Image Builder pipeline
    Value: !Ref X86ImagePipeline
  Arm64ImagePipelineArn:
    Description: ARN of the arm64 Image Builder pipeline
    Value: !Ref Arm64ImagePipeline
  LoggingBucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket used for build logs
    Value: !Ref LoggingBucket
