AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Student Services Agent Infrastructure with Cognito and IAM roles'

Resources:
  # ---------- Shared base IAM managed policy ----------
  BaseManagedPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: student-services-base-policy
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - bedrock:InvokeModel
              - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/bedrock-agentcore/*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - xray:PutTraceSegments
              - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParametersByPath
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/student-services/*'

  # ---------- StudentServicesAgent (orchestrator) ----------
  StudentServicesAgentExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: StudentServicesAgentExecutionRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:agent/*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref BaseManagedPolicy

  # ---------- StudentServicesGateway (Cognito only, no execution role) ----------
  StudentServicesGatewayUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: StudentServicesGatewayUserPool
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 6
          RequireUppercase: false
          RequireLowercase: false
          RequireNumbers: false
          RequireSymbols: false
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true

  StudentServicesGatewayUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub 'student-services-gateway-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudentServicesGatewayUserPool

  StudentServicesGatewayResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: student-services-gateway
      Name: StudentServicesGatewayResourceServer
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudentServicesGatewayUserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to student services gateway

  StudentServicesGatewayClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: StudentServicesGatewayResourceServer
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ClientName: StudentServicesGatewayClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudentServicesGatewayUserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub 'student-services-gateway/read'
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  # ---------- CourseRegistration (execution role + Cognito) ----------
  CourseRegistrationDynamoDBFullManagedPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: course-registration-dynamodb-full
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: dynamodb:*
            Resource: "*"

  CourseRegistrationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: CourseRegistrationExecutionRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:agent/*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref BaseManagedPolicy
        - !Ref CourseRegistrationDynamoDBFullManagedPolicy

  CourseRegistrationUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: CourseRegistrationUserPool
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 6
          RequireUppercase: false
          RequireLowercase: false
          RequireNumbers: false
          RequireSymbols: false
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true

  CourseRegistrationUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub 'course-registration-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseRegistrationUserPool

  CourseRegistrationResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: course-registration
      Name: CourseRegistrationResourceServer
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseRegistrationUserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to course registration

  CourseRegistrationClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: CourseRegistrationResourceServer
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ClientName: CourseRegistrationClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseRegistrationUserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub 'course-registration/read'
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  # ---------- CourseCatalog (execution role + Cognito) ----------
  CourseCatalogExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: CourseCatalogExecutionRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:agent/*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref BaseManagedPolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: BedrockRetrievePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: bedrock:Retrieve
                Resource: "*"

  CourseCatalogUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: CourseCatalogUserPool
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 6
          RequireUppercase: false
          RequireLowercase: false
          RequireNumbers: false
          RequireSymbols: false
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true

  CourseCatalogUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub 'course-catalog-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseCatalogUserPool

  CourseCatalogResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: course-catalog
      Name: CourseCatalogResourceServer
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseCatalogUserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to course catalog

  CourseCatalogClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: CourseCatalogResourceServer
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ClientName: CourseCatalogClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseCatalogUserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub 'course-catalog/read'
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  # ---------- CourseReview (execution role + Cognito) ----------
  CourseReviewExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: CourseReviewExecutionRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:agent/*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref BaseManagedPolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBReadOnly
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource: "*"

  CourseReviewUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: CourseReviewUserPool
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 6
          RequireUppercase: false
          RequireLowercase: false
          RequireNumbers: false
          RequireSymbols: false
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true

  CourseReviewUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub 'course-review-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseReviewUserPool

  CourseReviewResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: course-review
      Name: CourseReviewResourceServer
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseReviewUserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to course reviews

  CourseReviewClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: CourseReviewResourceServer
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ClientName: CourseReviewClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseReviewUserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub 'course-review/read'
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  # ---------- LoanApplication (execution role + Cognito) ----------
  LoanApplicationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: LoanApplicationExecutionRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:agent/*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref BaseManagedPolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SageMakerInvokeEndpoint
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: sagemaker:InvokeEndpoint
                Resource: "*"

  LoanApplicationUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: LoanApplicationUserPool
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 6
          RequireUppercase: false
          RequireLowercase: false
          RequireNumbers: false
          RequireSymbols: false
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true

  LoanApplicationUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub 'loan-application-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref LoanApplicationUserPool

  LoanApplicationResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: loan-application
      Name: LoanApplicationResourceServer
      UserPoolId: !Ref LoanApplicationUserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to loan applications

  LoanApplicationClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: LoanApplicationResourceServer
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ClientName: LoanApplicationClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref LoanApplicationUserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub 'loan-application/read'
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark Section 3 - Log Monitoring Controls'

Resources:
  # 1. KMS Key
  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow SNS to use key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow CloudTrail to use key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow S3 to use key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'

  # 1b. KMS Key Alias
  KMSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/CloudTrailKey
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KMSKey

  # 2. SNS Topic (encrypted with KMS key)
  SNSTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey

  # 3. S3 Bucket for CloudTrail logs
  CloudTrailS3Bucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref KMSKey
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  CloudTrailS3BucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref CloudTrailS3Bucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudTrailWrite
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub '${CloudTrailS3Bucket.Arn}/AWSLogs/${AWS::AccountId}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                s3:x-amz-acl: bucket-owner-full-control
          - Sid: AllowCloudTrailAcl
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - s3:GetBucketAcl
            Resource: !Sub '${CloudTrailS3Bucket.Arn}'
          - Sid: AllowSSLRequestsOnly
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:*
            Resource:
              - !Sub '${CloudTrailS3Bucket.Arn}'
              - !Sub '${CloudTrailS3Bucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: false

  # 4. IAM Role for CloudTrail to write to CloudWatch Logs
  CloudTrailCloudWatchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudTrailCloudWatchPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn

  # 5. CloudTrail Trail
  CloudTrailTrail:
    Type: AWS::CloudTrail::Trail
    DependsOn: CloudTrailS3BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      S3BucketName: !Ref CloudTrailS3Bucket
      CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn
      CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt CloudTrailCloudWatchRole.Arn
      EnableLogFileValidation: true
      IsMultiRegionTrail: true
      IncludeGlobalServiceEvents: true
      IsLogging: true
      KMSKeyId: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn

  # 6. CloudWatch Logs Log Group
  CloudTrailLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: 365

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Metric Filters and Alarms (14 conditions)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  # 7. Unauthorized API Calls
  UnauthorizedApiCallsMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.errorCode = "*UnauthorizedOperation") || ($.errorCode = "AccessDenied*") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: '1'
          MetricNamespace: CISBenchmark
          MetricName: UnauthorizedApiCalls

  UnauthorizedApiCallsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: UnauthorizedApiCalls
      AlarmDescription: 'Alarm when unauthorized API calls are detected'
      MetricName: UnauthorizedApiCalls
      Namespace: CISBenchmark
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SNSTopic

  # 8. Console Sign-In Without MFA
  ConsoleSignInWithoutMFAMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = "ConsoleLogin") && ($.additionalEventData.MFAUsed != "Yes") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: '1'
          MetricNamespace: CISBenchmark
          MetricName: ConsoleSignInWithoutMFA

  ConsoleSignInWithoutMFAAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: ConsoleSignInWithoutMFA
      AlarmDescription: 'Alarm when console sign-in without MFA is detected'
      MetricName: ConsoleSignInWithoutMFA
      Namespace: CISBenchmark
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SNSTopic

  # 9. Root Account Usage
  RootAccountUsageMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.userIdentity.type = "Root" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: '1'
          MetricNamespace: CISBenchmark
          MetricName: RootAccountUsage

  RootAccountUsageAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RootAccountUsage
      AlarmDescription: 'Alarm when root account usage is detected'
      MetricName: RootAccountUsage
      Namespace: CISBenchmark
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SNSTopic

  # 10. IAM Policy Changes
  IAMPolicyChangesMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{($.eventSource = "iam.amazonaws.com") && (($.eventName = "DeleteGroupPolicy") || ($.eventName = "DeleteRolePolicy") || ($.eventName = "DeleteUserPolicy") || ($.eventName = "PutGroupPolicy") || ($.eventName = "PutRolePolicy") || ($.eventName = "PutUserPolicy") || ($.eventName = "CreatePolicy") || ($.eventName = "DeletePolicy") || ($.eventName = "CreatePolicyVersion") || ($.eventName = "DeletePolicyVersion") || ($.eventName = "AttachRolePolicy") || ($.eventName = "DetachRolePolicy") || ($.eventName = "AttachUserPolicy") || ($.eventName = "DetachUserPolicy") || ($.eventName = "AttachGroupPolicy") || ($.eventName = "DetachGroupPolicy"))}'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: '1'
          MetricNamespace: CISBenchmark
          MetricName: IAMPolicyChanges

  IAMPolicyChangesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: IAMPolicyChanges
      AlarmDescription: 'Alarm when IAM policy changes are detected'
      MetricName: IAMPolicyChanges
      Namespace: CISBenchmark
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SNSTopic

  # 11. CloudTrail Configuration Changes
  CloudTrailConfigurationChangesMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{($.eventSource = "cloudtrail.amazonaws.com") && (($.eventName = "UpdateTrail") || ($.eventName = "StopLogging") || ($.eventName = "StartLogging") || ($.eventName = "DeleteTrail"))}'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: '1'
          MetricNamespace: CISBenchmark
          MetricName: CloudTrailConfigurationChanges

  CloudTrailConfigurationChangesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: CloudTrailConfigurationChanges
      AlarmDescription: 'Alarm when CloudTrail configuration changes are detected'
      MetricName: CloudTrailConfigurationChanges
      Namespace: CISBenchmark
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SNSTopic

  # 12. Console Login Failures
  ConsoleLoginFailuresMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = "ConsoleLogin") && ($.responseElements.ConsoleLogin = "Failure") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: '1'
          MetricNamespace: CISBenchmark
          MetricName: ConsoleLoginFailures

    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:

      Namespace: CISBenchmark
      Statistic: Sum

    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{($.eventSource = "kms.amazonaws.com") && (($.eventName = "DisableKey") || ($.eventName = "ScheduleKeyDeletion"))}'

  # 14. S3 Bucket Policy Changes
  S3BucketPolicyChangesMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{($.eventSource = "s3.amazonaws.com") && (($.eventName = "PutBucketPolicy") || ($.eventName = "DeleteBucketPolicy") || ($.eventName = "PutBucketAcl"))}'
      MetricTransformations:

  S3BucketPolicyChangesAlarm:

    Properties:

  # 15. AWS Config Configuration Changes
  ConfigConfigurationChangesMetricFilter:

    Properties:

  # 18. Network Gateway Changes
  NetworkGatewayChangesMetricFilter:

    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{($.eventSource = "ec2.amazonaws.com") && (($.eventName = "CreateInternetGateway") || ($.eventName = "DeleteInternetGateway") || ($.eventName = "AttachInternetGateway") || ($.eventName = "DetachInternetGateway"))}'
      MetricTransformations:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Automated Security Hub deployment across AWS Organization with Control Tower'

Resources:
  # SSM Parameters for account IDs (placeholders initially, updated by custom resource)
  AuditAccountIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: '/superwerker/audit-account-id'
      Type: String
      Value: '000000000000'
      Description: 'AWS Account ID of the Security Hub delegated administrator (audit account)'
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  LogArchiveAccountIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: '/superwerker/log-archive-account-id'
      Type: String
      Value: '000000000000'
      Description: 'AWS Account ID of the Log Archive account'
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  # IAM Role for EventBridge to start SSM automation and read parameters
  SHEventBridgeAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: 'SHEventBridgeAutomationRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule/*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: 'EventBridgeAutomationPermissions'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:DescribeAutomationExecutions
                  - ssm:GetAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt SHCrossAccountAutomationRole.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: ssm.amazonaws.com

  # IAM Role for SSM Automation execution (assumed by SSM service)
  SHCrossAccountAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: 'SHCrossAccountAutomationRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: 'CrossAccountAutomationPermissions'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:AssumeRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::*:role/AWSControlTowerExecution'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:ResourceAccount: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - securityhub:EnableSecurityHub
                  - securityhub:CreateMembers
                  - securityhub:InviteMembers
                  - securityhub:ListMembers
                  - securityhub:AcceptInvitation
                  - securityhub:ListInvitations
                  - organizations:DescribeOrganization
                  - organizations:ListAccounts
                Resource: '*'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Shared IAM roles, logging, GuardDuty, and CloudFormation type activations for EKS.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentAlias:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Alias used to prefix resource names.
  EnvironmentHash:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional hash to ensure uniqueness of resource names.
  PermissionsBoundaryArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: ARN of an IAM permissions boundary to attach to all roles (leave empty if not needed).
  S3BucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket for bastion role GetObject access.

Conditions:
  HasHash: !Not [!Equals [!Ref EnvironmentHash, '']]
  HasPermissionsBoundary: !Not [!Equals [!Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn, '']]
  HasS3Bucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref S3BucketName, '']]

Resources:
  # GuardDuty Detector
  GuardDutyDetector:
    Type: AWS::GuardDuty::Detector
    Properties:
      Enable: true
      FindingPublishingFrequency: FIFTEEN_MINUTES

  # IAM Roles
  LambdaDiscoveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: !If [HasHash, !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-lambda-discovery', !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-lambda-discovery']
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']

  LambdaCallerIdentityRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: !If [HasHash, !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-lambda-caller-identity', !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-lambda-caller-identity']
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CallerIdentityAndLogsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:ListStacks
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudtrail:DescribeTrails
                  - cloudtrail:GetTrailStatus
                  - cloudtrail:LookupEvents
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:GetLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']

  EKSDescribeNodegroupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: !If [HasHash, !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-eks-describe-nodegroup', !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-eks-describe-nodegroup']
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EKSDescribeNodegroupAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:DescribeNodegroup
                  - eks:ListNodegroups
                  - eks:DescribeCluster
                Resource: '*'
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']

  CloudFormationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: !If [HasHash, !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-cfn-execution', !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-cfn-execution']
      MaxSessionDuration: 8400
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FullAccessForCFN
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:*
                  - secretsmanager:*
                  - kms:*
                  - ec2:*
                  - lambda:*
                  - logs:*
                  - cloudformation:*
                  - s3:CreateBucket
                  - s3:DeleteBucket
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:PutBucketPolicy
                  - s3:GetBucketPolicy
                  - s3:PutBucketTagging
                  - s3:GetBucketTagging
                  - s3:PutBucketVersioning
                Resource: '*'
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']

  LoggingDeliveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: !If [HasHash, !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-logging-delivery', !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-logging-delivery']
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LogDeliveryPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']

  CodeBuildEKSIntegrationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: !If [HasHash, !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-codebuild-eks-integration', !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-codebuild-eks-integration']
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - codebuild.amazonaws.com
                - eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CodeBuildEKSPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - eks:DescribeCluster
                  - eks:ListClusters
                Resource: '*'
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']

  CloudFormationHooksRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: !If [HasHash, !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-cfn-hooks', !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-cfn-hooks']
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: HookPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:*
                  - kms:*
                  - eks:*
                  - sts:AssumeRole
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:PassRole
                  - ec2:*
                  - lambda:*
                  - logs:*
                  - cloudwatch:*
                  - ssm:*
                  - s3:CreateBucket
                  - s3:DeleteBucket
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: '*'
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']

  BastionInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: !If [HasHash, !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-bastion', !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-bastion']
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies: !If
        - HasS3Bucket
        - - PolicyName: BastionPermissionsBase
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                    - ecr:BatchGetImage
                    - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  Resource: '*'
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - ec2:Describe*
                  Resource: '*'
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action: eks:DescribeCluster
                  Resource: '*'
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - codebuild:StartBuild
                    - codebuild:BatchGetBuilds
                  Resource: '*'
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - codepipeline:GetPipeline
                    - codepipeline:StartPipelineExecution
                  Resource: '*'
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - logs:CreateLogStream
                    - logs:PutLogEvents
                    - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  Resource: '*'
          - PolicyName: BastionS3Access
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action: s3:GetObject
                  Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${S3BucketName}/*'
        - - PolicyName: BastionPermissionsBase
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                    - ecr:BatchGetImage
                    - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  Resource: '*'
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - ec2:Describe*
                  Resource: '*'
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action: eks:DescribeCluster
                  Resource: '*'
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - codebuild:StartBuild
                    - codebuild:BatchGetBuilds
                  Resource: '*'
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - codepipeline:GetPipeline
                    - codepipeline:StartPipelineExecution
                  Resource: '*'
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - logs:CreateLogStream
                    - logs:PutLogEvents
                    - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  Resource: '*'
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']

  # CloudWatch Log Groups
  LogGroupResource:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: cloudformation/registry/awsqs-kubernetes-resource
      RetentionInDays: 7

  LogGroupHelm:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: awsqs-kubernetes-helm-logs
      RetentionInDays: 7

  LogGroupEKSCluster:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: cloudformation/registry/awsqs-eks-cluster
      RetentionInDays: 7

  # CloudFormation Type Activations
  TypeActivationResource:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::TypeActivation
    DependsOn:
      - LogGroupResource
    Properties:
      Type: RESOURCE
      TypeName: AWSQS::Kubernetes::Resource
      PublisherId: awsqs
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecutionRole.Arn
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroupName: cloudformation/registry/awsqs-kubernetes-resource
        LogRoleArn: !GetAtt LoggingDeliveryRole.Arn
      AutoUpdate: true

  TypeActivationHelm:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::TypeActivation
    DependsOn:
      - LogGroupHelm
    Properties:
      Type: RESOURCE
      TypeName: AWSQS::Kubernetes::Helm
      PublisherId: awsqs
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecutionRole.Arn
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroupName: awsqs-kubernetes-helm-logs
        LogRoleArn: !GetAtt LoggingDeliveryRole.Arn
      AutoUpdate: true

  TypeActivationEKSCluster:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::TypeActivation
    DependsOn:
      - LogGroupEKSCluster

      Type: RESOURCE
      TypeName: AWSQS::EKS::Cluster
      PublisherId: awsqs
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecutionRole.Arn
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroupName: cloudformation/registry/awsqs-eks-cluster
        LogRoleArn: !GetAtt LoggingDeliveryRole.Arn
      AutoUpdate: true

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Comprehensive SQS infrastructure for testing with FIFO and standard queues,
  DLQs, KMS encryption, and many CloudWatch alarms.'

Resources:
  # KMS Key for encrypting all queues
  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for SQS queue encryption
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Ref AWS::AccountId
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow SQS to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
            Resource: '*'
      Enabled: true
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT

  # FIFO queue without DLQ
  FIFOQueueWithoutDLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      QueueName: 'FIFOQueueWithoutDLQ.fifo'
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey

  # FIFO queue with DLQ
  FIFOQueueWithDLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      QueueName: 'FIFOQueueWithDLQ.fifo'
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt FIFODLQForFIFOQueue.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5

  # FIFO DLQ referenced by FIFOQueueWithDLQ
  FIFODLQForFIFOQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      QueueName: 'FIFODLQForFIFOQueue.fifo'
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey

  # Standard queue with DLQ
  StandardQueueWithDLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      QueueName: 'StandardQueueWithDLQ'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt StandardDLQForStandardQueue.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5

  # Standard DLQ referenced by StandardQueueWithDLQ
  StandardDLQForStandardQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      QueueName: 'StandardDLQForStandardQueue'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey

  # Separate FIFO DLQ (not attached to any source queue)
  SeparateFIFODLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      QueueName: 'SeparateFIFODLQ.fifo'
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey

  # Alarm 1: Standard queue - ApproximateNumberOfMessagesSent, Sum, threshold 1, breaching on missing data
  StandardQueueMessagesSentAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: 'StandardQueue-MessagesSent'
      AlarmDescription: 'Alarm when sum of messages sent exceeds 1'
      Namespace: 'AWS/SQS'
      MetricName: 'ApproximateNumberOfMessagesSent'
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDLQ.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: breaching

  # Alarm 2: FIFO queue with DLQ - ApproximateNumberOfMessagesSent, Average, anomaly detection band
  FIFOQueueWithDLQMessagesSentAnomalyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: 'FIFOQueueWithDLQ-MessagesSent-Anomaly'
      AlarmDescription: 'Anomaly detection alarm on average messages sent'
      Metrics:
        - Id: m1
          Label: MessagesSent
          ReturnData: true
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/SQS
              MetricName: 'ApproximateNumberOfMessagesSent'
              Dimensions:
                - Name: QueueName
                  Value: !GetAtt FIFOQueueWithDLQ.QueueName
            Period: 60
            Stat: Average
        - Id: t1
          Label: 'Anomaly Band'
          Expression: 'ANOMALY_DETECTION_BAND(m1, 2)'
          ReturnData: true
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ThresholdMetricId: t1
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanLowerOrGreaterThanUpperThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing

  # Alarm 3: Standard queue - SentMessageSize Maximum, threshold 183500
  StandardQueueSentMessageSizeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: 'StandardQueue-SentMessageSize'
      AlarmDescription: 'Alarm when max sent message size exceeds 183500 bytes'
      Namespace: 'AWS/SQS'
      MetricName: 'SentMessageSize'
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDLQ.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 183500
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing

  # Alarm 4: FIFO queue without DLQ - SentMessageSize Maximum, threshold 183500
  FIFOQueueWithoutDLQSentMessageSizeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: 'FIFOQueueWithoutDLQ-SentMessageSize'
      AlarmDescription: 'Alarm when max sent message size exceeds 183500 bytes'
      Namespace: 'AWS/SQS'
      MetricName: 'SentMessageSize'
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt FIFOQueueWithoutDLQ.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 183500
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing

  # Alarm 5: Standard DLQ - ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible Sum > 0
  StandardDLQVisibleMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: 'StandardDLQ-VisibleMessages'
      AlarmDescription: 'Alarm when sum of visible messages exceeds 0'
      Namespace: 'AWS/SQS'
      MetricName: 'ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible'
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardDLQForStandardQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  # Alarm 6: FIFO DLQ (the one attached to FIFOQueueWithDLQ) - ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible Sum > 0
  FIFODLQForFIFOQueueVisibleMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: 'FIFODLQForFIFOQueue-VisibleMessages'
      AlarmDescription: 'Alarm when sum of visible messages exceeds 0'
      Namespace: 'AWS/SQS'
      MetricName: 'ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible'
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt FIFODLQForFIFOQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  # Alarm 7: Standard queue - ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage Maximum, threshold 15
  StandardQueueAgeOfOldestMessageAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: 'StandardQueue-AgeOfOldestMessage'
      AlarmDescription: 'Alarm when max age of oldest message exceeds 15 seconds'
      Namespace: 'AWS/SQS'
      MetricName: 'ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage'
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDLQ.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 15
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing

  # Alarm 8: FIFO queue without DLQ - ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage Maximum, threshold 15
  FIFOQueueWithoutDLQAgeOfOldestMessageAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: 'FIFOQueueWithoutDLQ-AgeOfOldestMessage'
      AlarmDescription: 'Alarm when max age of oldest message exceeds 15 seconds'
      Namespace: 'AWS/SQS'
      MetricName: 'ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage'
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt FIFOQueueWithoutDLQ.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 15
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing

  # Alarm 9: Standard queue - ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible Maximum, threshold 108000
  StandardQueueMessagesNotVisibleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: 'StandardQueue-MessagesNotVisible'
      AlarmDescription: 'Alarm when max number of not visible messages exceeds 108000'
      Namespace: 'AWS/SQS'
      MetricName: 'ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible'
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDLQ.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 108000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing

  # Alarm 10: FIFO queue without DLQ - ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible Maximum, threshold 18000
  FIFOQueueWithoutDLQMessagesNotVisibleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: 'FIFOQueueWithoutDLQ-MessagesNotVisible'
      AlarmDescription: 'Alarm when max number of not visible messages exceeds 18000'
      Namespace: 'AWS/SQS'
      MetricName: 'ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible'
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt FIFOQueueWithoutDLQ.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 18000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing

  # Alarm 11: Standard DLQ - ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage Maximum, threshold 90
  StandardDLQAgeOfOldestMessageAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: 'StandardDLQ-AgeOfOldestMessage'
      AlarmDescription: 'Alarm when max age of oldest message exceeds 90 seconds'
      Namespace: 'AWS/SQS'
      MetricName: 'ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage'
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardDLQForStandardQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 90
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing

  # Alarm 12: Synthetic always-OK alarm - metric expression equal to 0, threshold 1, LessThanThreshold
  SyntheticAlwaysOKAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: 'Synthetic-AlwaysOK'
      AlarmDescription: 'Synthetic alarm that always evaluates to OK'
      Metrics:
        - Id: m1
          Expression: '0'
          Label: 'Zero'
          ReturnData: true
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

Outputs:
  # Optional outputs for reference
  KMSKeyArn:
    Value: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn
  FIFOQueueWithoutDLQUrl:
    Value: !Ref FIFOQueueWithoutDLQ
  FIFOQueueWithDLQUrl:
    Value: !Ref FIFOQueueWithDLQ
  StandardQueueWithDLQUrl:
    Value: !Ref StandardQueueWithDLQ
  StandardDLQUrl:
    Value: !Ref StandardDLQForStandardQueue
  FIFODLQForFIFOQueueUrl:
    Value: !Ref FIFODLQForFIFOQueue
  SeparateFIFODLQUrl:
    Value: !Ref SeparateFIFODLQ

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template for private ROSA networking infrastructure with PrivateLink.

Parameters:
  NumberOfAzs:
    Type: Number
    AllowedValues: [1, 3]
    Default: 1
    Description: Number of Availability Zones for ROSA VPC private subnets (1 or 3).

  RosaVpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.1.0.0/16'
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for the ROSA VPC.

  RosaPrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.1.1.0/24'
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for the first private subnet in the ROSA VPC.

  RosaPrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.1.2.0/24'
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for the second private subnet in the ROSA VPC (used only when NumberOfAzs is 3).

  RosaPrivateSubnet3CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.1.3.0/24'
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for the third private subnet in the ROSA VPC (used only when NumberOfAzs is 3).

  EgressVpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.0/16'
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for the egress VPC.

  EgressPublicSubnetCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.1.0/24'
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet in the egress VPC.

  EgressPrivateSubnetCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.2.0/24'
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet in the egress VPC.

  TgwAsn:
    Type: Number
    Default: 64512
    Description: Amazon-side ASN for the Transit Gateway.

  CreateElbServiceLinkedRole:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Default: 'false'
    Description: Whether to create the ELB service-linked role.

  EnableVpcFlowLogs:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Default: 'false'
    Description: Whether to enable VPC Flow Logs for both VPCs.

  FlowLogsRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 3653
    Description: Retention period in days for VPC Flow Logs.

Conditions:
  ThreeAzs: !Equals [!Ref NumberOfAzs, 3]
  EnableElbRole: !Equals [!Ref CreateElbServiceLinkedRole, 'true']
  EnableFlowLogs: !Equals [!Ref EnableVpcFlowLogs, 'true']

Resources:
  # VPCs
  RosaVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaVpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: rosa-vpc

  EgressVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressVpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: egress-vpc

  # Subnets
  RosaPrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: rosa-private-subnet-1

  RosaPrivateSubnet2:
    Condition: ThreeAzs
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: rosa-private-subnet-2

  RosaPrivateSubnet3:
    Condition: ThreeAzs
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet3CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: rosa-private-subnet-3

  EgressPublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressPublicSubnetCIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: egress-public-subnet

  EgressPrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnetCIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: egress-private-subnet

  # Internet Gateway
  EgressIGW:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: egress-igw

  EgressIGWAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref EgressIGW
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC

  # NAT Gateway
  NatEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: nat-eip

  EgressNAT:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: egress-nat

  # Transit Gateway
  RosaTgw:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: disable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: disable
      AmazonSideAsn: !Ref TgwAsn
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: disable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: rosa-tgw

  RosaTgwRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref RosaTgw
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: rosa-tgw-route-table

  # Transit Gateway Attachments
  RosaTgwAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref RosaTgw
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVPC
      SubnetIds:
        Fn::If:
          - ThreeAzs
          - [!Ref RosaPrivateSubnet1, !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet2, !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet3]
          - [!Ref RosaPrivateSubnet1]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: rosa-tgw-attachment-rosa

  EgressTgwAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref RosaTgw
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: rosa-tgw-attachment-egress

  # Transit Gateway Route Table Associations
  RosaTgwAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref RosaTgwRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref RosaTgwAttachment

  EgressTgwAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref RosaTgwRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref EgressTgwAttachment

  # Transit Gateway Routes
  TgwDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref RosaTgwRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref EgressTgwAttachment

  TgwRosaVpcRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: !GetAtt RosaVPC.CidrBlock
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref RosaTgwRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref RosaTgwAttachment

  # Route Tables
  RosaPrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: rosa-private-rt

  RosaPrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref RosaTgw

  RosaPrivateSubnet1Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaPrivateRouteTable

  RosaPrivateSubnet2Association:
    Condition: ThreeAzs
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaPrivateRouteTable

  RosaPrivateSubnet3Association:
    Condition: ThreeAzs
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaPrivateRouteTable

  EgressPrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: egress-private-rt

  EgressPrivateDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      NatGatewayId: !Ref EgressNAT

  EgressPrivateTgwRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !GetAtt RosaVPC.CidrBlock
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref RosaTgw

  EgressPrivateSubnetAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable

  EgressPublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: egress-public-rt

  EgressPublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      GatewayId: !Ref EgressIGW

  EgressPublicSubnetAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPublicRouteTable

  # Optional ELB Service-Linked Role
  ElbServiceLinkedRole:
    Condition: EnableElbRole
    Type: AWS::IAM::ServiceLinkedRole
    Properties:
      AWSServiceName: elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com

  # VPC Flow Logs (conditional)
  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Condition: EnableFlowLogs
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: flow-logs-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow CloudWatch Logs to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: vpc-flow-logs-key

  FlowLogsKmsAlias:
    Condition: EnableFlowLogs
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/vpc-flow-logs-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  FlowLogsRole:
    Condition: EnableFlowLogs
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: flow-logs-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc-flow-logs:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: vpc-flow-logs-role

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Condition: EnableFlowLogs
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/vpc-flow-logs
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogsRetentionDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn

  RosaVpcFlowLog:
    Condition: EnableFlowLogs
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref RosaVPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      TrafficType: ALL

  EgressVpcFlowLog:
    Condition: EnableFlowLogs
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref EgressVPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      TrafficType: ALL

Outputs:
  RosaVpcId:
    Description: ID of the ROSA VPC
    Value: !Ref RosaVPC

  EgressVpcId:
    Description: ID of the egress VPC
    Value: !Ref EgressVPC

  RosaPrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: IDs of the ROSA private subnets (comma-separated)
    Value:
      !If [ThreeAzs, !Join [',', [!Ref RosaPrivateSubnet1, !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet2, !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet3]], !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet1]

  EgressPublicSubnetId:

  EgressPrivateSubnetId:

  NatGatewayId:

  InternetGatewayId:

    Value: !Ref EgressIGW

  FlowLogsLogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the VPC Flow Logs log group (only if enabled)
    Value: !If [EnableFlowLogs, !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup, '']

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Prerequisite resources and SSM Automation documents for PCI DSS remediation"

Resources:
  # 1. CloudWatch Log Group for CloudTrail
  CloudTrailLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/cloudtrail/${AWS::StackName}"
      RetentionInDays: 1827

  # 2. KMS Key for CloudTrail encryption
  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: "KMS key for CloudTrail encryption"
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "AllowRootFullAccess"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 30

  # Optional KMS alias for easy reference
  KMSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/CloudTrailKey-${AWS::StackName}"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KMSKey

  # 3. IAM Role for SSM Automation
  SSMAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "SSMAutomationRole-${AWS::StackName}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/IAMFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess
      Path: "/"

  # 4. IAM Role for CloudTrail CloudWatch Logs delivery
  CloudTrailCloudWatchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "CloudTrailCloudWatchRole-${AWS::StackName}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "CloudTrailCloudWatchPolicy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:PutRetentionPolicy
                Resource: !Sub "${CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn}:*"
      Path: "/"

  # 5. SSM Document: EncryptCloudTrailAndIntegrateCloudWatch
  EncryptCloudTrailAndIntegrateCloudWatch:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: "Encrypt a CloudTrail trail with a KMS key and integrate with CloudWatch Logs"
        parameters:
          TrailArn:
            type: String
            description: "ARN of the CloudTrail trail"
          KmsKeyArn:
            type: String
            description: "ARN of the KMS key for encryption"
          LogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: "ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group"
          CloudTrailCloudWatchRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: "ARN of the IAM role for CloudTrail CloudWatch integration"
        mainSteps:
          - name: "UpdateTrail"
            action: "aws:executeAwsApi"
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: "{{ TrailArn }}"
              KmsKeyId: "{{ KmsKeyArn }}"
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: "{{ LogGroupArn }}"
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: "{{ CloudTrailCloudWatchRoleArn }}"
            outputs:
              - Name: "TrailARN"
                Selector: "$.TrailARN"
                Type: String

  # 6. SSM Document: EnableKMSKeyRotation
  EnableKMSKeyRotation:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: "Enable key rotation for a KMS key"
        parameters:
          KmsKeyArn:
            type: String
            description: "ARN of the KMS key"
        mainSteps:
          - name: "EnableKeyRotation"
            action: "aws:executeAwsApi"
            inputs:
              Service: kms
              Api: EnableKeyRotation
              KeyId: "{{ KmsKeyArn }}"

  # 7. SSM Document: IntegrateCloudTrailWithCloudWatch
  IntegrateCloudTrailWithCloudWatch:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: "Integrate a CloudTrail trail with CloudWatch Logs"
        parameters:
          TrailArn:
            type: String
            description: "ARN of the CloudTrail trail"
          LogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: "ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group"
          CloudTrailCloudWatchRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: "ARN of the IAM role for CloudTrail CloudWatch integration"
        mainSteps:
          - name: "UpdateTrail"
            action: "aws:executeAwsApi"
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: "{{ TrailArn }}"
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: "{{ LogGroupArn }}"
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: "{{ CloudTrailCloudWatchRoleArn }}"

  # 8. SSM Document: UpdateIAMPasswordPolicy
  UpdateIAMPasswordPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: "Update the IAM password policy to enforce PCI DSS requirements"
        parameters:
          Confirmation:
            type: String
            description: "Type 'yes' to confirm updating the password policy"
            default: "yes"
        mainSteps:
          - name: "UpdatePasswordPolicy"
            action: "aws:executeAwsApi"
            inputs:
              Service: iam
              Api: UpdateAccountPasswordPolicy
              MinimumPasswordLength: 14
              RequireUppercaseCharacters: true
              RequireLowercaseCharacters: true
              RequireNumbers: true
              RequireSymbols: true
              AllowUsersToChangePassword: true
              HardExpiry: true
              MaxPasswordAge: 90
              PasswordReusePrevention: 24
            condition: '{{ equals "yes" Confirmation }}'

  # 9. SSM Document: EnableCloudTrailLogFileValidationAndMultiRegion
  EnableCloudTrailLogFileValidationAndMultiRegion:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: "Enable log file validation and multi-region trail, and integrate with CloudWatch Logs"
        parameters:
          TrailArn:
            type: String
            description: "ARN of the CloudTrail trail"
          LogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: "ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group"
          CloudTrailCloudWatchRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: "ARN of the IAM role for CloudTrail CloudWatch integration"
        mainSteps:
          - name: "UpdateTrail"
            action: "aws:executeAwsApi"
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: "{{ TrailArn }}"
              EnableLogFileValidation: true
              IsMultiRegionTrail: true
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: "{{ LogGroupArn }}"
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: "{{ CloudTrailCloudWatchRoleArn }}"

  # 10. SSM Document: RevokeDefaultSecurityGroupRules
  RevokeDefaultSecurityGroupRules:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: "Revoke all inbound and outbound rules of a default security group"
        parameters:
          SecurityGroupId:
            type: String
            description: "ID of the security group"
        mainSteps:
          - name: "DescribeSecurityGroup"
            action: "aws:executeAwsApi"
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: DescribeSecurityGroups
              GroupIds:
                - "{{ SecurityGroupId }}"
            outputs:
              - Name: "IpPermissions"
                Selector: "$.SecurityGroups[0].IpPermissions"
                Type: "StringList"
              - Name: "IpPermissionsEgress"
                Selector: "$.SecurityGroups[0].IpPermissionsEgress"
                Type: "StringList"
          - name: "RevokeIngress"
            action: "aws:executeAwsApi"
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              GroupId: "{{ SecurityGroupId }}"
              IpPermissions: "{{ IpPermissions }}"
          - name: "RevokeEgress"
            action: "aws:executeAwsApi"
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
              GroupId: "{{ SecurityGroupId }}"
              IpPermissions: "{{ IpPermissionsEgress }}"

  # 11. SSM Document: DeleteSecurityGroup
  DeleteSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: "Delete an EC2 security group"
        parameters:
          SecurityGroupId:
            type: String
            description: "ID of the security group to delete"
        mainSteps:
          - name: "DeleteSecurityGroup"
            action: "aws:executeAwsApi"
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: DeleteSecurityGroup
              GroupId: "{{ SecurityGroupId }}"

  # 12. SSM Document: ReleaseUnusedElasticIP
  ReleaseUnusedElasticIP:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
