  # 13. SSM Document: RemoveCodeBuildEnvVarsAKID
  RemoveCodeBuildEnvVarsAKID:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: "Remove environment variables named AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID or AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY from a CodeBuild project"
        parameters:
          ProjectName:
            type: String
            description: "Name of the CodeBuild project"
        mainSteps:
          - name: "DescribeCodeBuildProject"
            action: "aws:executeScript"
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.8
              Handler: "remove_env_vars"
              InputPayload:
                ProjectName: "{{ ProjectName }}"
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                def remove_env_vars(event, context):
                    client = boto3.client('codebuild')
                    project_name = event['ProjectName']
                    response = client.batch_get_projects(names=[project_name])
                    project = response['projects'][0] if response['projects'] else None
                    if not project:
                        raise Exception(f"Project {project_name} not found")
                    env = project.get('environment', {})
                    existing_vars = env.get('environmentVariables', [])
                    # Filter out sensitive vars
                    filtered_vars = [v for v in existing_vars if v['name'] not in ('AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID', 'AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY')]
                    if len(filtered_vars) == len(existing_vars):
                        return {"Message": "No sensitive environment variables found"}
                    # Update the project
                    client.update_project(
                        name=project_name,
                        environment={
                            'type': env['type'],
                            'image': env['image'],
                            'computeType': env['computeType'],
                            'environmentVariables': filtered_vars + [v for v in existing_vars if v['name'] in ('AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID', 'AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY')]
                        }
                    )
                    return {"Message": "Sensitive environment variables removed"}
            outputs:
              - Name: "Message"
                Selector: "$.Payload.Message"
                Type: String

Description: Telemetry monitoring dashboard for Claude Desktop (CoWork) usage.

Parameters:

    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.outputTokens = "*" }'
      MetricTransformations:

    Description: 'List of managed policy ARNs to attach to the account lookup role'
    Default: 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess'

  DeploymentManagedPolicyArns:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: 'List of managed policy ARNs to attach to the deploy action role'
    Default: 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/PowerUserAccess'

  CloudFormationExecutionManagedPolicyArns:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: 'List of managed policy ARNs to attach to the CloudFormation execution role'
    Default: 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess'

Conditions:
  HasBucketName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref BucketName, '']]
  HasCustomAlias: !Not [!Equals [!Ref KeyAlias, '']]
  HasTrustedAccounts: !Not [!Equals [!Join ['', !Ref TrustedAccounts], '']]

Resources:
  # KMS Key for S3 bucket encryption
  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      Description: !Sub 'CDK bootstrap file asset encryption key for qualifier ${Qualifier}'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow encryption and decryption for asset publishing
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !If
                - HasTrustedAccounts
                - !Split
                  - ','
                  - !Sub
                    - '${AccountId},${TrustedAccounts}'
                    - AccountId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
                      TrustedAccounts: !Join [',', !Ref TrustedAccounts]
                - - !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'

  KmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !If [HasCustomAlias, !Ref KeyAlias, !Sub 'alias/cdk-${Qualifier}-file-assets']
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  # S3 Bucket for file assets
  FileAssetsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !If
        - HasBucketName
        - !Ref BucketName
        - !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-assets-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref KmsKey
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  FileAssetsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref FileAssetsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureConnections
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:PutObject'
            Resource: !Sub '${FileAssetsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  # ECR Repository for container assets
  ContainerAssetsRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-container-assets-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
      EncryptionConfiguration:
        EncryptionType: KMS
        KmsKey: !Ref KmsKey
      RepositoryPolicyText:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowPullPush
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - 'ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer'
              - 'ecr:BatchGetImage'
              - 'ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability'
              - 'ecr:PutImage'
              - 'ecr:InitiateLayerUpload'
              - 'ecr:UploadLayerPart'
              - 'ecr:CompleteLayerUpload'
              - 'ecr:DescribeRepositories'
              - 'ecr:ListImages'
              - 'ecr:DescribeImages'
              - 'ecr:StartImageScan'
              - 'ecr:GetRepositoryPolicy'

  # SSM Parameter for bootstrap version
  BootstrapVersionParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/cdk-bootstrap/${Qualifier}/version'
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref BootstrapVersion

  # IAM Roles
  FilePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-file-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !If
                - HasTrustedAccounts
                - !Split
                  - ','
                  - !Sub
                    - '${AccountId},${TrustedAccounts}'
                    - AccountId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
                      TrustedAccounts: !Join [',', !Ref TrustedAccounts]
                - - !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns: !Ref FilePublishingManagedPolicyArns
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: 'file-publishing-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:PutObject'
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                  - 's3:DeleteObject'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub '${FileAssetsBucket.Arn}/*'
                  - !Sub '${FileAssetsBucket.Arn}'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                  - 'kms:Encrypt'
                Resource: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: 'cdk-bootstrap'
          Value: !Ref Qualifier

  ImagePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-image-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !If
                - HasTrustedAccounts
                - !Split
                  - ','
                  - !Sub
                    - '${AccountId},${TrustedAccounts}'
                    - AccountId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
                      TrustedAccounts: !Join [',', !Ref TrustedAccounts]
                - - !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns: !Ref ImagePublishingManagedPolicyArns
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: 'image-publishing-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ecr:PutImage'
                  - 'ecr:InitiateLayerUpload'
                  - 'ecr:UploadLayerPart'
                  - 'ecr:CompleteLayerUpload'
                  - 'ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability'
                  - 'ecr:GetAuthorizationToken'
                Resource: !GetAtt ContainerAssetsRepository.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: 'ecr:GetAuthorizationToken'
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: 'cdk-bootstrap'
          Value: !Ref Qualifier

  AccountLookupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-account-lookup-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !If
                - HasTrustedAccounts
                - !Split
                  - ','
                  - !Sub
                    - '${AccountId},${TrustedAccounts}'
                    - AccountId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
                      TrustedAccounts: !Join [',', !Ref TrustedAccounts]
                - - !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns: !Ref AccountLookupManagedPolicyArns
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: 'account-lookup-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'organizations:DescribeAccount'
                  - 'iam:ListAccountAliases'
                  - 'iam:GetAccountPasswordPolicy'
                  - 'iam:GetAccountSummary'
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: 'cdk-bootstrap'
          Value: !Ref Qualifier

  DeployActionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-deploy-action-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !If
                - HasTrustedAccounts
                - !Split
                  - ','
                  - !Sub
                    - '${AccountId},${TrustedAccounts}'
                    - AccountId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
                      TrustedAccounts: !Join [',', !Ref TrustedAccounts]
                - - !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns: !Ref DeploymentManagedPolicyArns
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: 'deploy-action-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'sts:AssumeRole'
                Resource: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecutionRole.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'cloudformation:CreateStack'
                  - 'cloudformation:UpdateStack'
                  - 'cloudformation:DeleteStack'
                  - 'cloudformation:DescribeStacks'
                  - 'cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents'
                  - 'cloudformation:GetTemplate'
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: 'iam:PassRole'
                Resource: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecutionRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: 'cdk-bootstrap'
          Value: !Ref Qualifier

  CloudFormationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-cfn-exec-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/cdk-${Qualifier}-deploy-action-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns: !Ref CloudFormationExecutionManagedPolicyArns
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: 'cfn-execution-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'cloudformation:*'
                  - 'ecr:*'
                  - 'kms:*'
                  - 'iam:*'
                  - 'ssm:*'
                  - 's3:CreateBucket'
                  - 's3:DeleteBucket'

                  - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
                  - 's3:GetBucketPolicy'
                  - 's3:PutBucketPolicy'
                  - 's3:PutBucketPublicAccessBlock'
                  - 's3:PutBucketVersioning'
                  - 's3:PutEncryptionConfiguration'
                  - 's3:GetEncryptionConfiguration'
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                  - 's3:PutObject'
                  - 's3:DeleteObject'
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: 'cdk-bootstrap'
          Value: !Ref Qualifier

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Elastic Beanstalk Blue-Green Deployment Infrastructure"

Parameters:
  ApplicationName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyApp
    Description: Name of the Elastic Beanstalk application (used when creating a new application)
  EnvironmentNameBlue:
    Type: String
    Default: MyApp-env-blue
    Description: Name of the blue environment (used when creating a new blue environment)
  EnvironmentNameGreen:
    Type: String
    Default: MyApp-env-green
    Description: Name of the temporary green environment
  ExistingApplicationName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Name of an existing Elastic Beanstalk application (leave empty to create a new one)
  ExistingEnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Name of an existing blue environment (leave empty to create a new one)
  ExistingBlueEndpointURL:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: CNAME of the existing blue environment (required if using existing environment)
  BlueGreenUpdate:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Default: "false"
    Description: Set to true to perform a blue/green update (creates green environment and swaps)
  SolutionStackName:
    Type: String
    Default: "64bit Amazon Linux 2 v5.8.1 running Node.js 18"
    Description: Solution stack for the Elastic Beanstalk environment
  CustomS3Bucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Custom S3 bucket containing the application source (leave empty to use sample)
  CustomS3Key:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Custom S3 key for the application source (leave empty to use sample)
  CreateSampleSecret:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Default: "false"
    Description: Set to true to create a sample secret in Secrets Manager
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/16"
  Subnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.1.0/24"
  Subnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.2.0/24"

Conditions:
  IsNewApp: !Equals [!Ref ExistingApplicationName, ""]
  IsNewBlueEnv: !Equals [!Ref ExistingEnvironmentName, ""]
  IsBlueGreenUpdate: !Equals [!Ref BlueGreenUpdate, "true"]
  UseCustomS3: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CustomS3Bucket, ""]]
  CreateSampleSecretCond: !Equals [!Ref CreateSampleSecret, "true"]
  AppVersionNeeded: !Or [Condition: IsNewBlueEnv, Condition: IsBlueGreenUpdate]

Resources:
  # VPC and Networking
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ElasticBeanstalkVPC

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  Subnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref Subnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ElasticBeanstalkSubnet1

  Subnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref Subnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ElasticBeanstalkSubnet2

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # IAM Roles
  ElasticBeanstalkServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: elasticbeanstalk.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSElasticBeanstalkService

  ElasticBeanstalkWebTierRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSElasticBeanstalkWebTier

  InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ElasticBeanstalkWebTierRole

  # Elastic Beanstalk Application
  Application:
    Condition: IsNewApp
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Application
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref ApplicationName
      Description: Application for blue-green deployment

  # Application Version (created when either new blue or green is needed)
  ApplicationVersion:
    Condition: AppVersionNeeded
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::ApplicationVersion
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !If [IsNewApp, !Ref ApplicationName, !Ref ExistingApplicationName]
      SourceBundle:
        !If
        - UseCustomS3
        -
          S3Bucket: !Ref CustomS3Bucket
          S3Key: !Ref CustomS3Key
        -
          S3Bucket: !Sub "elasticbeanstalk-samples-${AWS::Region}"
          S3Key: "nodejs-sample.zip"

  # Blue Environment
  BlueEnvironment:
    Condition: IsNewBlueEnv
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Environment
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !If [IsNewApp, !Ref ApplicationName, !Ref ExistingApplicationName]
      EnvironmentName: !Ref EnvironmentNameBlue
      SolutionStackName: !Ref SolutionStackName
      VersionLabel: !Ref ApplicationVersion
      OptionSettings:
        - Namespace: aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration
          OptionName: IamInstanceProfile
          Value: !Ref InstanceProfile
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment
          OptionName: ServiceRole
          Value: !Ref ElasticBeanstalkServiceRole
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: VPCId
          Value: !Ref VPC
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: Subnets
          Value: !Join [",", [!Ref Subnet1, !Ref Subnet2]]
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: AssociatePublicIpAddress
          Value: "true"

  # Green Environment (temporary)
  GreenEnvironment:
    Condition: IsBlueGreenUpdate
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Environment
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !If [IsNewApp, !Ref ApplicationName, !Ref ExistingApplicationName]
      EnvironmentName: !Ref EnvironmentNameGreen
      SolutionStackName: !Ref SolutionStackName
      VersionLabel: !Ref ApplicationVersion
      OptionSettings:
        - Namespace: aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration
          OptionName: IamInstanceProfile
          Value: !Ref InstanceProfile
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment
          OptionName: ServiceRole
          Value: !Ref ElasticBeanstalkServiceRole
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: VPCId
          Value: !Ref VPC
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: Subnets
          Value: !Join [",", [!Ref Subnet1, !Ref Subnet2]]
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: AssociatePublicIpAddress
          Value: "true"

  # Lambda Execution Role
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Condition: IsBlueGreenUpdate
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ElasticBeanstalkActions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticbeanstalk:SwapEnvironmentCNAMEs
                  - elasticbeanstalk:TerminateEnvironment
                  - elasticbeanstalk:DescribeEnvironments
                Resource: "*"

  # Lambda Function
  CustomResourceLambda:
    Condition: IsBlueGreenUpdate
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: nodejs22.x
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          const AWS = require('aws-sdk');
          const eb = new AWS.ElasticBeanstalk();
          exports.handler = async (event) => {
            const send = async (res) => {
              const url = event.ResponseURL;
              const body = JSON.stringify(res);
              const https = require('https');
              return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                const req = https.request(url, { method: 'PUT', headers: {'Content-Type':'','Content-Length':Buffer.byteLength(body)} }, resolve);
                req.on('error', reject);

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: Network stack for staging or production environment with dual-stack IPv4/IPv6 VPC

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - staging
      - production
    Default: staging
    Description: Environment name used to select VPC CIDR and naming

  EnableNATGateway:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'
    Description: 'When true, provisions a NAT Gateway in the public subnets with an Elastic IP'

  BastionVPNPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1194
    Description: UDP/TCP port used for bastion VPN access

Mappings:
  EnvironmentConfig:
    staging:
      VpcCidr: 10.64.0.0/16
      DomainName: staging.example.internal
    production:
      VpcCidr: 10.128.0.0/16
      DomainName: production.example.internal

  SubnetCIDRs:
    staging:
      PublicSubnet1: 10.64.0.0/24
      PublicSubnet2: 10.64.1.0/24
      PublicSubnet3: 10.64.2.0/24
      PrivateSubnet1: 10.64.10.0/24
      PrivateSubnet2: 10.64.11.0/24
    production:
      PublicSubnet1: 10.128.0.0/24
      PublicSubnet2: 10.128.1.0/24
      PublicSubnet3: 10.128.2.0/24
      PrivateSubnet1: 10.128.10.0/24
      PrivateSubnet2: 10.128.11.0/24

Conditions:
  EnableNAT: !Equals [!Ref EnableNATGateway, 'true']

Resources:
  # VPC
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, VpcCidr]
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-vpc'

  # IPv6 CIDR block for VPC
  VpcCidrBlock:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCCidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AmazonProvidedIpv6CidrBlock: true

  # Internet Gateway
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Egress-Only Internet Gateway (for IPv6 egress)
  EgressOnlyInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EgressOnlyInternetGateway
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-eigw'

  # Subnets
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetCIDRs, !Ref Environment, PublicSubnet1]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-public-subnet-1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetCIDRs, !Ref Environment, PublicSubnet2]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-public-subnet-2'

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetCIDRs, !Ref Environment, PublicSubnet3]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-public-subnet-3'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetCIDRs, !Ref Environment, PrivateSubnet1]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-private-subnet-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetCIDRs, !Ref Environment, PrivateSubnet2]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-private-subnet-2'

  # Public Route Table
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-public-rt'

  PublicRouteIPv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteIPv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: '::/0'
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # Private Route Table
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-private-rt'

  PrivateRouteIPv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: '::/0'
      EgressOnlyInternetGatewayId: !Ref EgressOnlyInternetGateway

  # Conditional NAT Gateway resources
  NatEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: EnableNAT
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-nat-eip'

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: EnableNAT
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-nat-gw'

  PrivateRouteIPv4ToNAT:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: EnableNAT
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # Network ACLs
  PublicNetworkAcl:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-public-nacl'

  PublicNetworkAclInboundHTTP4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 80
        To: 80

  PublicNetworkAclInboundHTTP6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 101
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      Ipv6CidrBlock: '::/0'
      PortRange:
        From: 80
        To: 80

  PublicNetworkAclInboundHTTPS4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 110
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 443
        To: 443

  PublicNetworkAclInboundHTTPS6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 111
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      Ipv6CidrBlock: '::/0'
      PortRange:
        From: 443

  PublicNetworkAclInboundSSH4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl

    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Self-contained serverless Movies API using DynamoDB, Lambda, API Gateway'
Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+'
    Description: Environment name for stage and resource naming
Resources:
  MoviesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: title
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: title
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      TableName: !Sub "MoviesTable-${Environment}"

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource: !GetAtt MoviesTable.Arn

  CreateMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "CreateMovie-${Environment}"
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, boto3, os, logging
          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])
          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event.get('body', '{}'))
                  table.put_item(Item=body)
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 201,
                      'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'POST,OPTIONS', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Movie created'})
                  }
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(e)

          def handler(event, context):

  UpdateMovieFunction:

      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, boto3, os, logging

          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])
          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  title = event['pathParameters']['title']
                  body = json.loads(event.get('body', '{}'))
                  update_expr = 'SET '
                  expr_attr_values = {}
                  for key, value in body.items():
                      if key != 'title':
                          update_expr += f"#{key} = :{key}, "
                          expr_attr_values[f":{key}"] = value
                  update_expr = update_expr.rstrip(', ')
                  if not expr_attr_values:
                      return {'statusCode': 200, 'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'}, 'body': json.dumps({'message': 'No attributes to update'})}
                  expr_attr_names = {f"#{k}": k for k in body if k != 'title'}
                  table.update_item(
                      Key={'title': title},
                      UpdateExpression=update_expr,
                      ExpressionAttributeNames=expr_attr_names,
                      ExpressionAttributeValues=expr_attr_values

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template to provision a SageMaker Studio user profile for an MLOps engineer persona, with self-contained networking and domain creation when no existing domain is provided.
Parameters:
  DomainId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Optional existing SageMaker Studio Domain ID. Leave empty to create a new domain."
  UserProfileName:
    Type: String
    Default: mlops-engineer
    Description: "Name for the SageMaker Studio user profile."
Conditions:
  CreateNewDomain: !Equals [!Ref DomainId, ""]
Resources:
  # VPC and networking resources (created only when no existing domain is provided)
  SageMakerVPC:
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: SageMakerStudioVPC
  InternetGateway:
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: SageMakerStudioIGW
  AttachGateway:
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref SageMakerVPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnet:
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref SageMakerVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: SageMakerStudioPublicSubnet
  RouteTable:
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref SageMakerVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: SageMakerStudioRouteTable
  DefaultRoute:
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: AttachGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
  # IAM Execution Role for MLOps engineer persona (always created) with inline policy
  SageMakerExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MLOpsEngineerInlinePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PassRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: "*"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
              - Sid: SageMakerPipelines
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreatePipeline
                  - sagemaker:DeletePipeline
                  - sagemaker:DescribePipeline
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelines
                  - sagemaker:UpdatePipeline
                  - sagemaker:StartPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:StopPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:RetryPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:DescribePipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelineExecutions
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: ModelMonitoring
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:DeleteMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:DescribeMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:ListMonitoringSchedules
                  - sagemaker:StopMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:UpdateMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:CreateProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListProcessingJobs
                  - sagemaker:StopProcessingJob
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: ModelAndModelPackageGroup
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateModel
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModel
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModel
                  - sagemaker:ListModels
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackageGroups
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackages
                  - sagemaker:UpdateModelPackage
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: ExperimentsAndLineage
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:AddAssociation
                  - sagemaker:CreateExperiment
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrial
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:DeleteAssociation
                  - sagemaker:DeleteExperiment
                  - sagemaker:DeleteTrial
                  - sagemaker:DeleteTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:DescribeExperiment
                  - sagemaker:DescribeLineageGroup
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrial
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:ListAssociations
                  - sagemaker:ListExperiments
                  - sagemaker:ListLineageGroups
                  - sagemaker:ListTrialComponents
                  - sagemaker:ListTrials
                  - sagemaker:UpdateExperiment
                  - sagemaker:UpdateTrial
                  - sagemaker:UpdateTrialComponent
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: TrainingAndInferenceJobs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:CreateTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:ListHyperParameterTuningJobs
                  - sagemaker:ListTrainingJobs
                  - sagemaker:ListTransformJobs
                  - sagemaker:StopHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:StopTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:StopTransformJob
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: Endpoints
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:CreateEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:DeleteEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:DeleteEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:DescribeEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:DescribeEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:InvokeEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:ListEndpointConfigs
                  - sagemaker:ListEndpoints
                  - sagemaker:UpdateEndpoint
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: StudioAppsOwnership
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateApp
                  - sagemaker:DeleteApp
                  - sagemaker:DescribeApp
                  - sagemaker:ListApps
                Resource: "*"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    sagemaker:UserProfileName: !Ref UserProfileName
              - Sid: StudioSpacesOwnership
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateSpace
                  - sagemaker:DeleteSpace
                  - sagemaker:DescribeSpace
                  - sagemaker:ListSpaces
                  - sagemaker:UpdateSpace
                Resource: "*"
                Condition:
                  StringLike:
                    sagemaker:SpaceName: !Sub "${UserProfileName}*"
              - Sid: LogsAndECR
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: MLOpsEngineerExecutionRole
  # SageMaker Studio Domain (created only when no existing domain is provided)
  SageMakerStudioDomain:
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::Domain
    Properties:
      DomainName: mlops-domain
      AuthMode: IAM
      VpcId: !Ref SageMakerVPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PublicSubnet
      AppNetworkAccessType: PublicInternetOnly
      DefaultUserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt SageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: MLOpsStudioDomain
  # SageMaker User Profile (always created, attached to either new or existing domain)
  SageMakerUserProfile:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::UserProfile
    Properties:
      DomainId: !If [CreateNewDomain, !Ref SageMakerStudioDomain, !Ref DomainId]
      UserProfileName: !Ref UserProfileName
      UserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt SageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
Outputs:
  UserProfileArn:
    Description: ARN of the created SageMaker Studio user profile
    Value: !GetAtt SageMakerUserProfile.UserProfileArn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  CloudFormation template for CloudWatch monitoring of cross-language database
  encryption SDK performance benchmarks. Creates a CloudWatch Logs log group
  and 40 metric filters for five languages (Java, .NET, Python, Go, Rust)
  extracting memory efficiency ratio, peak memory, and latency percentiles (p50,
  p95, p99) from throughput and concurrency tests. Each metric is published
  into a language-specific CloudWatch namespace with a Language dimension.
Parameters:
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: /aws/benchmarks/db-encryption-sdk
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group to receive benchmark JSON events.
  ThroughputDataSize:
    Type: String
    Default: 1MB
    Description: The data size used in throughput tests (e.g., 1MB, 10MB). Must match the $.dataSize field in log events.
Resources:
  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: 30

  # ==============================
  # Java metric filters (8)
  # ==============================
  JavaMemoryEfficiencyRatioFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.testType = "memory" && $.language = "Java" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "$.memoryEfficiencyRatio"
          MetricNamespace: "JavaDBEncryptionBenchmarks"
          MetricName: "MemoryEfficiencyRatio"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Dimensions:
            - Key: "Language"
              Value: "Java"

  JavaPeakMemoryUsageFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.testType = "memory" && $.language = "Java" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "$.peakMemoryMB"
          MetricNamespace: "JavaDBEncryptionBenchmarks"
          MetricName: "PeakMemoryUsageMB"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Dimensions:
            - Key: "Language"
              Value: "Java"

  JavaThroughputLatencyP50Filter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroup
      FilterPattern: !Sub
        '{ $.testType = "throughput" && $.language = "Java" && $.dataSize = "${ThroughputDataSize}" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "$.latency.p50"
          MetricNamespace: "JavaDBEncryptionBenchmarks"
          MetricName: "ThroughputLatency_p50"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Dimensions:
            - Key: "Language"
              Value: "Java"

  JavaThroughputLatencyP95Filter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroup
      FilterPattern: !Sub
        '{ $.testType = "throughput" && $.language = "Java" && $.dataSize = "${ThroughputDataSize}" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "$.latency.p95"
          MetricNamespace: "JavaDBEncryptionBenchmarks"
          MetricName: "ThroughputLatency_p95"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Dimensions:
            - Key: "Language"
              Value: "Java"

  JavaThroughputLatencyP99Filter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroup
      FilterPattern: !Sub
        '{ $.testType = "throughput" && $.language = "Java" && $.dataSize = "${ThroughputDataSize}" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "$.latency.p99"
          MetricNamespace: "JavaDBEncryptionBenchmarks"
          MetricName: "ThroughputLatency_p99"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Dimensions:
            - Key: "Language"
              Value: "Java"

  JavaConcurrencyLatencyP50Filter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.testType = "concurrency" && $.language = "Java" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "$.latency.p50"
          MetricNamespace: "JavaDBEncryptionBenchmarks"
          MetricName: "ConcurrencyLatency_p50"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Dimensions:
            - Key: "Language"
              Value: "Java"

  JavaConcurrencyLatencyP95Filter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.testType = "concurrency" && $.language = "Java" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "$.latency.p95"
          MetricNamespace: "JavaDBEncryptionBenchmarks"
          MetricName: "ConcurrencyLatency_p95"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Dimensions:
            - Key: "Language"
              Value: "Java"

  JavaConcurrencyLatencyP99Filter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.testType = "concurrency" && $.language = "Java" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "$.latency.p99"
          MetricNamespace: "JavaDBEncryptionBenchmarks"
          MetricName: "ConcurrencyLatency_p99"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Dimensions:
            - Key: "Language"
              Value: "Java"

  # ==============================
  # .NET metric filters (8)
  # ==============================
  DotNetMemoryEfficiencyRatioFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.testType = "memory" && $.language = ".NET" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "$.memoryEfficiencyRatio"
          MetricNamespace: ".NETDBEncryptionBenchmarks"
          MetricName: "MemoryEfficiencyRatio"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Dimensions:
            - Key: "Language"
              Value: ".NET"

  DotNetPeakMemoryUsageFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.testType = "memory" && $.language = ".NET" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "$.peakMemoryMB"
          MetricNamespace: ".NETDBEncryptionBenchmarks"
          MetricName: "PeakMemoryUsageMB"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Dimensions:
            - Key: "Language"
              Value: ".NET"

  DotNetThroughputLatencyP50Filter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroup
      FilterPattern: !Sub
        '{ $.testType = "throughput" && $.language = ".NET" && $.dataSize = "${ThroughputDataSize}" }'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained AppSync GraphQL API with DynamoDB, JS resolvers, and subscriptions.

Parameters:
  ApiName:
    Type: String
    Default: TodoAPIwithJs
    Description: Name for the GraphQL API.

Resources:
  # ===== GraphQL API =====
  GraphQLApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ApiName
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY
      AdditionalAuthenticationProviders: []

  # ===== API Key (default 7-day expiration) =====
  ApiKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      # No Expires property – defaults to 7 days

  # ===== GraphQL Schema =====
  GraphQLSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Todo {
          id: ID!
          owner: String
          title: String
          description: String
          createdAt: AWSDateTime
          updatedAt: AWSDateTime
        }
        input CreateTodoInput {
          id: ID
          owner: String
          title: String
          description: String
        }
        input UpdateTodoInput {
          id: ID!
          owner: String
          title: String
          description: String
        }
        type Query {
          getTodo(id: ID!): Todo
          listTodos(limit: Int, nextToken: String): TodoConnection
          listTodosByOwner(owner: String!): TodoConnection
        }
        type Mutation {
          createTodo(input: CreateTodoInput!): Todo
          updateTodo(input: UpdateTodoInput!): Todo
          deleteTodo(id: ID!): Todo
        }
        type Subscription {
          onCreateTodo: Todo @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["createTodo"])
          onUpdateTodo: Todo @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["updateTodo"])
          onDeleteTodo: Todo @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["deleteTodo"])
        }
        type TodoConnection {
          items: [Todo]
          nextToken: String
        }
        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
          subscription: Subscription
        }

  # ===== DynamoDB Table =====
  TodoTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: owner
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: owner-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: owner
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
      TableName: !Sub "${ApiName}-todos"

  # ===== IAM Role for AppSync DataSource =====
  DataSourceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncDynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt TodoTable.Arn
                  - !Sub "${TodoTable.Arn}/index/*"

  # ===== AppSync DataSource =====
  TodoDynamoDBDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: TodoDynamoDBDataSource
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt DataSourceRole.Arn

          const { id, owner, title, description } = ctx.arguments.input;
          const now = util.time.nowISO8601();
          const item = {
            id: id ? id : util.autoId(),
            owner: owner || null,
            title: title || null,
            description: description || null,
            createdAt: now,
            updatedAt: now
          };
          return {
            operation: 'PutItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id: item.id }),

          };
        }

      Runtime:

      Code: |

        export function request(ctx) {
          const { id, owner, title, description } = ctx.arguments.input;

          const updates = {};
          const exprNames = {};
          const exprValues = {};
          let expr = 'SET ';
          if (owner !== undefined) {
            expr += '#owner = :owner, ';
            exprNames['#owner'] = 'owner';
            exprValues[':owner'] = owner;
          }
          if (title !== undefined) {
            expr += '#title = :title, ';
            exprNames['#title'] = 'title';
            exprValues[':title'] = title;
          }
          if (description !== undefined) {
            expr += '#description = :description, ';
            exprNames['#description'] = 'description';
            exprValues[':description'] = description;
          }
          expr += '#updatedAt = :updatedAt';
          exprNames['#updatedAt'] = 'updatedAt';
          exprValues[':updatedAt'] = now;
          return {
            operation: 'UpdateItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id }),

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Composite CloudWatch alarms for cross-region failover application monitoring API Gateway, Lambda, and RDS."

Parameters:
  ApiGatewayName:
    Type: String
    Default: "Remittance"
    Description: "Name of the existing API Gateway REST API for dimension ApiName."
  GetRemittancesFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: "GetRemittances"
    Description: "Name of the existing GetRemittances Lambda function."
  CreateRemittanceFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: "CreateRemittance"
    Description: "Name of the existing CreateRemittance Lambda function."
  RDSInstanceIdentifier:
    Type: String
    Default: "dbcluster1-instance1"
    Description: "Identifier of the existing RDS DB instance."

Resources:
  # API Gateway Alarms
  API4XXErrors:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "API-4XXErrors"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average 4XX errors > 0 over 300 seconds."
      MetricName: "4XXError"
      Namespace: "AWS/ApiGateway"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanThreshold"
      TreatMissingData: "notBreaching"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "ApiName"
          Value: !Ref ApiGatewayName

  API5XXErrors:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "API-5XXErrors"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average 5XX errors > 1 over 60 seconds."
      MetricName: "5XXError"
      Namespace: "AWS/ApiGateway"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanThreshold"
      TreatMissingData: "notBreaching"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "ApiName"
          Value: !Ref ApiGatewayName

  APILatency:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "API-Latency"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average latency >= 10000 ms over 300 seconds."
      MetricName: "Latency"
      Namespace: "AWS/ApiGateway"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"
      TreatMissingData: "notBreaching"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "ApiName"
          Value: !Ref ApiGatewayName

  # Lambda Alarms for GetRemittances
  GetRemittancesErrors:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "GetRemittances-Errors"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when summed errors > 0 over 60 seconds for GetRemittances."
      MetricName: "Errors"
      Namespace: "AWS/Lambda"
      Statistic: "Sum"
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanThreshold"
      TreatMissingData: "notBreaching"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "FunctionName"
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName

  GetRemittancesInvocations:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "GetRemittances-Invocations"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when summed invocations > 2 over 60 seconds for GetRemittances."
      MetricName: "Invocations"
      Namespace: "AWS/Lambda"
      Statistic: "Sum"
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 2
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanThreshold"
      TreatMissingData: "notBreaching"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "FunctionName"
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName

  GetRemittancesDuration:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "GetRemittances-Duration"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average duration >= 10000 ms over 900 seconds for GetRemittances."
      MetricName: "Duration"
      Namespace: "AWS/Lambda"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"
      TreatMissingData: "missing"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "FunctionName"
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName

  # Lambda Alarms for CreateRemittance
  CreateRemittanceErrors:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "CreateRemittance-Errors"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when summed errors > 0 over 60 seconds for CreateRemittance."
      MetricName: "Errors"
      Namespace: "AWS/Lambda"
      Statistic: "Sum"
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanThreshold"
      TreatMissingData: "notBreaching"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "FunctionName"
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName

  CreateRemittanceInvocations:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "CreateRemittance-Invocations"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when summed invocations > 2 over 60 seconds for CreateRemittance."
      MetricName: "Invocations"
      Namespace: "AWS/Lambda"
      Statistic: "Sum"
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 2
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanThreshold"
      TreatMissingData: "notBreaching"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "FunctionName"
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName

  CreateRemittanceDuration:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "CreateRemittance-Duration"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average duration >= 10000 ms over 900 seconds for CreateRemittance."
      MetricName: "Duration"
      Namespace: "AWS/Lambda"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"
      TreatMissingData: "missing"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "FunctionName"
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName

  # RDS Alarms
  RDSCPUUtilization:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RDS-CPUUtilization"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average CPU >= 70% over 300 seconds."
      MetricName: "CPUUtilization"
      Namespace: "AWS/RDS"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "DBInstanceIdentifier"
          Value: !Ref RDSInstanceIdentifier

  RDSDatabaseConnections:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RDS-DatabaseConnections"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average database connections >= 100 over 300 seconds."
      MetricName: "DatabaseConnections"
      Namespace: "AWS/RDS"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "DBInstanceIdentifier"
          Value: !Ref RDSInstanceIdentifier

  RDSDeadlocks:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RDS-Deadlocks"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average deadlocks >= 10 over 300 seconds."
      MetricName: "Deadlocks"
      Namespace: "AWS/RDS"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "DBInstanceIdentifier"
          Value: !Ref RDSInstanceIdentifier

  RDSNetworkTransmitThroughput:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RDS-NetworkTransmitThroughput"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average network transmit throughput >= 10485760 bytes over 300 seconds."
      MetricName: "NetworkTransmitThroughput"
      Namespace: "AWS/RDS"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "DBInstanceIdentifier"
          Value: !Ref RDSInstanceIdentifier

  RDSNetworkReceiveThroughput:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RDS-NetworkReceiveThroughput"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average network receive throughput >= 10485760 bytes over 300 seconds."
      MetricName: "NetworkReceiveThroughput"
      Namespace: "AWS/RDS"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "DBInstanceIdentifier"
          Value: !Ref RDSInstanceIdentifier

  RDSQueries:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RDS-Queries"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average queries >= 100 over 300 seconds."
      MetricName: "Queries"
      Namespace: "AWS/RDS"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "DBInstanceIdentifier"
          Value: !Ref RDSInstanceIdentifier

  RDSDiskQueueDepth:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RDS-DiskQueueDepth"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average disk queue depth >= 50 over 300 seconds."
      MetricName: "DiskQueueDepth"
      Namespace: "AWS/RDS"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 50
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "DBInstanceIdentifier"
          Value: !Ref RDSInstanceIdentifier

  RDSReadLatency:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RDS-ReadLatency"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average read latency >= 0.1 seconds over 300 seconds."
      MetricName: "ReadLatency"
      Namespace: "AWS/RDS"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0.1
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "DBInstanceIdentifier"
          Value: !Ref RDSInstanceIdentifier

  RDSWriteLatency:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RDS-WriteLatency"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average write latency >= 0.1 seconds over 300 seconds."
      MetricName: "WriteLatency"
      Namespace: "AWS/RDS"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0.1
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "DBInstanceIdentifier"
          Value: !Ref RDSInstanceIdentifier

  # Composite Alarms
  APIGatewayHealth:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "API Gateway Health"
      AlarmDescription: "Composite alarm for API Gateway health based on 4XX, 5XX, and latency."
      AlarmRule: !Sub
        - "ALARM(${Alarm1}) OR ALARM(${Alarm2}) OR ALARM(${Alarm3})"
        - Alarm1: !GetAtt API4XXErrors.Arn
          Alarm2: !GetAtt API5XXErrors.Arn
          Alarm3: !GetAtt APILatency.Arn

  LambdaHealth:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "Lambda Health"
      AlarmDescription: "Composite alarm for Lambda health based on errors and duration (excluding invocations)."
      AlarmRule: !Sub
        - "ALARM(${Alarm1}) OR ALARM(${Alarm2}) OR ALARM(${Alarm3}) OR ALARM(${Alarm4})"
        - Alarm1: !GetAtt GetRemittancesErrors.Arn
          Alarm2: !GetAtt CreateRemittanceErrors.Arn
          Alarm3: !GetAtt GetRemittancesDuration.Arn
          Alarm4: !GetAtt CreateRemittanceDuration.Arn

  RDSHealth:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RDS Health"
      AlarmDescription: "Composite alarm for RDS health based on all nine metric alarms."
      AlarmRule: !Sub
        - "ALARM(${Alarm1}) OR ALARM(${Alarm2}) OR ALARM(${Alarm3}) OR ALARM(${Alarm4}) OR ALARM(${Alarm5}) OR ALARM(${Alarm6}) OR ALARM(${Alarm7}) OR ALARM(${Alarm8}) OR ALARM(${Alarm9})"
        - Alarm1: !GetAtt RDSCPUUtilization.Arn
          Alarm2: !GetAtt RDSDatabaseConnections.Arn
          Alarm3: !GetAtt RDSDeadlocks.Arn
          Alarm4: !GetAtt RDSNetworkTransmitThroughput.Arn
          Alarm5: !GetAtt RDSNetworkReceiveThroughput.Arn
          Alarm6: !GetAtt RDSQueries.Arn
          Alarm7: !GetAtt RDSDiskQueueDepth.Arn
          Alarm8: !GetAtt RDSReadLatency.Arn
          Alarm9: !GetAtt RDSWriteLatency.Arn

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Comprehensive monitoring and data extraction pipeline for QuickSight admin console'
Parameters:
  ScriptBucketName:
    Type: String
    Description: 'Name of the pre-existing S3 bucket containing Glue job scripts'
    Default: 'my-script-bucket'

Resources:
  EncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'

  OutputBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}'
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt EncryptionKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true

  OutputBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref OutputBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: firehose.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub '${OutputBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn:
                  - !GetAtt FirehoseStream1.Arn
                  - !GetAtt FirehoseStream2.Arn
                  - !GetAtt FirehoseStream3.Arn
                  - !GetAtt FirehoseStream4.Arn
                  - !GetAtt FirehoseStream5.Arn
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub '${OutputBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn:
                  - !GetAtt MetricStream1.Arn
                  - !GetAtt MetricStream2.Arn
                  - !GetAtt MetricStream3.Arn
                  - !GetAtt MetricStream4.Arn
                  - !GetAtt MetricStream5.Arn

  GlueRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: AdminSuiteRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AdminSuitePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - quicksight:Describe*
                  - quicksight:List*
                  - quicksight:Get*
                  - quicksight:Search*
                  - quicksight:PassDataSet
                  - quicksight:PassDataSource
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:GetJob
                  - glue:StartJobRun
                  - glue:GetJobRun
                  - glue:ListJobs
                  - glue:CreateJob
                  - glue:UpdateJob
                  - glue:DeleteJob
                  - glue:GetTrigger
                  - glue:StartTrigger
                  - glue:StopTrigger
                  - glue:CreateTrigger
                  - glue:UpdateTrigger
                  - glue:DeleteTrigger
                  - glue:BatchStopJobRun
                  - glue:GetJobBookmark
                  - glue:ResetJobBookmark
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ScriptBucketName}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ScriptBucketName}/*'
                  - !GetAtt OutputBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${OutputBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:PutRecord
                  - firehose:PutRecordBatch
                  - firehose:DescribeDeliveryStream
                  - firehose:ListDeliveryStreams
                  - firehose:CreateDeliveryStream
                  - firehose:UpdateDestination
                  - firehose:DeleteDeliveryStream
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt EncryptionKey.Arn

  # Python Shell Glue Jobs (5)
  AssetsAccessJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access
      Role: !GetAtt GlueRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucketName}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access.py'
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--region': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--account-id': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        '--script-bucket': !Ref ScriptBucketName
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      GlueVersion: '3.0'

  AssetsMetadataJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata
      Role: !GetAtt GlueRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucketName}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata.py'
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--region': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--account-id': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        '--script-bucket': !Ref ScriptBucketName
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      GlueVersion: '3.0'

  FolderAssetsJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets
      Role: !GetAtt GlueRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucketName}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets.py'
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--region': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--account-id': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        '--script-bucket': !Ref ScriptBucketName
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      GlueVersion: '3.0'

  QMetadataJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_q_metadata
      Role: !GetAtt GlueRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucketName}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_q_metadata.py'
        PythonVersion: '3.9'

        '--script-bucket': !Ref ScriptBucketName
