AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Shared VPC with EMR on EKS and Celeborn support, including VPC endpoints, flow logs, and NAT gateways.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the first public subnet.
  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the second public subnet.
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the first private subnet.
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.4.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the second private subnet.

Resources:
  # VPC
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VPC'

  # Internet Gateway
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-IGW'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Public Subnets (MapPublicIpOnLaunch set to false)
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet1'
        - Key: Type
          Value: Public

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet2'
        - Key: Type
          Value: Public

  # Private Subnets
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet1'
        - Key: Type
          Value: Private

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet2'
        - Key: Type
          Value: Private

  # Elastic IPs for NAT Gateways
  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment

  # NAT Gateways
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-NatGateway1'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-NatGateway2'

  # Public Route Table
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicRT'

  DefaultPublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Private Route Tables
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRT1'

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRT2'

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  # Subnet Route Table Associations
  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  # S3 Gateway Endpoint
  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PublicRouteTable
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  # Security Group for Interface Endpoints
  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for interface VPC endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VPC-Endpoints-SG'

  # Interface VPC Endpoints
  SSMEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  EC2Endpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  LogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  MonitoringEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.monitoring'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  STSEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sts'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  EMREndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.elasticmapreduce'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  KMSEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kms'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  # KMS Key for VPC Flow Logs (also used for CloudWatch Logs encryption)
  FlowLogKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting VPC Flow Logs and CloudWatch Logs group
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow Delivery Logs Service to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: delivery.logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow CloudWatch Logs Service to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: '*'
      Enabled: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FlowLogKmsKey'

  FlowLogKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-flow-log-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogKmsKey

  # IAM Role for VPC Flow Logs
  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FlowLogRole'

  # CloudWatch Logs Group for Flow Logs (encrypted with KMS key using ARN)
  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flow-logs/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: 90
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FlowLogsLogGroup'

  # VPC Flow Logs
  VPCFlowLogs:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VPCFlowLogs'

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'

  VpcCidr:
    Description: VPC CIDR block
    Value: !Ref VpcCidr
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcCidr'

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: Public subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet1Id'

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: Public subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet2Id'

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: Private subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet1Id'

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: Private subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet2Id'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Greenfield VPC with private subnets and optional public subnets across three AZs.

Parameters:
  VpcName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name tag for the VPC
    Default: 'MyVPC'
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9\-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens.
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Description: IPv4 CIDR block for the VPC (e.g., 10.0.0.0/16)
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.
  CreatePublicSubnets:
    Type: String
    Description: Set to "true" to include three public subnets, Internet Gateway, and public route table.
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'true'

Conditions:
  HasPublicSubnets: !Equals [!Ref CreatePublicSubnets, 'true']

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref VpcName

  VpcIpv6CidrBlock:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCCidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AmazonProvidedIpv6CidrBlock: true

  # Private Subnets (always)
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 6, 8]]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 6, 64]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-private-az1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 6, 8]]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 6, 64]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-private-az2'

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 6, 8]]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 6, 64]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-private-az3'

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-private-rt'

  PrivateSubnet1RouteAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet3RouteAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # Public resources (conditional)
  InternetGateway:
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 6, 8]]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 6, 64]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-public-az1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "IAM identities for Cluster API Provider for AWS (CAPA) bootstrap and operation"

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: Production
    Description: Environment tag value for all resources

Resources:
  # Control Plane Role
  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: ControlPlaneRole
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: "CAPA Control Plane"

  ControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: ControlPlaneInstanceProfile
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole

  ControlPlaneCloudProviderPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: ControlPlaneCloudProviderPolicy
      Path: /
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:Describe*
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
              - elasticloadbalancing:*
              - autoscaling:*
              - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
              - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:PutParameter
            Resource: "*"
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole

  # EKS Control Plane Role
  EKSControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: EKSControlPlaneRole
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: "CAPA EKS Control Plane"

  # Controllers Role
  ControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: ControllersRole
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: "CAPA Controllers"

  # ClusterAPIControllersPolicy
  ClusterAPIControllersPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: ClusterAPIControllersPolicy
      Path: /
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:*
              - elasticloadbalancing:*
              - autoscaling:*
              - eks:*
              - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
              - iam:GetRole
              - iam:PassRole
              - iam:CreateInstanceProfile
              - iam:DeleteInstanceProfile
              - iam:AddRoleToInstanceProfile
              - iam:RemoveRoleFromInstanceProfile
              - iam:GetInstanceProfile
              - iam:ListInstanceProfiles
              - iam:CreateRole
              - iam:DeleteRole
              - iam:AttachRolePolicy
              - iam:DetachRolePolicy
              - iam:PutRolePolicy
              - iam:DeleteRolePolicy
              - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
              - iam:ListRolePolicies
              - iam:TagRole
              - iam:UntagRole
              - iam:CreatePolicy
              - iam:DeletePolicy
              - iam:CreatePolicyVersion
              - iam:DeletePolicyVersion
              - iam:SetDefaultPolicyVersion
              - iam:CreateOpenIDConnectProvider
              - iam:DeleteOpenIDConnectProvider
              - iam:GetOpenIDConnectProvider
              - iam:ListOpenIDConnectProviders
              - iam:TagOpenIDConnectProvider
              - iam:UntagOpenIDConnectProvider
              - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
              - iam:DeleteServiceLinkedRole
              - iam:GetServiceLinkedRoleDeletionStatus
              - ecr:*
              - ssm:*
              - secretsmanager:*
            Resource: "*"
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole

  # Worker Node Role
  WorkerNodeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: WorkerNodeRole
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: "CAPA Worker Node"

  WorkerNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: WorkerNodeInstanceProfile
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref WorkerNodeRole

  # WorkerNodeCloudProviderPolicy
  WorkerNodeCloudProviderPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: WorkerNodeCloudProviderPolicy
      Path: /
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:Describe*
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:AttachNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
              - elasticloadbalancing:*
              - autoscaling:*
              - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
              - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:PutParameter
            Resource: "*"
      Roles:
        - !Ref WorkerNodeRole

  # IAM Group
  BootstrapperGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      GroupName: BootstrapperGroup
      Path: /
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ClusterAPIControllersPolicy

  # IAM User
  BootstrapperUser:
    Type: AWS::IAM::User
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserName: BootstrapperUser
      Path: /
      Groups:
        - !Ref BootstrapperGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

Outputs:
  ControlPlaneRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CAPA control plane role
    Value: !GetAtt ControlPlaneRole.Arn
  EKSControlPlaneRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EKS control plane role
    Value: !GetAtt EKSControlPlaneRole.Arn
  ControllersRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CAPA controllers role
    Value: !GetAtt ControllersRole.Arn
  WorkerNodeRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CAPA worker node role
    Value: !GetAtt WorkerNodeRole.Arn
  BootstrapperUserName:
    Description: IAM user name for bootstrapper
    Value: !Ref BootstrapperUser

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'VPC infrastructure for OpenSearch cross-region resilience with optional NAT Gateway deployment mode'

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    Description: Environment name used for tagging and resource naming
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
  PublicSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.101.0/24
    Description: CIDR for public subnet 1
  PublicSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.102.0/24
    Description: CIDR for public subnet 2
  PublicSubnet3CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.103.0/24
    Description: CIDR for public subnet 3
  PrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR for private subnet 1
  PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR for private subnet 2
  PrivateSubnet3CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    Description: CIDR for private subnet 3
  NatGatewayType:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - Single
      - PerAZ
    Default: Single
    Description: >
      Select 'Single' for one NAT Gateway in the first AZ (cost-effective) or
      'PerAZ' for one NAT Gateway per AZ (high availability)

Conditions:
  IsSingleNat: !Equals [!Ref NatGatewayType, 'Single']
  IsPerAZNat: !Equals [!Ref NatGatewayType, 'PerAZ']

Resources:
  # VPC
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # Internet Gateway
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Public Subnets
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Type
          Value: public

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Type
          Value: public

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet3CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Type
          Value: public

  # Private Subnets
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Type
          Value: private

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Type
          Value: private

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet3CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Type
          Value: private

  # Public Route Table and Routes
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3

  # Conditional NAT Gateway Resources for Single mode
  NatGatewayEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: IsSingleNat
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsSingleNat
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRouteTableSingle:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: IsSingleNat
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-single'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRouteSingle:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: IsSingleNat
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableSingle
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation1Single:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsSingleNat
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableSingle
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation2Single:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsSingleNat
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableSingle
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation3Single:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsSingleNat
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableSingle
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3

  # Conditional NAT Gateway Resources for PerAZ mode
  NatGatewayEIP1PerAZ:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: IsPerAZNat
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-peraz-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGatewayEIP2PerAZ:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: IsPerAZNat
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-peraz-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGatewayEIP3PerAZ:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: IsPerAZNat
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-peraz-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway1PerAZ:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsPerAZNat
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP1PerAZ.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-peraz-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway2PerAZ:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsPerAZNat
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP2PerAZ.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-peraz-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway3PerAZ:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsPerAZNat
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP3PerAZ.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-peraz-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRouteTablePerAZ1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: IsPerAZNat
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-peraz-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRoutePerAZ1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: IsPerAZNat
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTablePerAZ1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1PerAZ

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation1PerAZ:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsPerAZNat
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTablePerAZ1
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateRouteTablePerAZ2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: IsPerAZNat
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-peraz-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRoutePerAZ2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: IsPerAZNat
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTablePerAZ2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2PerAZ

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation2PerAZ:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsPerAZNat
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTablePerAZ2
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  PrivateRouteTablePerAZ3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: IsPerAZNat
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-peraz-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRoutePerAZ3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: IsPerAZNat
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTablePerAZ3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway3PerAZ

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation3PerAZ:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsPerAZNat
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTablePerAZ3
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3

  # VPC Flow Logs
  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: flow-log-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-flow-log-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  FlowLogLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc-flow-logs/${EnvironmentName}'
      RetentionInDays: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-flow-log-group'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceType: VPC
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-flow-log'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-id'

  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-delimited list of public subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2, !Ref PublicSubnet3]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-ids'

  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-delimited list of private subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2, !Ref PrivateSubnet3]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-ids'

  InternetGatewayId:
    Description: Internet Gateway ID
    Value: !Ref InternetGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-igw-id'

  NatGatewayIds:
    Description: NAT Gateway IDs (comma-delimited list when PerAZ, single ID when Single)
    Value: !If
      - IsSingleNat
      - !Ref NatGateway1
      - !Join [',', [!Ref NatGateway1PerAZ, !Ref NatGateway2PerAZ, !Ref NatGateway3PerAZ]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway-ids'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'AI-Powered Customer Support: Isolated VPC with Private Subnets, VPC Endpoints, Flow Logs, and Application Security Groups'

Mappings:
  SubnetConfig:
    '0':
      CIDR: 10.0.1.0/24
    '1':
      CIDR: 10.0.2.0/24
    '2':
      CIDR: 10.0.3.0/24

Resources:
  # VPC
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: AI-CustomerSupport

  # Private Subnets (3 AZs)
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select ['0', !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, '0', CIDR]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: private-subnet-1

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select ['1', !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, '1', CIDR]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: private-subnet-2

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select ['2', !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, '2', CIDR]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: private-subnet-3

  # Private Route Table
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: private-route-table

  # Subnet to Route Table Associations
  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # Gateway VPC Endpoints (S3 and DynamoDB)
  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  DynamoDbGatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.dynamodb'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # Shared Security Group for Interface VPC Endpoints
  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for interface VPC endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: endpoint-sg

  # Interface VPC Endpoints
  BedrockEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.bedrock'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  EcrApiEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  EcrDkrEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.dkr'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  CloudWatchLogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  CloudWatchMonitoringEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.monitoring'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  RdsDataEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.rds-data'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  SecretsManagerEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.secretsmanager'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  SSMEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  KMSEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kms'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  XRayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.xray'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  # KMS Key for VPC Flow Logs Encryption
  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for VPC Flow Logs encryption
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow CloudWatch Logs to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: '*'

  # CloudWatch Logs Log Group for VPC Flow Logs
  VpcFlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/vpc-flow-logs/ai-customer-support
      RetentionInDays: 90
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn

  # IAM Role for VPC Flow Logs
  VpcFlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcFlowLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn

  # VPC Flow Logs
  VpcFlowLogs:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref VpcFlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogsRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60

  # Application Component Security Groups
  AgentRuntimeSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Agent Runtime component
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationSecurityGroupId: !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: agent-runtime-sg

  MCPRuntimeSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for MCP Runtime component
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationSecurityGroupId: !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: mcp-runtime-sg

  LambdaSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Lambda functions
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationSecurityGroupId: !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: lambda-sg

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/16"
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: "CIDR block for the EKS VPC"
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: "MyEKSCluster"
    Description: "Name used to tag all resources"
  PublicSubnetCIDR0:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.1.0/24"
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: "CIDR for public subnet in AZ 0"
  PublicSubnetCIDR1:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.2.0/24"
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: "CIDR for public subnet in AZ 1"
  PublicSubnetCIDR2:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.3.0/24"
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: "CIDR for public subnet in AZ 2"
  PrivateSubnetCIDR0:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.11.0/24"
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: "CIDR for private subnet in AZ 0"
  PrivateSubnetCIDR1:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.12.0/24"
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: "CIDR for private subnet in AZ 1"
  PrivateSubnetCIDR2:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.13.0/24"
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: "CIDR for private subnet in AZ 2"
  AppGatewayIngressPorts:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: "80,443,8443,15021"
    Description: "Additional TCP ports to open on the ingress security group"

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-IGW"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PublicRouteTable"

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet0:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCIDR0
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PublicSubnet-0"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: "1"

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCIDR1
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PublicSubnet-1"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: "1"

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCIDR2
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PublicSubnet-2"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: "1"

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation0:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet0
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  EIP0:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-NAT-EIP-0"
  EIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-NAT-EIP-1"
  EIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-NAT-EIP-2"

  NatGateway0:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP0.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-NATGW-0"
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-NATGW-1"
  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-NATGW-2"

  PrivateSubnet0:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnetCIDR0
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnet-0"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: "1"
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnetCIDR1
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnet-1"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: "1"
  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnetCIDR2
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnet-2"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: "1"

  PrivateRouteTable0:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PrivateRouteTable-0"
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PrivateRouteTable-1"
  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PrivateRouteTable-2"

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation0:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet0
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable0
  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  PrivateRoute0:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: NatGateway0
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable0
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway0
  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: NatGateway1
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1
  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: NatGateway2
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  EksControlPlaneSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: "EKS Control Plane to worker node communication"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCIDR
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 10250
          ToPort: 10250
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCIDR
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-EKSControlPlaneSG"

  AppGatewaySecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: "Security group for ingress/mesh gateway"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: "0.0.0.0/0"
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: "0.0.0.0/0"
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-AppGatewaySG"

  AppGatewayIngressPort0:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref AppGatewaySecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: !Select [0, !Ref AppGatewayIngressPorts]
      ToPort: !Select [0, !Ref AppGatewayIngressPorts]
      CidrIp: "0.0.0.0/0"
  AppGatewayIngressPort1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref AppGatewaySecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: !Select [1, !Ref AppGatewayIngressPorts]
      ToPort: !Select [1, !Ref AppGatewayIngressPorts]
      CidrIp: "0.0.0.0/0"
  AppGatewayIngressPort2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref AppGatewaySecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: !Select [2, !Ref AppGatewayIngressPorts]
      ToPort: !Select [2, !Ref AppGatewayIngressPorts]
      CidrIp: "0.0.0.0/0"
  AppGatewayIngressPort3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref AppGatewaySecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: !Select [3, !Ref AppGatewayIngressPorts]
      ToPort: !Select [3, !Ref AppGatewayIngressPorts]
      CidrIp: "0.0.0.0/0"

Outputs:

Parameters:
  ResourceNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^[a-zA-Z0-9\\-]+$"
  EKSClusterName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
  VpcId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^vpc-[a-f0-9]{8,17}$"
  SecurityGroupIds:
    Type: List<String>
    Default: ""
  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Type: List<String>
    Default: ""
  LifecycleScriptsBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^[a-z0-9\\.\\-]{3,63}$"
  RIGInputBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^[a-z0-9\\.\\-]{3,63}$"
  RIGOutputBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^[a-z0-9\\.\\-]{3,63}$"
  CreateRIGResources:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "false"
  EnableGatedAccess:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "false"

Conditions:
  CreateRIGResourcesTrue: !Equals [!Ref CreateRIGResources, "true"]
  EnableGatedAccessTrue: !Equals [!Ref EnableGatedAccess, "true"]
  HasRIGInputBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref RIGInputBucketName, ""]]
  HasRIGOutputBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref RIGOutputBucketName, ""]]
  CreateRIGWithInput: !And [!Condition CreateRIGResourcesTrue, !Condition HasRIGInputBucket]
  HasLifecycleS3Bucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref LifecycleScriptsBucketName, ""]]

Resources:
  SageMakerHyperPodExecRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerClusterInstanceRolePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EKSCNIPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AttachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                Resource: "*"
        - PolicyName: ENIManagementAndServiceAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:ec2:*:*:instance/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:ec2:*:*:network-interface/*"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    ec2:Vpc: !Ref VpcId
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeDhcpOptions
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: eks-auth:AssumeRoleForPodIdentity
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:eks:*:*:cluster/${EKSClusterName}"
              - !If
                - HasLifecycleS3Bucket
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:ListBucket
                    - s3:GetObject
                  Resource:
                    - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${LifecycleScriptsBucketName}"
                    - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${LifecycleScriptsBucketName}/*"
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Tags:
        - Key: SageMakerHyperPodPrerequisite
          Value: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole"

  RIGInputPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: CreateRIGWithInput
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}-RIG-Input"
      Roles:
        - !Ref SageMakerHyperPodExecRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:ListBucket
              - s3:GetObject
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${RIGInputBucketName}"
              - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${RIGInputBucketName}/*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                lambda:FunctionName:
                  - "*SageMaker*"
                  - "*sagemaker*"

  RIGOutputPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: HasRIGOutputBucket
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}-RIG-Output"
      Roles:
        - !Ref SageMakerHyperPodExecRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:DeleteObject
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${RIGOutputBucketName}"
              - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${RIGOutputBucketName}/*"

  GatedAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: EnableGatedAccessTrue
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}-GatedAccess"
      Roles:
        - !Ref SageMakerHyperPodExecRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: s3:GetObject
            Resource:
              - !If
                - HasRIGInputBucket
                - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${RIGInputBucketName}"
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              - !If
                - HasRIGInputBucket
                - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${RIGInputBucketName}/*"
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              - "arn:aws:s3:*:*:accesspoint/*/object/*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sqs:ReceiveMessage
              - sqs:DeleteMessage
              - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
              - sqs:SendMessage
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                sqs:QueueName:
                  - "*SageMaker*"
                  - "*sagemaker*"

  SubnetENIPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}-SubnetENI"
      Roles:
        - !Ref SageMakerHyperPodExecRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
              - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              ForAllValues:StringLike:
                ec2:Subnet: !Ref PrivateSubnetIds

  SecurityGroupENIPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}-SecurityGroupENI"
      Roles:
        - !Ref SageMakerHyperPodExecRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
              - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              ForAllValues:StringLike:
                ec2:SecurityGroup: !Ref SecurityGroupIds

Outputs:
  RoleName:
    Description: Name of the SageMaker HyperPod execution role
    Value: !Ref SageMakerHyperPodExecRole
  RoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the SageMaker HyperPod execution role
    Value: !GetAtt SageMakerHyperPodExecRole.Arn

      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Deny
            Action: "iam:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Deny
            Action:

          - Effect: Allow
            Action: "*"
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                "aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent": "true"

  IAMAdminPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: IAMAdministratorPolicy

        Version: "2012-10-17"

              - "kms:UpdateKeyDescription"
              - "kms:PutKeyPolicy"
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringEqualsIgnoreCase:

          - Effect: Allow
            Action: "*"
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                "aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent": "true"

          - Effect: Deny

            Condition:
              Bool:

        Statement:
          - Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - "aws-portal:*"
              - "billing:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Deny
            Action:

              - "cloudwatch:Get*"

              - "elasticloadbalancing:Get*"

              - "kms:Get*"

              - "s3:List*"

              Bool:

    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

        Statement:

            Action:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "VPC with three-tier subnets across three AZs, NAT Gateways, and Internet Gateway."

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: MyVPC

  # Internet Gateway
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: MyIGW

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Web Tier Subnets (across 3 AZs)
  WebSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebSubnet1

  WebSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebSubnet2

  WebSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.3.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebSubnet3

  # Application Tier Subnets
  AppSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.4.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AppSubnet1

  AppSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.5.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AppSubnet2

  AppSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.6.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AppSubnet3

  # Database Tier Subnets
  DbSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.7.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: DbSubnet1

  DbSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.8.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: DbSubnet2

  DbSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.9.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: DbSubnet3

  # Web Route Table and Routes
  WebRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebRouteTable

  WebDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  WebSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  WebSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  WebSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  # Elastic IPs for NAT Gateways
  NatEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatEIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatEIP3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  # NAT Gateways in each web subnet
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: NatGateway1

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: NatGateway2

  NatGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP3.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: NatGateway3

  # Application Tier Route Tables and Routes
  AppRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AppRouteTable1

  AppDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  AppSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable1

  AppRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AppRouteTable2

  AppDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  AppSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable2

  AppRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AppRouteTable3

  AppDefaultRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway3

  AppSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable3

  # Database Tier Route Tables and Routes
  DbRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: DbRouteTable1

  DbDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  DbSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable1

  DbRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: DbRouteTable2

  DbDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  DbSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable2

  DbRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: DbRouteTable3

  DbDefaultRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway3

  DbSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable3

Outputs:
  VPCId:
    Description: "VPC ID"
    Value: !Ref VPC
  AvailabilityZones:
    Description: "List of Availability Zones used"
    Value: !Join
      - ","
      - - !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
        - !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
        - !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
  WebSubnetIds:
    Description: "List of Web Subnet IDs"
    Value: !Join
      - ","
      - - !Ref WebSubnet1
        - !Ref WebSubnet2
        - !Ref WebSubnet3
  AppSubnetIds:
    Description: "List of Application Subnet IDs"
    Value: !Join
      - ","
      - - !Ref AppSubnet1
        - !Ref AppSubnet2
        - !Ref AppSubnet3
  DbSubnetIds:
    Description: "List of Database Subnet IDs"
    Value: !Join
      - ","
      - - !Ref DbSubnet1
        - !Ref DbSubnet2
