AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates shared IAM roles, instance profiles, and SSM parameters required by
  the Amazon EKS Quick Start stacks. All roles use the prefix 'eks-quickstart'
  and parameter values are stored under /quickstart/amazon-eks/.

Resources:
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. General Lambda Execution Role
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-lambda-execution-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EKSQuickStartLambdaExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes
                  - ec2:DescribeAddresses
                  - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
                  - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:ListFunctions
                  - lambda:DeleteFunction
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:PutParameter
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:SignalResource
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:CreateFargateProfile
                  - eks:DeleteFargateProfile
                  - eks:DescribeFargateProfile
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:AssumeRole
                Resource: !GetAtt RoleCreationRole.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:RegisterType
                  - cloudformation:SetTypeDefaultVersion
                Resource: '*'

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. EKS Control Plane Role
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  EKSControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-eks-control-plane-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSServicePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EKSControlPlaneAdditionalPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes
                  - ec2:DescribeAddresses
                  - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
                Resource: '*'

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. Fargate Execution Role
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  FargateExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-fargate-execution-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FargateExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                Resource: '*'

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4. Managed Node Instance Role and Instance Profile
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  ManagedNodeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-managed-node-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemReadOnlyAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudFormationSignalPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:SignalResource
                Resource: '*'

  ManagedNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: eks-quickstart-managed-node-instance-profile
      Roles:
        - !Ref ManagedNodeRole

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 5. Unmanaged Node Instance Role and Instance Profile
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  UnmanagedNodeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-unmanaged-node-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemReadOnlyAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudFormationSignalPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:SignalResource
                Resource: '*'

  UnmanagedNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: eks-quickstart-unmanaged-node-instance-profile
      Roles:
        - !Ref UnmanagedNodeRole

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 6. Role Creation Role
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  RoleCreationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-role-creation-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CreateVpcRolePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateRole
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/CloudFormation-Kubernetes-VPC'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/CloudFormation-Kubernetes-VPC'
                Condition:
                  ArnEquals:
                    iam:PolicyARN:
                      - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaENIManagementAccess'
                      - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 7. SSM Parameters for Role ARNs
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaExecutionRoleSSM:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /quickstart/amazon-eks/lambda-execution-role
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Description: ARN of the Lambda execution role for EKS QuickStart

  EKSControlPlaneRoleSSM:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /quickstart/amazon-eks/eks-control-plane-role
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt EKSControlPlaneRole.Arn
      Description: ARN of the EKS control plane role

  FargateExecutionRoleSSM:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /quickstart/amazon-eks/fargate-execution-role
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt FargateExecutionRole.Arn
      Description: ARN of the Fargate execution role

  ManagedNodeRoleSSM:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /quickstart/amazon-eks/managed-node-role
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt ManagedNodeRole.Arn
      Description: ARN of the managed node instance role

  UnmanagedNodeRoleSSM:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /quickstart/amazon-eks/unmanaged-node-role
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt UnmanagedNodeRole.Arn
      Description: ARN of the unmanaged node instance role

  RoleCreationRoleSSM:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /quickstart/amazon-eks/role-creation-role
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt RoleCreationRole.Arn
      Description: ARN of the role creation role for Lambda to create the VPC IAM role

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Lab VPC with web and app subnets, S3 gateway endpoint, Kinesis interface endpoints
Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR for the VPC
  WebSubnetACidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR for web subnet in AZ1
  WebSubnetBCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR for web subnet in AZ2
  AppSubnetACidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    Description: CIDR for app subnet in AZ1
  AppSubnetBCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.4.0/24
    Description: CIDR for app subnet in AZ2
Resources:
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: LabVpc
  WebSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref WebSubnetACidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebSubnetA
  WebSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref WebSubnetBCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebSubnetB
  AppSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref AppSubnetACidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AppSubnetA
  AppSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref AppSubnetBCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AppSubnetB
  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: SharedRouteTable
  WebSubnetARouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnetA
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
  WebSubnetBRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation

      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnetB

    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation

      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
  AppSubnetBRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnetB
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
  WebSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for web tier allowing HTTPS from VPC CIDR
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt Vpc.CidrBlock
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: !GetAtt Vpc.CidrBlock

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions shared IAM roles and instance profiles required for multi-cluster
  EKS deployments using Lambda-backed custom resources. All resource names are
  derived from the provided prefix.

Parameters:
  Prefix:
    Type: String
    Default: eks-shared
    Description: Common prefix for all IAM role and instance profile names.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. Lambda execution role – copy deployment assets between S3 buckets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaCopyAssetsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${Prefix}-lambda-copy-assets
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CopyAssetsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. Lambda execution role – read arbitrary AWS resources
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaReadArbitraryResourcesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${Prefix}-lambda-read-arbitrary-resources
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ReadArbitraryResourcesPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:Describe*
                  - elasticloadbalancing:Describe*
                  - autoscaling:Describe*
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:GetPolicy
                  - iam:ListRoles
                  - iam:ListPolicies
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                  - lambda:ListFunctions
                  - lambda:GetFunction
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:ListStacks
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. Lambda execution role – create a VPC‑related IAM role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaCreateVpcRoleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${Prefix}-lambda-create-vpc-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CreateVpcRolePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateRole
                  - iam:PutRolePolicy
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4. Lambda execution role – delete contents of S3 buckets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaDeleteBucketContentsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${Prefix}-lambda-delete-bucket-contents
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DeleteBucketContentsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:DeleteObjectVersion
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 5. Lambda execution role – clean up orphaned load balancers, security
  #    groups, and network interfaces
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaCleanupLoadBalancersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${Prefix}-lambda-cleanup-load-balancers
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CleanupLoadBalancersPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 6. Lambda execution role – clean up leftover Lambda functions
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaCleanupLambdaFunctionsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${Prefix}-lambda-cleanup-lambda-functions
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CleanupLambdaFunctionsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:ListFunctions
                  - lambda:DeleteFunction
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 7. Lambda execution role – look up the calling identity
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaLookupCallingIdentityRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${Prefix}-lambda-lookup-calling-identity
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LookupCallingIdentityPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 8. Lambda execution role – register CloudFormation resource provider types
  #    and associated custom resources
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaRegisterCFNTypesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${Prefix}-lambda-register-cfn-types
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: RegisterCFNTypesPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:RegisterType
                  - cloudformation:DeregisterType
                  - cloudformation:DescribeType
                  - cloudformation:ListTypes
                  - cloudformation:ListTypeVersions
                  - cloudformation:SetTypeDefaultVersion
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 9. Lambda execution role – resolve Systems Manager parameters under a
  #    common configuration path
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaResolveSSMParametersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${Prefix}-lambda-resolve-ssm-parameters
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ResolveSSMParametersPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 10. Lambda execution role – create the IAM role that CloudFormation assumes
  #     when provisioning cluster VPC resources
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaCreateCFNRoleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${Prefix}-lambda-create-cfn-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CreateCFNRolePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateRole
                  - iam:PutRolePolicy
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 11. EKS control plane IAM role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EKSControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${Prefix}-eks-control-plane
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 12. Fargate pod execution IAM role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FargatePodExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${Prefix}-fargate-pod-execution
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSFargatePodExecutionRolePolicy

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 13. Managed node – EC2 instance role and instance profile
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ManagedNodeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${Prefix}-managed-node
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemReadOnlyAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudFormationSignalPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:SignalResource
                Resource: '*'

  ManagedNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub ${Prefix}-managed-node
      Roles:
        - !Ref ManagedNodeRole

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 14. Unmanaged node – EC2 instance role and instance profile
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UnmanagedNodeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${Prefix}-unmanaged-node
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemReadOnlyAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudFormationSignalPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:SignalResource
                Resource: '*'

  UnmanagedNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub ${Prefix}-unmanaged-node
      Roles:
        - !Ref UnmanagedNodeRole

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Outputs:
  # Lambda role ARNs
  LambdaCopyAssetsRoleArn:
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaCopyAssetsRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${Prefix}-lambda-copy-assets-Arn

    Value: !GetAtt LambdaReadArbitraryResourcesRole.Arn

  FargatePodExecutionRoleArn:

    Export:

    Default: "999hadvhgchjesr"

Resources:
  # Secret containing username and generated password
  MinesweeperSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: "Minesweeper user secret"
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: '{"username": "minesweeper-user"}'
        GenerateStringKey: "password"
        PasswordLength: 15
        RequireEachIncludedType: true
        ExcludeCharacters: "|;,.<>%`"

  # IAM group with full permissions on EC2, CloudFormation, and Secrets Manager
  MinesweeperGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub "minesweeper-${ID}"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FullAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "ec2:*"
                  - "cloudformation:*"
                  - "secretsmanager:*"
                Resource: "*"

  # IAM role for the Lambda function that creates the IAM user
  LambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SecretAndIAM
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                Resource: !Ref MinesweeperSecret
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateUser
                  - iam:CreateLoginProfile
                  - iam:DeleteUser
                  - iam:DeleteLoginProfile
                  - iam:UpdateLoginProfile
                  - iam:GetUser
                Resource: "*"

  # Lambda function to create the IAM user using the secret values
  CreateUserFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import json
          import cfnresponse

          def handler(event, context):
              secret_arn = event['ResourceProperties']['SecretArn']
              iam = boto3.client('iam')
              secrets = boto3.client('secretsmanager')

              request_type = event['RequestType']
              physical_resource_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId', None)

              try:
                  if request_type == 'Create':
                      response = secrets.get_secret_value(SecretId=secret_arn)
                      secret = json.loads(response['SecretString'])
                      username = secret['username']
                      password = secret['password']

                      iam.create_user(UserName=username)
                      iam.create_login_profile(
                          UserName=username,
                          Password=password,
                          PasswordResetRequired=False
                      )
                      user_arn = iam.get_user(UserName=username)['User']['Arn']
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS,
                          {'Arn': user_arn, 'UserName': username}, username)

                  elif request_type == 'Update':
                      response = secrets.get_secret_value(SecretId=secret_arn)
                      secret = json.loads(response['SecretString'])
                      username = secret['username']
                      password = secret['password']

                      iam.update_login_profile(
                          UserName=username,
                          Password=password,
                          PasswordResetRequired=False
                      )
                      user_arn = iam.get_user(UserName=username)['User']['Arn']
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS,
                          {'Arn': user_arn, 'UserName': username}, physical_resource_id)

                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      if physical_resource_id:
                          try:
                              iam.delete_login_profile(UserName=physical_resource_id)
                          except Exception:
                              pass
                          try:
                              iam.delete_user(UserName=physical_resource_id)
                          except Exception:
                              pass
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})

              except Exception as e:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'Error': str(e)})

  CreateUserCustomResource:
    Type: Custom::CreateUser
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt CreateUserFunction.Arn
      SecretArn: !Ref MinesweeperSecret

  # Adds the created user to the IAM group
  UserToGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::UserToGroupAddition
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub "minesweeper-${ID}"
      Users:
        - !GetAtt CreateUserCustomResource.UserName
    DependsOn:
      - MinesweeperGroup

Outputs:
  UserArn:
    Description: ARN of the created IAM user
    Value: !GetAtt CreateUserCustomResource.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Dedicated IAM user and group for SES SMTP sending with automated SMTP credential generation and storage in SSM Parameter Store'
Parameters:
  IamUsername:
    Type: String
    Default: SMTPUser
    Description: Desired IAM username for the SMTP user.
  RotationVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: '1'
    Description: Version number used as a suffix in the SSM parameter paths to track credential rotations.
  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: Retention period in days for Lambda execution logs.
  KmsKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: (Optional) ARN of a customer-managed KMS key to encrypt the SSM parameters. If empty, the default AWS-managed key is used.
Conditions:
  NonEmptyKmsKeyArn: !Not [!Equals [!Ref KmsKeyArn, '']]
Resources:
  SmtpSendingGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: SmtpSendingGroup

  SmtpSendingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: SmtpSendingPolicy
      Groups:
        - !Ref SmtpSendingGroup
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ses:SendEmail
              - ses:SendRawEmail
            Resource: '*'

  SmtpUser:
    Type: AWS::IAM::User
    Properties:
      UserName: !Ref IamUsername

  SmtpUserGroupAttachment:
    Type: AWS::IAM::UserToGroupAddition
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Ref SmtpSendingGroup
      Users:
        - !Ref SmtpUser

  SmtpAccessKey:
    Type: AWS::IAM::AccessKey
    Properties:
      UserName: !Ref SmtpUser
      Status: Active

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SsmPutParameters
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:PutParameter
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:*:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/smtp/${IamUsername}/*

  LambdaLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/SmtpCredentialConverter-${IamUsername}
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  LambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: LambdaLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub SmtpCredentialConverter-${IamUsername}
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, boto3, base64, hmac, hashlib, logging, urllib3

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
          ssm = boto3.client('ssm')
          http = urllib3.PoolManager()

          def generate_smtp_password(secret_access_key):
              # AWS SES SMTP credential generation algorithm
              # Password = base64(HMAC-SHA256(SecretAccessKey, "SendRawEmail"))
              key = secret_access_key.encode('utf-8')
              msg = b'SendRawEmail'
              digest = hmac.new(key, msg, hashlib.sha256).digest()
              return base64.b64encode(digest).decode('utf-8')

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              logger.info('Received event: %s', json.dumps(event))
              request_type = event['RequestType']
              props = event['ResourceProperties']
              username = props['IamUsername']
              access_key = props['AccessKeyId']
              secret_key = props['SecretAccessKey']
              version = props.get('RotationVersion', '1')
              kms_key = props.get('KmsKeyArn', '')

              base_path = f'/smtp/{username}/v{version}'
              username_path = f'{base_path}/smtp-username'
              password_path = f'{base_path}/smtp-password'

              physical_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId', f'SMTPCreds-{username}-{version}')

              if request_type in ('Create', 'Update'):
                  smtp_password = generate_smtp_password(secret_key)
                  params = [
                      {'Name': username_path, 'Value': access_key},
                      {'Name': password_path, 'Value': smtp_password},
                  ]
                  for param in params:
                      kwargs = {
                          'Name': param['Name'],
                          'Value': param['Value'],
                          'Type': 'SecureString',
                          'Overwrite': True
                      }
                      if kms_key:
                          kwargs['KeyId'] = kms_key
                      ssm.put_parameter(**kwargs)
                  logger.info('Stored parameters successfully')
              elif request_type == 'Delete':
                  # Do NOT delete SSM parameters to prevent accidental data loss.
                  logger.info('Delete requested - parameters preserved')

              response_body = {
                  'Status': 'SUCCESS',
                  'Reason': f'See execution logs in {context.log_group_name}:{context.log_stream_name}',
                  'PhysicalResourceId': physical_id,
                  'StackId': event['StackId'],
                  'RequestId': event['RequestId'],
                  'LogicalResourceId': event['LogicalResourceId'],
              }
              try:
                  http.request('PUT', event['ResponseURL'],
                               body=json.dumps(response_body).encode(),
                               headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'})
                  logger.info('Response sent')
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error('Failed to send response: %s', e)
                  raise

  SmtpCredentialCustomResource:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    DependsOn: SmtpAccessKey
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt LambdaFunction.Arn
      AccessKeyId: !Ref SmtpAccessKey
      SecretAccessKey: !GetAtt SmtpAccessKey.SecretAccessKey
      IamUsername: !Ref IamUsername
      RotationVersion: !Ref RotationVersion
      KmsKeyArn: !If [NonEmptyKmsKeyArn, !Ref KmsKeyArn, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']

Outputs:
  SmtpUsernameParameter:
    Description: SSM parameter path containing the SMTP username (Access Key ID).
    Value: !Sub /smtp/${IamUsername}/v${RotationVersion}/smtp-username
  SmtpPasswordParameter:
    Description: SSM parameter path containing the SMTP password (converted secret).
    Value: !Sub /smtp/${IamUsername}/v${RotationVersion}/smtp-password

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  WebSocket API for grant-processing job status updates.
  Creates API Gateway WebSocket API, Lambda function, DynamoDB connections table,
  KMS keys for encryption, and CloudWatch logging infrastructure.

Parameters:
  AdditionalKmsDecryptRoles:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ""
    Description: >
      Optional list of IAM role ARNs (besides the Lambda execution role)
      that are allowed to decrypt the Lambda environment variable KMS key.
  LogGroupRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: Number of days to retain API Gateway execution logs.

Conditions:
  HasAdditionalRoles: !Not [!Equals [!Join [",", !Ref AdditionalKmsDecryptRoles], ""]]

Resources:
  # ============================================================
  # First KMS Key for Lambda environment variable encryption
  # ============================================================
  LambdaEnvKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting Lambda environment variables
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "Allow account to manage key"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - !If
            - HasAdditionalRoles
            -
              Sid: "Allow additional roles to decrypt"
              Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: !Ref AdditionalKmsDecryptRoles
              Action:
                - "kms:Decrypt"
                - "kms:DescribeKey"
              Resource: "*"
            - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT

  LambdaEnvKmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/lambda-env-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref LambdaEnvKmsKey

  # ============================================================
  # DynamoDB table for WebSocket connections
  # ============================================================
  ConnectionsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: WebSocketConnections
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST

  # ============================================================
  # Lambda function execution role
  # ============================================================
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaDynamoDBKMSAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                Resource: !GetAtt ConnectionsTable.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt LambdaEnvKmsKey.Arn

  # ============================================================
  # Lambda function (Python 3.12)
  # ============================================================
  WebSocketHandlerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: WebSocketHandler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      KmsKeyArn: !GetAtt LambdaEnvKmsKey.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          CONNECTIONS_TABLE: !Ref ConnectionsTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table_name = os.environ['CONNECTIONS_TABLE']
          table = dynamodb.Table(table_name)

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              route_key = event.get('requestContext', {}).get('routeKey')
              connection_id = event.get('requestContext', {}).get('connectionId')
              domain_name = event.get('requestContext', {}).get('domainName')
              stage = event.get('requestContext', {}).get('stage')
              endpoint_url = f'https://{domain_name}/{stage}'

              if route_key == '$connect':
                  table.put_item(Item={'connectionId': connection_id})
                  return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'Connected'}
              elif route_key == '$disconnect':
                  table.delete_item(Key={'connectionId': connection_id})
                  return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'Disconnected'}
              elif route_key == 'sendStatus':
                  return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'Status route acknowledged'}
              else:
                  return {'statusCode': 400, 'body': 'Unknown route'}
      Description: Handler for WebSocket events
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebSocketHandler

  # ============================================================
  # API Gateway WebSocket API
  # ============================================================
  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: GrantProcessingWebSocketApi
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: "$request.body.action"
      Description: WebSocket API for grant processing status updates

  # ============================================================
  # WebSocket Integration (AWS_PROXY)
  # ============================================================
  LambdaIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !GetAtt WebSocketHandlerFunction.Arn
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      PassthroughBehavior: WHEN_NO_MATCH

  # ============================================================
  # Routes
  # ============================================================
  ConnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $connect
      Target: !Sub "integrations/${LambdaIntegration}"

  DisconnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $disconnect
      Target: !Sub "integrations/${LambdaIntegration}"

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $default
      Target: !Sub "integrations/${LambdaIntegration}"

  CustomRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: sendStatus
      Target: !Sub "integrations/${LambdaIntegration}"

  # ============================================================
  # Lambda resource-based policies for API Gateway invocation
  # ============================================================
  LambdaPermissionConnect:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref WebSocketHandlerFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*/$$connect"

  LambdaPermissionDisconnect:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref WebSocketHandlerFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*/$$disconnect"

  LambdaPermissionDefault:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref WebSocketHandlerFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*/$$default"

  LambdaPermissionSendStatus:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref WebSocketHandlerFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*/sendStatus"

  # ============================================================
  # Second KMS Key for CloudWatch Logs log group encryption
  # ============================================================
  CloudWatchLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting API Gateway CloudWatch Logs
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "Allow account to manage key"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: "Allow CloudWatch Logs to use key"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:

            Action:
              - "kms:Encrypt"
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
            Resource: "*"
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT

  CloudWatchLogsKmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/gateway-logs-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref CloudWatchLogsKmsKey

  # ============================================================
  # CloudWatch Logs log group for API Gateway execution logs
  # ============================================================
  ApiGatewayLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/apigateway/${WebSocketApi}"
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogGroupRetentionDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt CloudWatchLogsKmsKey.Arn

  # ============================================================

  # ============================================================

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonAPIGatewayPushToCloudWatchLogs

  # ============================================================
  # API Gateway Account settings (CloudWatch role)
  # ============================================================
  ApiGatewayAccount:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Account

      CloudWatchRoleArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayLoggingRole.Arn

  # ============================================================
  # API Gateway Deployment and Stage
  # ============================================================
  WebSocketDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - ConnectRoute
      - DisconnectRoute
      - DefaultRoute
      - CustomRoute
      - LambdaIntegration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      Description: Initial deployment

  WebSocketStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    DependsOn: ApiGatewayAccount

      StageName: prod

          {"requestId":"$context.requestId","ip":"$context.identity.sourceIp",

          "requestTime":"$context.requestTime","eventType":"$context.eventType",
          "routeKey":"$context.routeKey","status":"$context.status",
          "connectionId":"$context.connectionId"}
      RouteSettings:
        $default:
          LoggingLevel: INFO
          DataTraceEnabled: true
          ThrottlingBurstLimit: 1000
          ThrottlingRateLimit: 1000
      DefaultRouteSettings:
        LoggingLevel: INFO
        DataTraceEnabled: true
        ThrottlingBurstLimit: 1000
        ThrottlingRateLimit: 1000
      StageVariables: {}
      Tags:
        Name: prod-stage

# ============================================================

Outputs:

    Value: !Sub "wss://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${WebSocketStage}"

Description: 'IAM roles and instance profile for CodeDeploy and CodePipeline demo with KMS encryption'

Resources:
  # KMS Customer Managed Key for S3 bucket encryption
  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: 'CMK for pipeline artifact bucket'
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAdminPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 7

  # KMS Alias for easier reference
  KmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/pipeline-artifacts-${AWS::AccountId}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  # S3 bucket for pipeline artifacts with SSE-KMS
  PipelineArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'pipeline-artifacts-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref KmsKey
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  # Bucket policy to restrict access to CodePipeline role only
  # No explicit DependsOn needed; !GetAtt creates implicit dependency
  PipelineArtifactBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref PipelineArtifactBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCodePipelineAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt CodePipelineServiceRole.Arn
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:PutObjectAcl
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
              - s3:ListBucket
              - s3:DeleteObject
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt PipelineArtifactBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${PipelineArtifactBucket.Arn}/*'

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: EC2InstanceRole-Demo
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess

    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: EC2InstanceProfile-Demo
      Roles:
        - !Ref EC2InstanceRole

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: CodeDeployServiceRole-Demo
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: codedeploy.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                aws:SourceArn:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:codedeploy:us-east-1:${AWS::AccountId}:application:*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:codedeploy:us-west-2:${AWS::AccountId}:application:*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CodeDeployServicePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - autoscaling:CompleteLifecycleAction
                  - autoscaling:RecordLifecycleActionHeartbeat
                  - autoscaling:DescribeLifecycleHooks
                  - autoscaling:PutLifecycleHook
                Resource: '*'

  # CodePipeline service role
  CodePipelineServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: CodePipelineServiceRole-Demo
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: codepipeline.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CodePipelineServicePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:PutObjectAcl
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt PipelineArtifactBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${PipelineArtifactBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:*
                  - autoscaling:*
                  - elasticloadbalancing:*
                  - cloudwatch:*
                  - cloudformation:*
                  - rds:*
                  - sqs:*
                  - ecs:*
                  - codedeploy:*
                  - lambda:*
                  - elasticbeanstalk:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt EC2InstanceRole.Arn
                  - !GetAtt CodeDeployServiceRole.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService:
                      - ec2.amazonaws.com
                      - codedeploy.amazonaws.com
                      - ecs.amazonaws.com
                      - elasticbeanstalk.amazonaws.com

Outputs:

  SNSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for SNS topic encryption
      Enabled: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowRootUser
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowSNSService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: "*"

  SalesNotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      DisplayName: StripeSalesNotifications
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref SNSKey

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SNSAndKMSAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: sns:Publish
                Resource: !Ref SalesNotificationTopic
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                Resource: !GetAtt SNSKey.Arn

  WebhookHandlerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: StripeSquarespaceWebhookHandler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          STRIPE_SECRET: !Ref StripeWebhookSecret
          SQUARESPACE_TOKEN: !Ref SquarespaceApiToken
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN: !Ref SalesNotificationTopic
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import hashlib
          import hmac
          import os
          import urllib.request
          import boto3
          from datetime import datetime

          STRIPE_SECRET = os.environ['STRIPE_SECRET']
          SQUARESPACE_TOKEN = os.environ['SQUARESPACE_TOKEN']
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN = os.environ['SNS_TOPIC_ARN']

          def verify_stripe_signature(payload, sig_header):
              try:
                  parts = {k: v for k, v in (pair.split('=') for pair in sig_header.split(','))}
              except:
                  return False
              timestamp = parts.get('t', '')
              expected_sig = parts.get('v1', '')
              signed_payload = f"{timestamp}.{payload.decode('utf-8')}"
              computed_sig = hmac.new(
                  STRIPE_SECRET.encode('utf-8'),
                  signed_payload.encode('utf-8'),
                  hashlib.sha256
              ).hexdigest()
              return hmac.compare_digest(computed_sig, expected_sig)

          def get_squarespace_order(order_id):
              url = f"https://api.squarespace.com/1.0/commerce/orders/{order_id}"
              req = urllib.request.Request(url)
              req.add_header('Authorization', f'Bearer {SQUARESPACE_TOKEN}')
              with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
                  return json.loads(resp.read().decode('utf-8'))

          def format_message(order):
              order_id = order.get('id', 'N/A')
              total = order.get('total', {}).get('value', 0) / 100 if order.get('total', {}).get('currency') else 0
              currency = order.get('total', {}).get('currency', 'USD')
              customer = order.get('customer', {}).get('displayName', 'Unknown') if order.get('customer') else 'Unknown'
              items = order.get('lineItems', [])
              item_list = ', '.join([item.get('name', 'Item') for item in items[:3]])
              timestamp = datetime.utcnow().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')
              message = (
                  f"🛒 **New Sale!**\n"
                  f"Order ID: {order_id}\n"
                  f"Total: ${total:.2f} {currency}\n"
                  f"Customer: {customer}\n"
                  f"Items: {item_list}\n"
                  f"Time: {timestamp}"
              )
              return message

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              try:
                  raw_body = event['body'].encode('utf-8')
                  sig_header = event['headers'].get('Stripe-Signature', '')
                  if not verify_stripe_signature(raw_body, sig_header):
                      return {'statusCode': 400, 'body': json.dumps('Invalid signature')}

                  payload = json.loads(raw_body)
                  event_type = payload.get('type', '')
                  if event_type != 'checkout.session.completed':
                      return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': json.dumps('Event ignored')}

                  session = payload.get('data', {}).get('object', {})
                  order_id = session.get('metadata', {}).get('order_id')
                  if not order_id:
                      return {'statusCode': 400, 'body': json.dumps('No order_id in metadata')}

                  order = get_squarespace_order(order_id)
                  message = format_message(order)

                  sns = boto3.client('sns')
                  sns.publish(TopicArn=SNS_TOPIC_ARN, Message=message, Subject='New Sale Notification')

                  return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': json.dumps('Notification sent')}
              except Exception as e:
                  return {'statusCode': 500, 'body': json.dumps(str(e))}

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Self-contained test environment for ElastiCache Redis cluster-mode enabled replication group with Multi-AZ, encryption, and resilience testing support.'

Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.0/22'
    Description: 'CIDR block for the VPC'
  Subnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.0/24'
    Description: 'CIDR block for the first private subnet'
  Subnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.1.0/24'
    Description: 'CIDR block for the second private subnet'

Resources:
  # VPC with DNS support and hostnames enabled
  TestVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: 'TestRedisVPC'

  # Two private subnets in different AZs
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref TestVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref Subnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: 'TestRedisPrivateSubnet1'

    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref TestVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref Subnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: 'TestRedisPrivateSubnet2'

  # Security group for Redis traffic

    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: 'Security group for Redis replication group'
      VpcId: !Ref TestVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 6379
          ToPort: 6379
          CidrIp: !Ref Subnet1CIDR
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 6379
          ToPort: 6379
          CidrIp: !Ref Subnet2CIDR
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 6379
          ToPort: 6379
          CidrIp: !Ref Subnet1CIDR
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 6379
          ToPort: 6379
          CidrIp: !Ref Subnet2CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: 'TestRedisSecurityGroup'

  # ElastiCache subnet group
  RedisSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::SubnetGroup
    Properties:
      Description: 'Subnet group for Redis replication group'
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  # KMS key for encryption (at-rest and in-transit)
  RedisKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: 'EnableRootAccess'
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: 'AllowElastiCacheService'
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: 'elasticache.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: 'AllowSNSService'
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: 'sns.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: 'TestRedisEncryptionKey'

  # KMS alias
  RedisKMSAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: 'alias/test-redis-encryption-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref RedisKMSKey

  # ElastiCache Redis replication group with cluster mode enabled
  RedisReplicationGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::ReplicationGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ReplicationGroupDescription: 'Test Redis cluster-mode enabled replication group'
      Engine: redis
      EngineVersion: '7.1'
      CacheNodeType: 'cache.r6g.large'
      NumNodeGroups: 2
      ReplicasPerNodeGroup: 1
      MultiAZEnabled: true
      AutomaticFailoverEnabled: true
      AtRestEncryptionEnabled: true
      KmsKeyId: !Ref RedisKMSKey
      TransitEncryptionEnabled: true
      CacheSubnetGroupName: !Ref RedisSubnetGroup
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref RedisSecurityGroup
      SnapshotWindow: '03:00-04:00'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: 'TestRedisCluster'

  # SNS topic for CloudWatch alarms
  TestSNSTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TopicName: 'TestRedisResilienceAlarms'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref RedisKMSKey
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: 'TestRedisResilienceAlarms'

  # SNS topic policy to allow CloudWatch to publish
  TestSNSTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref TestSNSTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: 'AllowCloudWatchPublish'
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: 'cloudwatch.amazonaws.com'
            Action: 'SNS:Publish'
            Resource: !Ref TestSNSTopic
            Condition:

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: 'ssm.amazonaws.com'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'AWS:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Path: '/'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: 'SendAutomationSignalPolicy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: 'AllowSendAutomationSignal'
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ssm:SendAutomationSignal'
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template for Cognito user pool, REST API with protected and public endpoints

Resources:

  # IAM Role for Lambda execution
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  # Lambda function backing both endpoints
  UserEndpointFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              if event.get('requestContext') and event['requestContext'].get('authorizer') and event['requestContext']['authorizer'].get('claims'):
                  claims = event['requestContext']['authorizer']['claims']
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 200,
                      'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                      'body': json.dumps({
                          'message': 'Authenticated',
                          'claims': claims
                      })
                  }
              else:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 200,
                      'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                      'body': json.dumps({
                          'message': 'Unauthenticated',
                          'claims': None
                      })
                  }

  # Cognito User Pool
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: MyUserPool
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email

  # App Client without secret, enabling USER_PASSWORD and REFRESH_TOKEN auth
  UserPoolClient:

    Properties:
      Name: MyAPI
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:

      Body:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |-
            {
              "openapi": "3.0.1",
              "info": {
                "title": "MyAPI",
                "version": "1.0"

              "paths": {
                "/me": {
                  "get": {

                    "x-amazon-apigateway-integration": {
                      "type": "aws_proxy",
                      "httpMethod": "POST",
                      "uri": "${LambdaUri}"
                    }
                  }
                },
                "/open": {
                  "get": {
                    "x-amazon-apigateway-integration": {
                      "type": "aws_proxy",
                      "httpMethod": "POST",
                      "uri": "${LambdaUri}"

                "securitySchemes": {

                    "type": "apiKey",
                    "name": "Authorization",
                    "in": "header",
                    "x-amazon-apigateway-authorizer": {
                      "type": "cognito",
                      "providerARNs": ["${UserPoolArn}"],

                    }
                  }
                }

  # Permission for API Gateway to invoke Lambda

    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref UserEndpointFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub

        - RestApiId: !Ref RestApi

    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
  RestApiId:
    Value: !Ref RestApi
  ProdStageUrl:
    Value: !Sub "https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod"
